svasti śrī ■ cakaraiyāṇṭu āyirat⌈torunūṟṟaṟupattaiñciṉ mel cellāniṉṟa śrīrājarājatevaṟku yāṇṭu 2 10 8 āvatukaṟkaṭakanāyaṟu mutal cittirameḻimalaimaṇṭalaviṇṇakarāṉa poykai aruḷāḷap⌈perumāḷukku attiyūr tevatāṉantiruviṭaiāṭṭam paḷḷiccantantukkaipaṭṭipiṭāripaṭṭi paṭṭavirutti vayittiyaviruttinila niṅkal nikki nāṟpāṟkellaiyumuṭpaṭṭa melṉokkiṉa maramuṅkiṇokkiya kiṇaṟum nañce puñcey veṭṭitaṉiyāḷ āyam pāṭikāval kaṇkāṇi kaṇakkavari eṭuttukkoṭṭi arimukkai uḷḷiṭṭa nellāyaṅkaḷum veṭṭippuṭavai mutaṟtiramam vakainta kācu paṭṭolaikkācu muḷḷaṭi ciṉṉam ⌈velippayaṟu tāppaṭiarici accataṟi cālikaittaṟi tūcakattaṟi paṟaittaṟi cekkukkaṭamai ācuvakakaṭamaiyumuḷḷiṭṭa kācukaṭamaiyum maṟṟumepperpaṭṭa nellāyaṅkaḷuṅkācāyaṅkaḷumuṭpaṭa āyaīṉār ciṟai irāmaṉ kekaraḷaceṭṭiyār pakkal poṉṉaṟakkoṇṭu maṇṇaṟappoykai aruḷāḷapperumāḷukkuttiruviṭaiāṭṭamāka maṇṇaṟa viṭṭeṉ ceṅkeṇi virācaṉi ammaiappaṉ aḻakiya coḻaṉāṉa etirili coḻaccampuvarāyaṉeṉ ■

svasti śrī ■ tirumakaḷ polapperu nilaccelviyuntaṉakkeyurimai pūṇṭamai maṉakkoḷakkāntaḷurccālai kalamaṟuttaruḷi veṅkaināṭuṅkaṅkapāṭiyunuḷampapāṭiyuntaṭikaipāṭiyuṅkuṭamalaināṭuṅkollamuṅkaliṅkamum eṇṭicai pukaḻ taraviḻamaṇṭalamum tiṇṭiṟal veṉṟittaṇṭāṟkoṇṭatteḻil vaḷaruḻi ellāyāṇṭum toḻuteḻa viḷaṅku yāṇṭe ceḻiñaraittecu koḷ śrīkovirājairājakecaripanmarāṉa śrīirājairājadevarkku yāṇṭu 2 10 1 āvatu alai puriyum puṉaṟpoṉṉi āṟuṭaiya coḻaṉarumoḻikku yāṇṭu irupattoṉṟāvateṉṟuṅkalai puriyumatinipuṇaṉ veṇ kiḻāṉkaṇiccekkaramarupoṟcūriyaṉṟaṉ nāmattāl vāmanilai niṟṟakuṅkaliñciṭṭu nīmir vaiykai malaikku nīṭuḻi iru maruṅum nel viḷaiyakkaṇṭoṉ kulai puriyum paṭai araicar koṇṭāṭum pātaṉ kuṇaviramāmunivaṉkuḷir vaiykaikkovey ■
svasti śrī ■ tirumaṉṉi vaḷaraviru nilamaṭan=taiyum porccayappāvaiyuñcīrttaṉiccelviyuntaṉ perunteviyarāki iṉpuṟu neṭu tiyal ūḻiyuḷ iṭaituṟaināṭuntuṭar vaṉavelippaṭar vaṉavāciyuñcuḷḷiccūḻ matiṭkoḷḷippākkaiyunaṇṇaṟkaru muraṇ maṇṇaikkaṭakkamum poru kaṭal īḻattaracar tamuṭiyum āṅkavar teviyaroṅkeḻiṉmuṭiyumuṉṉavar pakkaltteṉṉavar vaitta cuntaramuṭiyum intiranāramunteṇṭirai īḻamaṇṭalamuḻuvatum eṟi paṭaikkeraḷarmuṟaimaiyiṟcūṭuṅkulataṉamākiya palar pukaḻ muṭiyuñceṅkatir mālaiyuñcaṅkatir velaittol peruṅkāvaṟpala paḻantivuñceruviṟceṉavil irupattoru kālaraicukaḷai kaṭṭa paracurāmaṉ mevaruñcāntimattivavaraṇ karuti iruttiya cem poṟṟiruttaku muṭiyum payaṅkoṭu paḻi mika mucaṅkiyil mutukiṭṭoḷitta cayaciṅkaṉ aḷapperum pukaḻoṭum pīṭiyal iraṭṭapāṭi eḻarai ilakkamunavanetikkulapperumalaikaḷum vikkiramavīrar cakkarakoṭṭamumutirapaṭavallai maturamaṇṭalamum kāmiṭaivaḷaiyanāmaṇaikkoṇamum veñcilaivīrar pañcappaḷḷiyum pācuṭaippaḻanaṉmācuṇitecamum ayarvil vaṇ kirttiyātinakaravaiyiṟcan=tiraṉṟol kulattirataraṉai viḷaiyamarkkaḷattukkiḷaiyoṭum piṭittuppala taṉattoṭu niṟai kulataṉakkuvaiyuñciṭṭaruñceṟi miḷaiyoṭṭaviṣaiyamum pūcurar cer nalkkocalaināṭun=taṉmapālaṉai vem muṉaiyaḻittu vaṇṭuṟai colaittaṇṭayuttiyumiraṇacūraṉai muraṇuṟattākkittikkaṇai kirttittakkaṇalāṭamuṅkovin=tacan=taṉ māviḻin=toṭattaṅkāta cāral vaṅkāḷatecamun=toṭu kaṭaṟcaṅkukoṭṭaṉ mahīpālaṉaiveñcama vaḷākattañcuvittaruḷi oṇṭiṟal yāṉaiyum peṇṭir paṇṭāramunittilaneṭuṅkaṭaluttiralāṭamum veṟi maṇaṟṟirttatteṟi puṉaṟkaṅkaiyumāpporu taṇṭāṟkoṇṭa kopparakecaripaṉmarāṉa uṭaiyār śrīrājendracoḷadevaṟku yāṇṭu 10 2 āvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu paṅkaḷanāṭṭu naṭuvilvakai mukaināṭṭuppaḷḷiccan=tam vaikavūrttirumalai śrīkun=tavaijinālayattu devaṟkupperumpāṇappāṭikkaraivaḻimalliyūr irukkum vyāpāri nan=nappayaṉ maṇavāṭṭi cāmuṇṭappai vaitta tirunan=tāviḷakku ■ oṉṟinukkukkācu irupatum tiruvamutukku vaitta kācu pattum ■

etat viśvanṛpaśreṇimaulimālopalāḷitam ■ śāsanaṁ rājarājasya rājakesarivarmmaṇaḥ ■■ 1tirumakaḷ polapperunilaccelviyuntaṉakkeyurimai pūṇṭamai manakkoḷakkāntaḷūrccālai kalamaṟuttaruḷi veṅkaināṭuṅkaṅkapāṭiyun taṭikaipāṭiyum nuḷampapāṭiyuṅkuṭamalaināṭuṅkollamuṅkaliṅkamum eṇṭicai pukaḻ tara īḻamaṇṭalamum iraṭṭapāṭi eḻarai ilakkamuntiṇṭiṟal veṉṟittaṇṭāṟkoṇṭa taṉṉeḻil vaḷarūḻiyuḷellāyāṇṭuntoḻutaka viḷaṅkum yāṇṭey ceḻiyaraittecu koḷ korājakesarivarmmarāṉa śrīrājarājadevarkku yāṇṭu irupattāṟāvatu nāḷ irupatiṉāl uṭaiyār śrīrājarājadevar tañcāvūrkkoyilinuḷḷāl irumaṭicoḻaniṉ kīśaittirumañcanacālai dānañceytaruḷāviruntu pāṇḍyakulāśanivaḷanāṭṭuttañcāvūrkkūṟṟattuttañcāvūr nām eṭuppicca tirukkaṟṟaḷiśrīrājarājīśvaramuṭaiyārkku nāṅkuṭuttanavum akkaṉ kuṭuttanavum nam peṇṭukaḷ kuṭuttanavum maṟṟum kuṭuttār kuṭuttanavumśrīvimānattilkkallile veṭṭuka eṉṟu tiruvāy moḻiñcaruḷa veṭṭina 2yāṇṭu irupattaiñcāvatu nāḷ muṉṉūṟṟorupattiraṇṭiṉāl uṭaiyārśrīrājarājadevar kuṭutta śrībali eḻuntaruḷum poṉṉiṉ koḷkaidevaroruvar āṭavallāneṉṉuṅkallāl niṟai eṇṇūṟṟirupattoṉpatiṉ kaḻañcey mukkāley mūṉṟu mañcāṭi— 3 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ patmāsanaśrībalittālam oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai toḷāyirattuttoṇṇūṟṟaiyṅkaḻañcaraiye nālu mañcāṭi— 4 yāṇṭu irupattāṟāvatu nāḷ patināli

ṉāl uṭaiyār śrīrājarājadevar kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ tiruppaṭṭam oṉṟu āṭavallāṉeṉṉuṅkallāl niṟai nāṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟoṉpatiṉ kaḻañcu— 5 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ tiruppaṭṭam oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai nāṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟu nāṟkaḻañcaraiyey iraṇṭumañcāṭi— 6 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ tiruppaṭṭam oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai nāṉūṟṟeṇpattu nāṟkaḻañce kāl— 7 nāḷatiṉāle kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ tiruppaṭṭam oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai nāṉūṟṟut toṇṇūṟṟeḻukaḻañcarai— 8 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ tiruppaṭṭam oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai nāṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟorukaḻañcarai— 9 nāḷ irupatteḻiṉāl uṭaiyār śrīrājarājadevar ciṟutanattukkuṭutta poṉṉiṉ taḷikai oṉṟu āṭavallāṉeṉṉum kallāl niṟai aṟunūṟṟaiympattirukaḻañcey eṭṭu mañcāṭi— 10 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ taḷikai oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai nāṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟu mukkaḻañcey kāl— 11 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta

poṉṉiṉ maṇṭai oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai muṉṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟeḻukaḻañce āṟumañcāṭi— 12 nāḷatiṉāle kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ maṇṭai oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai muṉṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟu mukkaḻañcey mañcāṭi— 13 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ maṇṭai oṉṟumeṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai muṉṉūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟṟeṇkaḻañcey kuṉṟi— 14 nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ maṇṭai oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai muṉṉūṟṟut toṇṇūṟṟu aṟukaḻañcu— 15nāḷatiṉāley kuṭutta poṉṉiṉ keṇṭi oṉṟu meṟpaṭi kallāl niṟai irunūṟṟeṇpattu nāṟkaḻañcarai— 16 nāḷ muppattu nāliṉāl uṭaiyār śrīrājarājadevar ciṟutanattukkuṭutta poṉṉi

svasti śrī ■ tiripuvaṉacakkaravarttikaḷ śrī kolottuṅkacoḻatevarkku yāṇṭuirupatteṭṭāvatu irācentiracoḻavaḷanāṭṭu puṟaṅkarampaināṭṭu tirukkaḷaruṭaiyamātevarkku amāvāci aravāparaṇatevar tiruviḻā veḻuntaruḷukaikku aṟṟai nāḷāl tevar perumtiruvamutu ceyvikkavum piḷḷaiyārkku tiruvamutu ceyvikkavum śrīmulattānammuṭaiyār amutuceytaruḷavum aṟṟai nāḷāl tevaraṭiyārai amutuceyvikkavum neṉmalināṭṭu taṇṇirkkunṟammuṭaiyān civan tillai nāyakannānaciṟuttoṇṭanampi ceyta upaiyamāvitu ■ ikkoyil civappirāmaṇan kaucikan veṇkāṭaṉpaṭṭaṉum kāciyavan kāṟāyil muḷaiccāṉum kaucikaṉ ātittaṉ āṭavalāṉum uḷḷiṭṭa civappirāmaṇarom ivarpakkal ivvāṭṭai vaikāci mācattu nāṅkaḷ poliyūṭṭu koṇṭa mutal nellu aṟupatiṉ kalattukkum kalattukku mukkuṟuṇiyāka palicai poliyum nellu patinṉaiñkalattukkum celavāka amāvācitoṟum kalanemukkuṟuṇṇiyāka cantirātittavaṟ munniṉṟome ceyakkaṭavomākavum ivvūr aravāparaṇan eṭuttapātamāna tirucciṟṟampalakkālāṉum aravāparaṇaṉ iyaparatanātaṉum āṭavalāṉāṉa pūruvacivanāṉa pattarkaḷṇāyaka piccaṉum aravintan kunṟaṉāṉa nāṟpatteṇṇāyirapiccanum kūttan kaṅkaikoṇṭāṉāna civacaraṇacekaramuventaveḷāṉum[*] ivaivom civan tillaināyakan pakkalṉāṅkaḷ upaiyam paṇṇi poliyūṭṭukkoṇṭa nellu nūṟṟu irupatin kalattukkum kalanellukkumukkuṟuṇiyāka orāṭṭaināḷaikku palicai nellu muppatin kalam ■ amāvāci onṟukku nellu irukalanetūṇippatakkāka tevaraṭiyār muppatu kalam amutu cevikkakkaṭavom eṅkaḷil puṇaivacam ■ caṉtirātittavaṟ śrīmāyeśuvararakṣai kaṇapeṟṟār māyecuvarak kāṇiyāniṟka ■ ivai eṉ neḻuttu ■
svasti śrī ■ tiripuvaṉacakkaravattikaḷ śrīirājarājatevaṟku yāṇṭu patineṭṭāvatu nāḷnūṟṟeṇpatināl irācēntiracoḻavaḷanāṭṭup puṟaṅkarampaināṭṭut tirukkaḷar muḷaitta mātevaṟku amāvāci eḻuntaruḷi tevaraṭiyārai amutu ceyvikkac cuṅkantavuttaruḷiṉa kolottuṅkacoḻatevaṟku irupatteṭṭāvatu taṇṇiṟkuṉṟamuṭaiyāṉ civantillaināyakan pakkal ittevar tirumaṭaiviḷākattirukkum āṇṭārkaḷ upaiyamāka koṇṭa nellukku amutu ceyvikkumpaṭikku muṉpu veṭṭiṉa ceppeṭṭupaṭiyil upaiyaṅkoṇṭu amutuceyvittuvarukiṟa āṇṭārkaḷil āṇvaḻi aṟṟup peṇvaḻiyāṉa kottukku amutu ceyvikkumpaṭi kaṉakarāyarum śrīmākecuvararum aṟuti paṇṇukiṟa iṭattup poliūṭṭup peṇvaḻiyum varumeṉṟu śrīmāgecuvarar niccayittamaiyil ippaṭi cammatittup peṇvaḻiyilār iṭṭa tiṭṭuppaṭi āṭavalāṉ pūrvacivaṉāna pattakanāyakap piccan makaḷaik koṇṭa kaṇpeṟṟāṉ manṟu niṟaintānāṉa aṉpaṟkaṭiyān amutu ceyvikkum per munṟu ivaṉ koḻunti makan tevaṉtivākaraṉ uḷḷiṭṭār amutu ceyvikkum per munṟum āṇvaḻi tirucciṟṟampalakkālāṉ amutu ceyvikkum aiñcu kūṟiṭ ṭiraṇṭu kūṟṟāl per paṉniraṇṭum amutu ceyvikka ■

maḻavaraiyaṉ cuntaracoḻaṉeṉ tūciyūr nakarattārai nāṅ koḷḷum miṟai muḻumaṉai kālum araimaṉai araikkālum niṉṟa iṟaiākak koḷvatākavum
taṇṭaṅkuṟṟa muḷḷatu nantipura maṟcāti koḷavatākavum
itaṉ ṟeṉṟāṉ sukitacantāṉam tuppaṉa vaṟuvāṉ
itu irakṣittāṉaṭi eṉ talai melatu.

kovirājakesaripanmarkkut tiruveḻuttiruveḻuttiṭṭuc cellāniṉṟa yāṇṭu añcāvatu ivvāṇṭu kollimaḻavaṉ oṟṟiyūraṉ piratikaṇṭavarmmaṉeṉ eṉṉāṭṭut tūciyūrt teṉpulat tūnilam kiḻakkellai piṭāriyār nilattukkumamaiccikkum pūnāṟṟiaṇaikkum mekkum teṟkkellai tiruppāṟaikkuk kiḻakkuk kaṉṉāṭṭukkum peruvarampukkum vaṭakkum tiruppāṟaikku mekku kaṉṉāṭṭukkum peruvarampukkum vaṭakkum mekkellai cūḷaikuḷamāṉa kāntaḷerikkun tāṉṟoṉṟippirāṉ koyilun tūciyūrt teṉvāy vāyiliṉiṉṟu teṟkku nokkipp poṉa peruvaḻikkum kiḻakkum vaṭakkellai tūciyūrup paḻavūrkkut teṟkkum tāmaraikkuḷamum ikkuḷattāl nirkovaiyum itaṭupiviraṉ bhūmiyum kaṟṟaḷiyeriyāṉa putukkuḷamum ikkuḷattu nirkovaiyum ikkuḷakkiḻellaiyāvatu kiḻakkellai kaṉṉāṭṭukku mekkunteṟkkellai kaṭṭinākaṉkūva liṭṭēri vaṭakku mekkellai mūkkuṟukāviṟkku kiḻakkum vaṭakkellai erikkun teṟkkum kaṇavatinallūrāṉa amaṇkuṭiyum avvūr naṉpulamum ceppulamum ivvicaitta perunāṉekellaiyi ṉilam meṉokkiṉa maramum kiḻnokkiṉa kiṇaṟum puṟṟu muṭakkuṟaiyum uṭumpoṭi yāmai tavaḻntatu epperppaṭṭa nilamum tūciyūrt tirukkaṟṟaḷi tirumulasthāṉamuṭaiya parameśvararkku udagapūrvvañ ceytu ellaiyuṅ kallun terittuk kuṭutteṉ kollimaḻavaṉ oṟṟiyūraṉ piratikaṇṭavarmmaṉeṉ ■

svasti praśastina stulyakalyāṇaguṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ■ pāṇḍyabhūpālaśuṇḍālakhaṇḍanoddaṇḍakesarī ■ khaṭ·ganārāyaṇo rūpanārāyaṇayaśaḥpadam ■ prājyakākatirājyaśrīpratiṣṭhāpanadeśikaḥ ■ deśān=tarāḷaviśrān=tayaśaskaraparākramaḥ ■ karṇakāmagavīvarṇavitīrṇavilasatkramaḥ ■ gāyigovāḷavikhyātanāmā somasamākṛtiḥ ■prajñābalārjitānvartthasarvajñabirudojvalaḥ ■ rājacūḍāmaṇiḥ pūrṇapauruṣaścaturānanaḥ ■ aṃgīkṛtāryo dhanado jagatprāṇassujīvanaḥ ■ satpauṇyajanyo dharmmātmā śucissumanasām maṇiḥ ■ bhāsvān rājā maṃgaḷātmā budho gurukavipradhīḥ ■ rāvupinnannabhūpālaratnākarasudhākaraḥ ■ rājasāman=tasiṁha śrīnṛsiṁhanaranāyakaḥ ■

svasti śrī ■ sārvabhaumaccakravattikaḷ śrivirasomiśvaradevaṟku yāṇṭu 2 10 1 vatu meṣanāyaṟṟu aparapakṣattu daśamiyum cevvāykkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa catayattu nāḷ kāśimaharideśattu caubhāṇayatu vaṃśattu jājaladevaṉ bhāryaiy ivaṉaiye mutukaṇṇāka uṭaiya jākhaladevik=ku pāṇṭikulācaṉivaḷanāṭṭu viḷānāṭṭu tiruvāṉaikkāttiruppatiyil śrīmāheśvarakkaṅkāṇi ceyvārkaḷil perumarutūr kāśyapaṉ uyyakkoṇṭān tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ tirunāvalūrnampiyeṉ nilavilaipramāṇa icaivutiṭṭu iṟṟaināḷāl ivūril nāṉ ivaḷukku viṟṟukuṭutta nilamāvatu tirupputiyitu viḷākattu ceyāṉa tiruñāṉacampantappallavaraiyaṉpāle nāṉ vilaikoṇṭu uṭaiyeṉāy eṉṉutāyirunta puṉcey nilaṅ kuḻi aṟunūṟu innilaṅ kuḻi aṟunūṟum ijākhaladevikku vi .... taṉ ittirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ tirunāvalūr nampiyeṉ inilattukku kiḻpāṟkellai virukkiṉṟāṉ viḷainilattukku meṟkum melpāṟkellai ciṟuttoṇṭar nandavaṉattukku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkukellai viṟkkiṉṟār nilattukku teṟkum teṉpāṟkellai meṟppaṭiyār nilattukku vaṭakkum iṉṉāṅkellaiyuḷ naṭuvupaṭṭa puṉcey nilaṅkkuḻi aṟunūṟu inilaṅkuḻi aṟunūṟṟukkum emmilicainta vilaipporuḷaṉṟāṭu naṟkācu 3 1000 ikkācu mūvāyiramum āvaṇakaḷariye kāṭṭeṟṟik kaiccilavaṟa kaikoṇṭu ippuṉ cey nilaṅ kuḻi aṟunūṟumviṟṟuk kuṭutteṉ ijjākhaladevikku ittirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉāṉa tirunāvalūrnampiyeṉ innilattu meṉokkiṉa maraṅkaḷum kiḻ nokkiṉa kiṇaṟukaḷum maṟṟum meppeṟpaṭṭa urimaikaḷum bhāgāśrayaṅkaḷumakappaṭa viṟṟukkuṭutta in=nilattukku ivaḷ veṇṭiṉapote pramāṇam paṇṇikkuṭukkakaṭaveṉākavum kuṭuttileṉākil innilavilaipramāṇa icaivutiṭṭe pramāṇamāvatākavum ippaṭi sammadittu in=nilavilaipramāṇa icaivutiṭṭuk kuṭutteṉ kāśamaharideśattu caubhāṇavaṅśattu jājaladevaṉ bhāryaiy ivaṉaiye mutukaṇṇāka uṭaiya jākhaladevikku perumarutūr kāśyapaṉ uyyakkoṇṭāṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ tirunāvalūrnampiyeṉ ittirunāvalūrnampi samijñaiyāṉamaikkum ippaṭikkum ivai maturāntakabraṃmārāyaṉ eḻuttu koyiṟkkaṭamai iṭuttukkoḷḷakaṭavarkaḷākavum ■

kuṭukkaiyālum maṟṟum palavaḻikaḷāle tiruviṭaiyāṭṭattil uṭalkaḷai aḻikkaiyāle iraṇṭu samvatsarattilāka muṉṉūṟṟuc ciṉṉam nāḷ tiruvārātaṉam orunāḷp paṭi koṇṭu palanāḷ paṭi celutta ippaṭi nāḷ viḻukaiyālum palamaṇṭalaṅkaḷil tiruviṭaiyāṭṭaṅkaḷ taṅkaḷukku paṟṟāka kūṟiṭṭu aṭaittukkoṇṭu taṅkaḷ āḷkaḷ pokaviṭṭu taṇṭivanta uṭalkaḷ tāṅkaḷum oṭṭarumāka koḷkaiyālum ippaṭi tiruvārātaṉan taṭṭuppaṭṭateṉṟum śrīmanmahāvaṭṭaviyāpāri lāṭadevayanāyakkaṉ makaṉ narasiṁhanāyakkaṉ taṉakkum taṉ mātāpitākkaḷ uḷḷiṭṭārkkum naṉṟāka śrīraṃganāthaṉukkut tirumālai cātti aruḷat tirumālaippuṟamākat taṉ artdham iṭṭu vilaikoṇṭa tirunantavaṉamāvatu pāṇṭikulācaṉivaḷanāṭṭu viḷānāṭṭut tiruvaraṅkantiruppatit tirukkuṟaippaṟṟil peruvaḻikkut teṉṉoḻukil pullūrt tiruppālkkaṭaldāsar makaṉ tirukkurukaippirāṉāṉa celvanampipakkal vilaikoṇṭa tirunantavaṉattukkuk kīḻpāṟkellai perumpuliyūr cipātappiccaṉ tirunantavaṉattukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai teṉ āṟṟil nīroṭukālukku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai talaicceṅkāṭṭut kiḻakkaṭaiya iṟṟaināḷilum iddevaṟku iraṇṭāvatu nāḷilum vaṭavellai peruvaḻiyilum teṉellai teṉāṟṟil niroṭukālilum mikutikkuṟaivum uḷḷaṭaṅka vilaikoṇṭa kiḻmel kol 3 1/2 ikkol muṉṟaraiyum inta āṟaraikkolilum niṉṟamutumaraṅkaḷil nilaviḻukkāṭṭu opātiyum ikkūṟu kol muṉṟaraiyil niṉṟa iḷamaran teṅku mā nelli nāval uḷḷiṭṭumeṉokkiṉa maramum kiṇōkkiṉa kiṇaṟum bhāgāśrayaṅkaḷum maṟṟum eppeṟpaṭṭa urimaikaḷum akappaṭa ikkol mūṉṟaraikkum irupatteṇṇāyiraṅkācu iṉnarasiṁhanāyakkaṉ kuṭuttu vilaikoṇṭamaiyil ittirunantavaṉaṅkol muṉṟaraiyum ittiruppālkaṭaldāsar makaṉ tirunāṭuṭaiyāḻvārāṉa tiruppālkaṭaldāsaṉ kaikkoṇṭu śrīraṃganāthaṉ tirumuṉpu nāḷ oṉṟukku ivaṉ eṭukkum in=narasiṁhanāyakkaṉ tirumālai oṉṟum ivaṉ pitā iddevayanāyakkaṉ tirumālai oṉṟum ivaṉ bhāryai in=narasiṁha nāyakkaṉ mātā sāmavāyi tirumālai oṉṟum ummavāyi tirumālai oṉṟum ciriyavāyi tirumālai oṉṟum in=narasiṁhanāyakkaṉ bhāryyai pommavāyi tirumālai oṉṟum mādeyanāyakkaṉ makaṉ sāraṃganāyakkaṉ tirumālai oṉṟum ivaṉ tampi gaṃgādharanāyakkaṉ tirumālai oṉṟum gadādharadevaṉ tirumālai oṉṟum āka nāḷ oṉṟukku eṭukkum tirumālai oṉpatum iṟṟaināḷmutal ittirunāṭuṭaiyāḻvārāṉa tirupālkkaṭaldāsaṉ śrīraṃganāthaṉ tirumuṉpu eṭuttuc cāttiaruḷappaṇṇi ittirunantavaṉaṅ kol muṉṟaraiyum taṉakku jīvanaśeṣamākak kaikkoṇṭu aṉupavikkakkaṭavaṉākavum ittirunantavaṉam ivaṉ viṟṟal oṟṟivaittal ceyyātoḻiyak kaṭavaṉākavum ceytāṉākil vilaiyum oṟṟiyum koṇṭaavarkaḷukku somākātoḻiyak kaṭavatākavum ittirunantavaṉattukkuk kaṭamai kuṭimai uḷḷaṉavum ittiruppālkaṭaldāsaṉ tāṉe iṟuttu ippaṭi nāḷ oṉṟukku oṉpatāka vanta tirumālai eṭuttuc cātti aruḷappaṇṇakkaṭavaṉākavum ippaṭi ittirumālai oṉpatum eṭuttilaṉākil ittirunantavaṉam ivaṉ aṉupavan tavintuviṭavum śrīraṃganāthaṉukkut tirunāmattukkāṇiyākakkaṭavatākavum ippaṭikkuk kalveṭṭu ■■
svasti śrīḥ ■ sārvabhauma śrīmatpratāpacakravat=tikaḷ poycaḷa śrīvīrarāmanāthadevaṟku yāṇṭu iraṇṭāvatu kumbhanāyaṟṟu pūrvapakṣattu saptamiyumbudhaṉkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa bharaṇi nāḷ tiruvaraṅkantiruppatiyil śrīpādantāṅkum nampimāril tiruvaḻuntūr śrīraṃgarājabrahmādhirājarmakaṉ tiruvaravaṇainiṟaintāṟku malaimaṇṭalattuk kutiraic ceṭṭikaḷil nallūrt tuppanāyakkaṉeṉ kalveṭṭikkuṭutta paricāvatueṉakku naṉṟāka aḻakiyamaṇavāḷapperumāḷukkuc cāttiaruḷa ittiruvaravaṇainiṟaintār eṭukkiṟa tirumālai iraṇṭukku palavaṟkattuttiruppaḷḷittāmam vaittu ākkavum tiruppaḷḷittāmamum ākkat tirunantavaṉamum ceykiṟa tiruvaravaṇainiṟaintāṟkku jīvaṉattukku uṭalāka ittiruppati śrīvaiṣṇavarkaḷil kumāṇṭur iṭavai irācamentiranampipakkal tirukkuṟaippaṟṟil teṉoḻuki liṭavai aḻakiyamaṇavāḷanampi tirunantavaṉattukku meṟku vetaneṟikāṭṭiṉān tiruttukku vaṭakkunt tiruvaḻuntūr vaṭakopurattāḻvi tirunantavaṉattukku kiḻakku meṟkkuṉokkipokiṟa peruvaḻikkut teṟku ṉaṭuvuuṭpaṭṭa tirunantavaṉam kiḻaimel kol 3 1/2 1/16 ittirunantavaṉam kol muṉṟaraiye mākāṇiyāluḷḷatiruppaḷḷittāma mānilaippuñceyum viḷainilamum mel ṉokkiṉa maramum kiḻṉokkiṉa kiṇaṟum uṭpaṭa nāṉ vilaikoṇṭa paṭiye ittiruvaravaṇainiṟaintāṟku tirunantavaṉamākavum tirunantavaṉappuṟamākavum kuṭuttu ippaṭi candrādityavarai celvatāka kalveṭṭikkuṭutteṉ nallūr tuppanāyakkaṉeṉ ■■ itu śrīvaiṣṇavarkaḷ rakṣai ■■

svasti śrīḥ ■ sārvabhauma śrīmat pratāpaccakravarttikaḷpocaḷa śrīvīrarāmanāthadevaṟku yāṇṭu patiṉaiñcāvatu mithunanāyaṟṟu aparapakṣattu ekādaśiyum nāyiṟṟukkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa bharaṇi nāḷirācarācavaḷanāṭṭu tirumuṉaippāṭi aviyaṉūrnāṭṭu brahmadeyam raṇadhīraccaturvedimaṅkalattuvaṅkippuṟattu aḻakiyamaṇavāḷabhaṭṭarāṉa kacciyarāya brahmādhirājar ivviṭattu ukantaruḷappaṇṇi tiruvārādhanaṅ koṇṭaruḷukiṟa innāyaṉār tirukkuḻa lūtiyaruḷukiṟa piḷḷaikkum nāccimārkkum tiruvārādhanattukkum amutupaṭi cāttuppaṭikaḷukkum ubhayamāka nūṟāyiraṅkācu śrīpaṇṭārattile oṭukka itil vṛddhikku innāḷ mutal nāḷ oṉṟukku tiruvaraṅkatevaṉāle patakku tirupponakap paḻavariciyumivvarici viḻukkāṭu paruppamutu uppamutu miḷakamutu kaṟiyamutu neyyamutu aṭaikkāyamutuilaiyamutu uḷḷiṭṭa amutupaṭikaḷum eṇṇaikkāppu nellikkāppu mañcaḷkāppu cantaṉakkāppu tiruppaḷḷittāmam tirumālai tirupparivaṭṭamuḷḷiṭṭa cāttuppaṭikaḷum nāḷtoṟum tirukkoṭṭakārattile viṭakkaṭavatākap peṟaveṇumeṉṟu ivar jiyarkku viṇṇappañceytu varakkāṭṭukayāle ippaṭiye jiyarum tiruppati śrīvaiṣṇavarkaḷum tiruppaṇi ceyyum janaṅkaḷum perumāḷukku viṇṇappañceyya tiruvuḷḷamāy ippaṭikku ceyvatākavum paṇṇikkuṭuttu ippaṭikku uṅkaḷ olaiyuṅ kuṭuṅkoḷeṉṟu tiruvāymoḻintaruḷiṉapaṭikku mahāniyogamum puṟappaṭṭu śrīpaṇṭārattile kācu nūṟāyiramum oṭukki taravum puṟappaṭukaiyil innāḷ mutal ippaṭi nittal vanta amutupaṭi cāttuppaṭikaḷ candrādityavat naṭakkakaṭavatāka kal veṭṭikkuṭuttatuitu śrī vaiṣṇava rakṣai
svasti śrīḥ ■ komāṟapaṉmar tirupuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīḥkulacekaratevaṟku yāṇṭu 4 vatu katkaṭakanāyaṟṟu pūrvapakṣattu caturddaśiyum caṉikkiḻamaiyum peṟṟauttirāṭattu nāḷ uṭaiyār keṅkaikoṇṭacoḷiśvaramuṭaiya nāyaṉārkku tirunāmattukkāṇiyāka nāṭṭuvilaiyaraka vilaikoṇṭa kumāramaṅkalamuṭaiyāṉ civatāṇṭāṉkāṇiyāṉa vaṭakarai virutarācapayaṅkaravaḷanāṭṭu meṟkānāṭṭu vikkiramacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu maṇṇaicoḻavaḷanāṭṭu kaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻapurappaṟṟil tevaṇiputtūṟ kellaiyāvatu kiḻpāṟkellaiuṭaiyār tiruppulīśvaramuṭaiyār tirunāmattukkāṇi kuṟuṅkuṭikkum maṉṉaṉār tiruviṭaiyāṭṭam vīranārāyaṇanallūr tiruvāḻikkallukkum kaṇṇamaṅkalattellaikku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellaikaṇṇamaṅkalam virarācentiracoḻapuram u ..... ṭarom tevanallūr ellaikku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai maḻavataraiyanallūr kiḻāy meṭṭellaikku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai akkarampaiyāḷaṉpaṭṭu ellaikkut teṟkum iṉṉāṉkellaik kuṭpaṭṭa ūrṉattamum maṉaikaḷum nañceyyum puṉceyyum toppukkaḷum erinirvāṅka nilamum ūruṇi kuḷamum potuvum potātiyum meṉokkiṉa maramumkiḻṉokkiṉa kiṇaṟum tirunāmattukkāṇiyāka vilaikoṇṭu ivvūr nāṉkellaikkum tiruccūlattāpaṉam paṇṇi ūrile nāṭṭiṉom ■

svasti śrīḥ ■ tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ koṉeriṉmaikoṇṭāṉ śrīcuntarapāṇṭiyatevarkku yāṇṭu iraṇṭāvatu vaṭakarai vikkiramacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu maṇṇaikoṇṭacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu poṉparappippaṟṟil kaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻapurattu uṭaiyār kaṅkaikoṇṭa coḷiśva ramuṭaiyanāyaṉār koyilttāṉattārkku iṉṉāyaṉārkku nam perāl kaṭṭiṉa cuntarapāṇṭiyaṉcantikkum tirunāḷaikku amutupaṭi cāttupaṭi uḷḷiṭṭa nittanimantaṅkaḷukku muṭalāka ivvūrkaḷāl muṉṉāḷvaraiyum tevatāṉamumtirunāmattukkāṇikaḷum iṟaiyiliyāy potukiṟa peri ...... kiḻakku melai .. kkaṭṭukku kiḻakku tiruvācal nārācattukku meṟkkupattutteruvil cuttamalinārācattukku meṟkkum irācentiracoḻaṉ ...... kut teṟkku im ... l vempukuṭivācalukku vaṭakku naṭuvuṭppaṭṭa naṉceyum puṉceyum maṉai nattappuṉceyum tirunantavaṉappuṟaṅkaḷum tiruviḷakku eṇṇaippu ṟaṅkaḷum tiruttoppukkaḷum tiruvoṭaippaṟṟukkaḷum uṭpaṭaiviṭṭilmatikaḷukkuḷppaṭṭa maṉai nattapuṉceyum naṉceyum irācentiracoḻaṉ tirumatiḷu ....... tirunāmattukkāṇi... vayittappaḷḷamāṉa ka ..... ṇaṉ tiruvoṭai naṉcey nilamum ivai cūḻnta puṉcey nilamum inta .......... voṭaikaḷil naṅkaikku.... ppākkuḷam maṭākuḷam tittakuḷam ... ḷḷa kuḷaṅkaḷilaruḷa uṭaiyār toṭṭamum jalapratiṣṭhai ........ perreri erimiṉppāṭṭam..... ṟai taṟiyiṟai taṭṭārppāṭṭa ........ kaṭai āyam maṉai iṟai maṟṟuḷḷa aṉaittāyaṅkaḷum .......... ka uṭppaṭa iṟaiyiliyāka..... ṉom ippaṭikku ivve ......... ṭākakkoṇṭu cantirātittavaraiyum iṟaiyiliyākak kallilum cempilum veṭṭikkoḷka.... kku ce . ntiyārukku nam olai .......... iṉṉāṉkellaikku uḷpaṭṭa tevatāṉam tirunāmattu ......... uḷḷa kaṭamai kuṭimai evalt te.... yappelppaṭṭatum taṇṭi ..... pūcaiyum tiruppaṇiyum tāḻvupaṭāmal naṭattacceyvatu ivai ............. ivai kāliṅkarāyar eḻuttu.... yar eḻuttu yāṇṭu 2 vatu nāḷ u ḷa 5 ■

svasti śrī ■ tiruvāykkeḻvi muṉṉāka muṭittalaiyu maturaiyuṅ koṇṭaruḷina tiribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrī kulottuṅkacoḻade ......ṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu svasti śrī ■ samadhiyutapañcamahāśabda mahāmaṇḍalīśvara kanupārapuravarātiśvara veṅgivallabha go .....ritirāvaniśvara pīṭhādehavaraprasāda śrīkāḷahastidevadivyaśrīpādārādhaka śrīmadveṃkaṭanādhapādāravindaśekhara ....rājaśrījananāravindalocana samastapraśasti śaśikulacāḷuk=ki tirukkāḷattitevaṉāṉa yātavarāyanen jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu eyiṟko ......yilnāṭṭu tiruattiūr niṉṟa aruḷāḷapperumāḷukku nittanimantattukkum tirunāṭpaṭiyuñ celvatāka tāmaṟkoṭṭattu amaṇpākkamāṉa te ....māṉanallūrāl vanta kaṭamaiyuṅ kācāyamum veṭṭiyuñ ciṟupāṭikāvalum eṭuttukkoṭṭiyun taṉiāḷum uḷḷiṭṭa nellāyamu ....ṭa tiruviṭaiyāṭṭamāka viṭṭeṉ ■■■

svasti śrī ■ tirupuvaṉaccakkaravatti koṉeriṉmaikoṇṭāṉ tiruvattikiri niṉṟaruḷiya paramasvāmikaḷ perumāḷ aruḷāḷanātaṉkoyil tiruppatiśrīvaiṣṇavarkaḷukku perumāḷ aruḷāḷanātaṉukku irupattoṉṟāvatu mārkaḻimātam mutalukku namperāl kaṭṭiṉa kaliyuka irāmaṉcaṉtikkum tirunāḷḷaikkum amutupaṭi cāttupaṭi tirumālai tirupparivaṭṭam uḷḷiṭṭa nimantaṅkaḷukkuveṇṭum veṇṭumavaiyiṟṟukkut tirumālai eṭukkum vaḷattuvāḻvittārkku paḻamatturil kaḻitta poṉ aimpatukkum viṭṭa paiyyaṉūrrum vaṭapiṭākai paṟṟil kiṇārum paḻamattūrum ivūrkaḷil nāṉkellaikku uḷ paṭṭa naṉcey puṉcey nattam nirnilai uḷḷiṭṭapaṟṟil paḷḷicaṉtam paḻantevatāṉam tiruviṭaiyāṭṭam ivai ........ ṉavari aṉaittāyam ..........

svasti śrī ■ karikālacoḻatevaṟkku yāṇṭu patinnonṟāvatu āḷuṭaiyār tiruvāṉpaṭṭi uṭaiyāṟkut tenvaḻināṭṭu eḻur ūrāḷi tenkuperil ciṅkaṉ coḻanāṉa aṇuttarappallavaraiyannen āḷuṭaiyār tiruvānpaṭṭi uṭaiyāṟku ceṅkaḻuṉir cāttiaruḷa ceṅkaḻuṉir oṭai yuṅ kalluvittu ceṅkaḻuṉirt tirupapaḷḷittāmam ākkuvāṉukku nimaṉtappuṟamāka viṭṭa nilamāvatu perur piññakaṉ vayalil kaṇavativāykkālukku vaṭakku nilivatikku meṟku iraṇṭāṅkaṇṇāṟṟu muṉṟām catirattu ceṅkaḻunirpuṟamāka viṭṭa nilam araimāvum irājātittamannaṟayiltiruvāṉpaṭṭi vāykkālukku vaṭakku vilāṭakulamāṇikkavatikkuk kiḻakku mutaṟkaṇṇāṟṟu mūṉṟām tuṇṭattu nilam kāṇiyum ākanilam mukkāṇiyum koṇṭu ceṅkaḻuṉirt tiruppaḷḷittāmam cāttuvatākavum ittaṉmam cantirātittavaṟa celvatākavum iṉṉilattukku talaipukuṉta nilamāvatu karaivaḻināṭṭueṉṟūr kaṇṇāṭipputtūril vaṭakarai nilamttovicey mukkāṇiyum viṭṭu ittaṉmam ceyten aṇuttirap pallavarāyanāṉa aṇutti ...
svasti śrī ■ koṉerimaikoṇṭān tiruvānpaṭṭi uṭaiyār cikāriyañceyvārkaḷukkunañceṉāpatikaḷil kaṇṭarātittaṉ ceṭṭiyāna rājarājappaṅkaḷanāṭuṭaiyāṉukkunam ceṉāpatik kāṇiyāka iṭṭa nilamāvatu perurnāṭṭu kovanputtūrrāna virakeraḷanallūrppālperumāṭkaḷ nāccinallūril civapātacekaramaṉṉaṟaiyil atirācarācavāykkālukku vaṭakku koṅkakulvallivatikkuk kiḻakkup puṟatuṇṭattu nelvitai mukkalattil ittevar paṅkuṉittirunāḷ viṇṇāḷaṉukku ivaṉ viṭṭa nelvitai irukalattiṉāl melvārattāl nel irupattu nāṟkalattukkuc cilavākat tiru amutarici tūṇip patakkunāl viñcaṉa muṭpaṭa nelkkalaṉe tūṇip patakkum maṭattukku arici nāṟkalattinālviñcaṉam uṭpaṭa nelp patiṉaiṅkalane tūṇiaṟunāḻiyum pūcikkum nampiyarkku tiruppaḷḷittāmam paṟippānukkum toṭuppānnukkum tirukkuḻalpaṇicevāṟkkumnel kalane tūṇi tiruviti āṇṭārkaḷukku nelirutūṇi patakku tiruviḷakkeṇṇai kuṟi nānāḻikku nel nākkalam tiruppatiyam pāṭuvoṟkumnaṭṭuvaṟkum nel tūṇi pataṟkum irukala nel vitaiyāl pāṭṭanel irupattu nāṟkalanetūṇip pataṟkum koṇṭu ittaṉmam celuttuka itupanmāecuvar rekṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ vīraballāḷatevar pṛthivirājyam paṇṇiaruḷā ...... saṁvat saram ......pakṣattu saptamiyum nāyaṟṟukkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa kāttikai nāḷ pāṇṭimaṇṭalattu ... cintāmaṇivaḷanāṭṭu .e ....tiruvikramaṉ kaṇṇappaṉāṉa teṉṉavataraiyaṉeṉ koṅkamaṇṭalattu perur nāṭṭu perur uṭaiyār ti ....ṭaiyanāyanārkku ucciccantiyile oru canti teṉṉavataraiyaṉ canti ka yeṉṟu amutu ceytaruḷa a....kkum kaṟi amutu mutalāya pala veñcaṉamum uṭpaṭa nāḷoṉṟukku nellu tūṇippatakku āka āṇṭu oṉṟu ...tiṉ kalattukkum teṉṉavataraiyaṉ tiruttoppukkut tirunantavaṉappuṟattukku āṇṭoṉṟukku ne ....lattukkum ittoppil maṇṭapattile tiruttaippūcattukkum tiruppaṅkūṉit tirunāḷ ti ...ḷila eṟi aruḷi amutu ceytaruḷa amutupaṭi aricikkum pala veñcaṉattukkum nellu patiṉkalattukkum ....m vaḻakkattukku eṇṇaikkum tiruvitip pantattukku eṇṇaikkum nellu eḻukalaṉe kuṟuṇi nāṉāḻiyum āka ....pattaṟukalaṉe iru tūṇip patakku nāṉāḻikkum viṭṭa nilamāvatu iṉṉāṭṭuk kulacekaranallūr ūravar pakkal nāṉ vilai koṇṭu uṭaiyeṉāy aṉupavi ....viranārāyaṉaṉ maṉṉaṟaiyil vitai irupatteḻukalaṉe irutūṇikku perunāṉku ellaiyāvatu nāṟpāṟkellai ...kavarukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai ivvūṟ paṟṟukku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai attikkavarukkiḻakkum ....ilakṣuminārāyaṇapperumāḷ tiruviṭaiyāṭṭattukkut teṟkum āka icainta perunāṉkellaikku uṭpaṭṭa nilattil pe ....vitai pataṉaṟukalattiṉāl nilam paṉṉiraṇṭu mā iṉṉilam paṉṉiraṇṭu māvum teṉṉavataraiyaṉ cantikkum teṉṉa .....m tiruttaippūcattukkum tiruppaṅkuṉi tirunāḷ tīttattukkum amutupṭippuṟamum tirunantavaṉappuṟamumāka viṭṭeṉ ceḻuvaṉūr u ..ṉ innilattukku māttāl irupattirukalanellāka vanta nellukkuk kulacekaranallūr ūrum nakarattārum kuṭi niṅkāte .... piṟavaraneṟikkāṇiyile aḷappārkaḷākavum ippaṭikku ...... amutu ...... ṟukku eḻumāhecurarku per oṉ ...m amutu ceyta kaṟiyamutum tirumuṉ oṭukkukai iṭuvatākavum ippaṭikku cantirātittavarai cella cempilum cilaiyilum veṭṭikkoḷ ...ceḻuvaṉūr uṭaiyāṉ tiruvikkirama kaṇṇappaṉāṉa teṉṉavataraiyaṉeṉ ippaṭi ivai teṉṉavataraiyaṉ eḻuttu itupa ......
■ svasti śrī ■■ taṇṭīśvaraṉ ōlai cākarañcūḻ vaiyyakattukkaṇṭīśvaran karumamārāyka paṇṭe aṟañceytāṉ ceytānaṟaṅkāttār pātan tiṟampāmal ceṉṉimel vaittu aruḷālāticaṇṭeśvaraṉ ātecam naṅkuṭiyāṉ teṉṉavārumaṉukku nammolai kuṭuttapaṭiyāvatu uṭaiyār tiruvānpaṭṭiyāḷuṭaiyār tevatānam kovanputtūr kār maṟu irācairācaṉ maṉṉa⌈ṟai taṭi 1■ṉāl nilam araikkāṇi kār orupū puttūr perumākkaḷ naccimaṉṉaṟai palataṭiyiṉāl nilam muṉṟumā mukkāṇiyum āka nilam muṉṟumā mukkāṇi araikkāṇiyum namtoḻaṉār virapāṇṭiyatevaṟkku yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutal kaikkoṇṭu vaḻutu accuvaṟkam iṟuttum māttāl patiṉṉaṟu kalaṉe tūṇiyākavanpāṭṭam aḷakkavum ippaṭi ivaṉ makkaḷmakkaḷ kuṭiniṅkā ⌈tevatāṉamāka aṉupovittu varuvāṉākavum aruḷāl āticaṇ ⌈ṭeśvara śrīkaraṇattāṉ eḻuttu ■

maṅkalattellaikku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai appaikkuṉ ṟuṭpaṭa vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai kecieri uṭpaṭak kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai īkaikkup pona peruvaḻikku teṟkum innāṟpāl ellaikkum uṭpaṭṭa nilam kāṟkoḷāyk svasti śrī ■ tirumaka ṇilaviya ceṅkol ventaṉ muṉnoṉ ceṉaipiṉnatākki iraṭṭapāṭi eḻaraiyilakkamuṅ koṇṭu perāṟṟaṅkaraikoppattu pūvamarceyta āhavamallaṉai añcuvit tavaṉ āṉaiyuṅ kutiraiyum peṇṭir paṇṭāramum vibhavamum aṭaṅkaluṅ koṇṭu vijaiyābhiṣekam paṇṇi virasiṁhāsanattu viṟṟirun=taruḷina kopparakecaripanmarāna uṭaiyār śrīrājendradevaṟku yāṇṭu añcāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuk kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattuk kaḷattūrnāṭṭut taṉkūṟṟut tevatāṉat tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamāṉaulakaḷantacoḻapurattu śrīmulasthāṉamuṭaiya mahādevarkku cempūrkkoṭṭattu paṭṭiṉanāṭṭuk koṭuvūrppaḷḷi kaṇṭaṉ cāttanāṉa rājentracempūrnāṭuṭaiyāṉvaitta tirununtāviḷak koṉṟu itaṉukku vaitta āṭutoṇṇūṟu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■
śvasti śrī ■ viramme tuṇaiyākavu n=tiyākame yaṇiyākavuñ ceṅko loccik karuṅkali kaṭintu teṉnaṉai talaikoṇṭu ceraṉai tiṟaikoṇṭu ciṅkaḷatecam aṭippaṭuttu veṅkaḷat tākavamallaṉai aimmaṭi meṉkaṇṭu veṅkaināṭu mīṭṭu tanṉuṭan piṟanta muṉnavar viratamuṭittu tan kaḻalaṭainta manṉavaṟku kiṭāram eṟintu kuṭuttaruḷi van=taṭipaṇinta vicaiātittarkku maṇṭalamaruḷa tanṉaṭi yaṭaintaruḷukiṟa vikkiramātittaṉai eṇṭicai nikaḻak kaṇṭikai kaṭṭi iraṭṭapāṭi eḻarai ilakkamum eṟintu kuṭuttaruḷi vijaiyasiṁhāsanattu ulakumuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya kovirācakecarivanmarāna śakravartthikaḷ śrīvirarājentradevaṟku yāṇṭu 7 āvatu veṟikuṟitta kaḷan=tanṉil porkkaḷattu puṟaṅkoṇṭu iraṭṭakoṉai puraṭṭaṭakki ikal virarājentraṉnilaṅkoṇṭu potunikki āḻkiṉṟa jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattu kaḷattūrnāṭṭu taṉkūṟṟu tevatānat tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu śrīmūlastānamuṭaiya mahātevaṟku cempūrkkoṭṭattu koṭuvūrpaḷḷi utaiyantiṭṭaiyār ṉāṟpatteṇṇāyirat tirukkaḻukkuṉṟak kaṇṇappanvaitta tirunuṉtāviḷakku oṉṟu ■ itaṉukku vaitta āṭu toṇṇūṟu cantrātittavaṟ panmāhesvara rakṣai ■ meṟpaṭiyān utaiyan tiṭṭai iraṇṭāmvicai vaitta viḷakku muṉṟināl viṭṭa āṭu irunūṟṟu eḻupatu āka utaiyan tiṭṭai vaitta tirunundāviḷakku nāluivai can=tirātittavaṟ vaittana ■ ivai paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■meṟpaṭi vaitta tirunan=tāviḷak=ku 1 āka viḷak=ku añcu meṟpaṭiyān vaittaviḷakku 1 āka tirunan=tāviḷakku āṟu āṟukkum viṭṭa āṭu aiññūṟṟu nāṟpatu ■ ivai can=tirātittavarai celutta vaittana paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ tiruvikkiramacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu munṟāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuk kaḷattūrkoṭṭattuk kaḷattūrnāṭṭut tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiya mahā⌈devaṟku cempūrkkoṭṭattuk koṭuvūrkkuṭipaḷḷi tiruveṇkāṭṭikaḷaraṉ cāttaiyāṉa kurukularāyap peri araiyaṉeṉ vaitta tirunun=tāviḷakku oṉṟukku viṭṭa cāvāmuvā perāṭu toṇṇūṟu ■■ panmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti ■ śrīmanmahāmahamaṇḍalīśvaran hariariyairāyavipāṭaṉ pāṣaikkuttappūrāyarkaṇṭaṉ muvarāyarkaṇṭaṉśrīvīradevarāyauṭaiyaṟkuc cellāniṉṟa vikartivaruṣattu kāttikai mātam 2 10 ■ tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiyanāyina ...ku koṇṭalātaṉ .... tirumalaiyāḷuṭaiyār....... kuṭutta pacu 10 5 m. kku pacuvum ...... ma śrīmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ irācanārāyaṇaṉ campūrāyarkku yāṇṭu 3 āvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu kaḷattūrkoṭṭattu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu uṭaiyārtirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiyanāyaṉāār tiruṉantatāviḷakkukkum mallinātar āṉa campu irāyartaṉtaruḷiṉa pacu eṭṭumum immaṇṭalattu ceyyāril irukkum maṉṟāṭikaḷil tāḻikoṉkarikālacoḻakoṉ cūriyaṉeṉ ippacu eṭṭum kaikkoṇṭu tiruviḷakku kālumkaikaikkoṇṭu āṇṭu oṉṟukku celavu irācakecarināḻiyāl aḷakkum ney irunāḻiūriyum celva .............ivaṉ cammatittu ca
svasti śrī ■ pukaḻmātu viḷaṅka jayamātu virumpa nilamakaḷ nilava malarkaḷ puṇara urimaiyiṟciṟan=ta maṇimuṭi cūṭi mīnavar nilaikeṭa villavar kulaitara eṉaimaṉnava ririyaluṟ ṟiḻitara tikkaṉaittu n=taṉ cakkara naṭātti vīrasiṁhāsanattu avanimuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟirun=taruḷiya korājakecaripanmarāna cakkaravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevarkku yāṇṭu 2 10 3 āvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu āmurkkoṭṭattu kumiḻināṭṭu vānavaṉmāteviccaturvvetimaṅkalattu naṭuvil śrīrājendracoḻaviṇṇakarāḻvāṉ koyilil ūrkaḷellai ceppiyirun=ta ceppeṭṭu śāsanam tirukkaḻukkuṉṟam nāppālellaiyum pārkka puravuvaritiṇaikkaḷam cekkiḻār coṟpaṭi ivvūr sabhaikku camain=ta kārampiceṭṭu sarvvātittaṉu muppirālk kumārasvāmikramavittaṉum uṟuppuṭṭurk kovin=tapaṭṭaṉum kirāñci toraṇacūrakkiramavittaṉum kuravi kumārasvāmibhaṭṭaṉum tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu śrīmāheśvarak kaṇkāṇi naminan=ti aṭikaḷum pūjikkum nampi śivarudrapaṇṭitarum civabrāhmaṇaṉ dekṣiṇāmūrttipaṭṭaṉum panmāheśvarapaṭṭaṉum palaviḷakkupiḷḷaiyum tevarkaḷ cun=tarapiṭāraṉum veḷḷāḷaṉcaṭaiyūrkiḻavaṉ kayilāyam poṉnampalaṉum pāracivaṉ kulāvum vānavaṉmātevicaturvvetimaṅkalattu karaṇattāṉ piccaṉa kuḻaiñcāṉum kaṇkāṇi āka pārttapaṭi kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattu kaḷattūrnāṭṭut tevatānabrahmateyam uṇṇīṅkalāka piṭinaṭan=ta paṭi tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu teṉellai veyyāṟṟerit tāṉṟimarame uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu teṉellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe kiḻakku nokkiyum teṉkiḻakku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu pali iṭupāṟaiye yuṟṟu itaṉai valattiṭṭu ivellai tāṉkiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭakku nokkiyum vaṭakiḻakku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu iraṭṭaikkum iṉnaṭuvil āyilamarame uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu kiḻakku nokkiyum vaṭakiḻakku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu teṉkiḻmulaiyil viḷāmarame uṟṟu teṟkiṉṉum kiḻakkiṉnum imarattai valattiṭṭu ittirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu kiḻellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭakku nokkiyum vaṭameṟku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu puṟṟe uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭuivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭakku nokkic ceṉṟu vaḻikkaraip pāṟaiye uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu ivvellaitāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭakku nokkiyum vaṭameṟku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu ālamarame uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu ivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭakiḻakku nokkic ceṉṟu nāvalmarame uṟṟu itaṉai valattiṭṭuivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭakku nokkiyum vaṭakiḻakku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu iluppaimarame uṟṟu itaṉai valattiṭṭu ivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭameṟku nokkic cenṟu kallampāṟaiye yuṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu ivvellai tān kiṭan=tavāṟe vaṭameṟku nokkic cenṟu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu tevarmalaiyil vaṭakiḻmulaiyilpuṟṟe yuṟṟu itaṉai yiṭattiṭṭu meṟku nokkiyum vaṭameṟku nokkiyum cenṟu miḷakukunṟe uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu ivvellai tān kiṭantavāṟe meṟku nokkic cenṟu tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu vaṭavellaiyil pūttoṇṭankuḻi yeṉṟu perkūvappaṭuṅ kuḻiyai yuṟṟu itaṉai valattiṭṭu ivvellai tān kiṭan=tavāṟe meṟku nokkiccenṟu tiraḷpuḷiye yuṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu meṟku nokkic cenṟu tiraḷa kallai uṟṟu itaṉai iṭattiṭṭu meṟkunokkic cenṟu tirukkaḻukkunṟattu vaṭamelaimulaiyil pīlikkunṟenṟu perkūvappaṭum malaiyaṭiye uṟṟu vaṭakkinṉum kiḻakkinnum immalaiyai iṭattiṭṭu ivvellai tān kiṭan=tavāṟe meṟkunokkic cenṟu oḻukumalaiye uṟṟu vaṭakkiṉṉum immalai⌈yai yeṟi tirukkaḻukkunṟattu melellai tān kiṭan=tavāṟe immalai mukaṭe teṟku nokkic ceṉṟu immalai mukaṭe iḻin=tu teṟkunokkic ceṉṟu kumiḻaṅkuḻiyai valattiṭṭu teṟkunokkic ceṉṟu naraippākkattu vaṭavellaiyai yuṟṟu ivvellai tān kiṭan=ta vāṟe kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattu kaḷattūrnāṭṭu nāḻalūr melaiyeriya vaṭakaṭaiye uṟṟu kiḻakkunokkic cenṟu nāḻalūr piṭārikoyilai valattiṭṭu ivvellaitān kiṭantavāṟe kiḻakkunokkic cenṟu nāḻalūr mahādevar koyilai valattiṭṭu ivvellai tān kiṭan=tavāṟe kiḻakkunokkic cenṟu nāḻalūrka kiḻai eriyil teṟkaṭaiya kāṇi araikkāṇi nikki ivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe ivveriyil teṉkiḻakku nokki erikaraiyai yeṟi itaṉai teṉkiḻakku nokkiyum kiḻakku nokkiyuñ ceṉṟu periya paṭarmāve uṟṟu itaṉai valattiṭṭu ivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe nāḻalūr vaṭakiḻai vempe uṟṟu itaṉai valattiṭṭu teṟku nokkiyum teṉmeṟku nokkiyum ceṉṟu nāḻalūrk ki⌈ḻai ellai tāṉa kiṭan=tavāṟe tenmeṟku nokkiyum meṟkunokkiyuñ ceṉṟu karaṇappūṇṭiyin vaṭakīḻmulaiyiṟa pāṟaiyai uṟṟu ivvellai tāṉ kiṭan=tavāṟe itaṉai yiṭattiṭṭu kiḻakku nokkiyum teṉkiḻakku nokkiyum ceṉṟuveyyāṟṟeriyil tāṉṟimarame uṟṟatu ittevatāṉa brahmateyam nāṟpālellaiyum śrīvānavaṉmātevi eṟṟuvitta uṭaiyār śrīrājendracoḻadevar piṭi naṭappittu śāsanañ ceyvitta ceppeṭṭiṉpaṭi ivai maddhyasthan piccan kuḻain=tāṉ eḻuttu itu panmaheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ cakalapuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ avaniyāḷappiṟantār kopperuñciṅkatevarkku yāṇṭu 2 10 1 vatu kumpanāyaṟṟu pūrvvapakṣattu dvitiyaiyum canikkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa uttiraṭṭāti nāḷ jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattu taniyūr tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu uṭaiyār tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamu⌈ṭaiya nāyaṉārkkuk kaṇṇuṭaipperumāḷāṉa irājarājakkaṭaṅkoṇṭāāṟku pukkameyyār pāṇiyār makaḷār pañcanetivāṇarāna nilakaṅkarayaṟku pukka coḻiṅkanācciyār viṭṭa tirununtāviḷakku 1/2 ivviḷakku araiyil koṇṭār cittirameḻikkoṉ aṭaippil veṇmaṇil aruḷāḷakoṉ makaṉ perumāḷeṉ kaikkoṇṭa pacu 4 kku tirununtāviḷakku araikkāl aracapurantarakkoṉ aṭaippukku vaivaḻutūrt tāḻikkoṉ makaṉ tevaṉ uḷḷiṭṭār kaikkoṇṭa pacu nālukku viḷakku araikkāltirukkaḻukkuṉṟakkoṉ aṭaippil tevakkoṉ makaṉ kūttaneṉ koṇṭa pacu iraṇṭukku viḷakku mākāṇiyum ...... maṇiyantai tevar .. ṇṭakkoṉ .... ṅkaṉeṉ koṇṭa pacu iraṇṭukku viḷakku mākāṇiyum .......... llirukkum tevakkoṉ makaṉ cūriyakoṉ koṇṭa pacu nālukku viḷakku araikālum āka viḷakku arai itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ tribhuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīmaturaiyum īḻamuṅ karuvūrum pāṇṭiyaṉ muṭittalaiyuṅ koṇṭu vīrar abhiṣekamum vijayābhiṣekamum paṇṇiyaruḷiya tiripuvanaviratevarkku yāṇṭu 3 10 7 vatu tirumalaimel uṭaiyār tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiya nāyaṉārkoyil āticaṇḍeśvaratevarkaṉmikaḷukku puḻaṟkoṭṭattu maṇaliyi lirukkum maṉṟāṭik kuṭimakkaḷil caṅkarakkoṉum kecavakkonum kaṇṇakkoṉum immuvom piṭippāṭut tiṭṭukkuṭutta paricāvatupiḷḷaiyār viranāraciṅkatevar eṅkaḷperil kaṭaimaiyiḻintu tanta tirumukappaṭikku nāṅkaḷ kaṭavomāṉa tirununtāviḷakku mukkālukkuc cela virācakecariyāl āṇṭu oṉṟukku aḷakkum ney toṇṇūṟṟu nāḻikku nāṅkaḷ aḷanta ney muppatu nāḻi nikki ney aṟupatu nāḻiyum nāṅkaḷum eṅkaḷ vaṅkṣattārum cantirātittavarai celuttakkaṭavomākac cilālekai paṇṇikkuṭuttom immuvom ivai caṅkarakkoṉ tāḻikkoṉ eḻuttu ivai kecuvakkoṉ eḻuttu ivai kaṇṇakkoṉ eḻuttu ippaṭi aṟivukku kaṇṭaṉ māṅkiḻavaṉ centakoṉ eḻuttu ippaṭi aṟivukku kārikaikkuḷattuḻāṉ tiruvitimuniva reḻuttu ippaṭi aṟivukku kārikaikkuḷattuḻāṉ tiruppulivanamuṭaiyāṉ eḻuttu itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣe ■■■■
svasti śrī ■ kaṭal cūḻnta pārmātarum pūmātaruṅ kalaimātaru maṭal cūḻnta por mātaruñ cīrmātaru mamarntu vāḻa nāṟkaṭalcūḻ puviyeḻum pāṟkaṭalpoṟ pukaḻ parappa ātiyukamā .....tirumuṭi puṉaintaruḷi aṟucamaiyamu maimpūtamu neṟiyiṉiṉṟu pālippat teṉṉavaruñ ceralaruñ ciṅkaḷaru mutalāy maṉnavarkaḷ tiṟaicumantu vantīṇṭic cevippa ūḻi ūḻi oruceṅ ...taḷippac cempon virasiṁhāsanattu ulakuṭai mukkokkiḻānaṭikaḷoṭum vīṟṟiruntaruḷiya kopparakesaripaṟmarāna tribhuvanaccakravat=tikaḷ śrīrājādhirājadevaṟku yāṇṭu onpatāvatu jayaṅkoṇ ......ṭalattuk kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattu kaḷattūrnāṭṭut tirukkaḻukkunṟattu uṭaiyār tirukkaḻukkunṟamuṭaiyāṟku coḻamaṇṭalattu uyyakkoṇṭavaḷanāṭṭu amparnāṭṭu nākankuṭi nākan kuṭaiyān .....ṟṟampala muṭaiyānen iṉnāyanārkku nān vaitta tirunantāviḷakku oṉṟarai oṉṟaraikkum viṭṭa cāvāmuvāp perāṭu 100 3 10 5 nūṟṟumuppattaiñcum iṉṉāyanār tirunantāviḷakkukku ■
svasti śrī ■ tribhuvanaccakravat=ti koṉeriṉmaikoṇṭāṉ jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuk kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattut tirumaṇṭiyāṟṟut tirumaṇṭiyāṟuṭaiyār koyiṟ tevarkaṉmikkum śrīmāheśvara kkaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷukkum śrīkālattukku veṭṭikkum kāṭṭāḷukkum tirumaṭaviḷākattuk kuṭiiruppārait taṟiiṟai taṭṭārappāṭṭam uḷḷiṭṭu āyamākavum taṇṭivarukiṟa kācum nellum ikkoyiṟ tiruppaṇik kuṭalākap peṟavum kaṭavatākap peṟaveṇumeṉṟu villavarājaṉ namakkuc coṉṉamaikoṇṭu nimantañ celuttavum veṭṭikkum kāṭṭāḷukkum taṟiyiṟai taṭṭārappāṭṭam uḷḷiṭṭu āyamākavum taṇṭivarukiṟa kācum nelluṅ kaikkoṇṭu ikkoyiṟ tiruppaṇiceyyavum paṇṇuka eḻutiṉāṉ tirumantiraolai neṟiyuṭaiccoḻarāja ṉeḻuttu ivai toṇṭaimā ṉeḻuttu yāṇṭu muppattunālu nāḷ irunūṟṟu nāṟpatu itu paṉmāhecura rakṣai ■■■■
tribhuvanaccakravat=ti koṉeriṉmaikoṇṭāṉ jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu īkkāṭṭukkoṭṭat tūrāṉa maṭattup parikārarkaḷukkun taṅkaḷukkuk koṟṟukkum puṭavai mutalukkum maṭam aḻivucora veṇṭuvaṉavaiyiṟṟukku iṟuppatākap paraṇarayiṇāyūrile paṉṉiruveli nilam muppattunālāvatu pacāṉmutal antarāyam pāṭṭam uṭpaṭa maṭappuṟamceyyakkaṭavatākac collik kaṇakkilum iṭṭukkoḷḷakkaṭavārkaḷāka varikkuk kūṟuceyvārkaḷukkum coṉṉom innilam muppattunālāvatu pacāṉa mutal antarāyam pāṭṭam uṭpaṭa maṭappuṟa iṟaiyiliyākavum veṭṭi kāṭṭāḷ uḷḷiṭṭu oṭukkuṅ kācu maṭam aḻivupārttu ivai vāṇātirāja ṉeḻuttu ivai cetikularāja ṉeḻuttu ivai toṇṭaimā ṉeḻuttu ivai ciṅkarāja ṉeḻuttu yāṇṭu muppattunālu nāḷ irunūṟṟu nāṟpatu itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■■■■

svasti śrī ■ koṟcaṭaipaṉmarāṉa tribhuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ emmaṇṭalamum koṇṭaruḷiya cuntarapāṇṭiyatevaṟkku yāṇṭu 9 vatu vaikāci mātam iraṇṭān tiyati nāḷ tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattu uṭaiyār poṉiṭṭīcuramuṭaiyanāyaṉār koyilukku āticaṇṭecuratevarkaṉmamikaḷom ivūr uṭaiyār tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiya nāyaṉār koyilil pūcikkum civaruttirapaṇṭitarum civamuttipaṭṭarum taruṇentucekarapaṭṭarum tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiyāṉ paṭṭarum civajñāṉapaṇṭitarum cantirapūṣaṇapaṭṭarum ivvaṉaivarom upaiyattiṭṭuk kuṭutta paricāvatu uṭaiyār poṉiṭṭīcuramuṭaiyanāyaṉāraip pūcikkap pūcaipeṟṟukku nāṅkaḷ poṉkoṇṭu policaiyūṭṭukku nāyaṉār irācākkaḷ nāyaṉār mutalikaḷil māṭakkuḷakkiḻiṭattu maturaiyil kāmaṉ aracaṉāṉa atiyamāṉtevar pakkal nāṅkaḷ upaiyaṅkoṇṭu ivvāṇṭai vaiykāci mātam irupattu iruṇṭāntiyati mutal cantirātittavaraikkum nāḷ oṉṟukku arici nāḻiuri ivarici nāḻiurikkum ivarpakkalk koṇṭa paṇam 2 10 2 1/2 ippaṇam irupattu iraṇṭaraiyum kaikkoṇṭu ivarici nāḻiuriyum pūcaippeṟṟukkuk kaikkoṇṭu iṉṉāḷ mutal cantirātittavaraiyum pūcikkak kaṭavomākac cammatittu upaiyattiṭṭuk kuṭuttom ivvaṉaivaromivai civaruttirapaṇṭitasya ivai ........ ṭaiyāṉ paṭṭasya ippaṭikku ivai taruṇentupaṭṭasya ippaṭikku itu śrīmāheśvara rakṣai ■
śrī koṟcaṭaipaṉmarāṉa tiripuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrī emmaṇṭalamum koṇṭaruḷiya cuntarapāṇṭiyatevaṟku yāṇṭu 9 vatu vaikāci mātam irupattuiraṇṭān tiyati nāḷ uṭaiyār poṉiṭṭīcuramuṭaiyanāyaṉār koyilukku ātiśaṇḍeśvaradevarkaṉmikaḷom uṭaiyār tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiyanāyaṉār koyilil kāṇiuṭaiya nāṟpatteṭṭu vaṭṭattil civappirāmaṇarom upaiyattiṭṭuk kuṭutta paricāvatu uṭaiyār poṉiṭṭīcuramuṭaiyanāyaṉārkku amutupaṭikku nāṅkaḷ poṉ ... ṭṭukku nāyaṉār [rājākkaḷ]nāyaṉār mutalikaḷil māṭakkuḷakkiḻ maturaiyil kāmaṉ aracaṉāṉa atiyamāṉtevar pakkal nāṅkaḷ upaiyaṅ koṇṭa ivvāṇṭai vaikāci mātam irupattu iraṇṭāntiyati mutal caṉtirātittavaraikkum nāḷ oṉṟukku nāṉāḻiyuri arici cipali ... le amutupaṭikku aḷantu amutu ākki amutu ceytaruḷappaṇṇi eṅkaḷ tirupparicārappeṟṟukku uṭavākac coṟu koḷḷa ivvarici nāṉāḻi urikkum ivarpakkal kaikkoṇṭa paṇam 6 10 7 1/2 ippaṇam aṟupatteḻaraiyum kaikkoṇṭu ivarici nāṉāḻi uriyum ikkoyilil aḷantu amutu ceytu aruḷappaṇṇi eṅkaḷ tirupparicārappeṟṟukku uṭalākak kaikkoḷḷak kaṭavomākac cammatittu upayattiṭṭuk kuṭuttom ikkoyil nāṟpattu eṭṭu vaṭṭamuṭaiya civappirāmaṇarom ivai kālakālapaṭṭaṉ eḻuttu ivai tirukkāḷattipaṭṭaṉ eḻuttu ivai uruttirapaṭṭaṉ eḻuttu ivai tirukkaḻukkuṉṟapaṭṭaṉ eḻuttu ivai āṇṭāḷpaṭṭaṉ eḻuttu ivai arutaṇappiḷḷai eḻuttu ivai poṉṉampalakkūttaṉ eḻuttu ivai taruṇentucekarapaṭṭaṉ tirukkāḷatti uṭaiyāṉ eḻuttu ivai tirukkaḻukkuṉṟamuṭaiyāṉ eḻuttu ivai tirucciṟṟampalapaṭṭaṉ eḻuttu ivai nāṟppatteṇṇāyiranampi eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai śrīmāheśvararakṣai ■

naṇṇaṟkarumuraṇ maṇṇaikkaṭakamum porukaṭa liḻattaraicātamuṭiyu māṅkavan ṟeviyar oṅkeḻilmuṭiyu munnavarpakkaṟ tennavaṟavaiytta cun=taramuṭiyu min=tira nāramu tenṟicai īḻamaṇṭala muḻutum eṟipaṭaika keraḷar muṟaimaiyiṟ cūṭuṅ kulatanamākiya palarpukaḻ muṭiyumceṅkatir mālaiyuñ caṅkatir velaittol peruṅkāvaṟ pala paḻantīvuñceruviṟ cinavi lirupattorukā laraicukaḷai kaṭṭa pācurāman mevaruñ cān=timaṟṟivaraṇ karuti iruttiya cempoṟ ṟiruttaku muṭiyum payaṅkoṭu paḻimika mucagkiyil mutukiṭṭoḷitta cayaciṅkan aḷapperum pukaḻoṭu piṭiyil ilaṭṭa pāṭi eḻaraiilakkamu navaneti kulapperumalaikaḷum vikkiramavirar cakkarakoṭṭamu mutirvaṭavalla maturamaṇṭalamuṅ kāmiṭaivaḷa nāmaṇaiykkoṇaiyum veñcina virar pañcappaḷḷiyum pācaṭaip paḻan mācuṇitecamum ayartivaṇkirtti ayātinakaravaiyil ■■ svasti śrī ■ tiripuvaṉaccakkaravartti koṉerimeṉkoṇṭāṉ uyyakkoṇṭārvaḷanāṭṭup pāmpūrnāṭṭu uṭaiyār tirunākiśvaramuṭaiyār koyiṟ tevarkaṉmikkum śrīmāheśvarakkaṇkāṇi ceyvārkkum śrīkāriyañceyvāṉukkum aṭukkaḷaippeṇṭukaḷil muppu uyyavantāḷ irājaviccātiri ittevar tiruviḻā veḻuntaruḷum nāṭkaḷil kāveriyil tirttam prasātikkaveḻuntaruḷun tiruvitiyun tiruttoppumāka ivaḷ iṉṉāṭṭuc cuṅkattavuttacoḻanallūril naṟaiyūrkiḻavaṉ araiyaṉ nacciṉāṟkiṉiyāṉ tillaiyampalamuventaveḷāṉum piccatevaṉ kuṉikkumapirāṉum pakkal vilaikoṇṭa pramāṇappaṭiyum brahmadeśam tirukkuṭamukkil piṭākai viracoḻanallūrilum coḻakaṅka ......... marāmanallūrilum virutarājapayaṅkaranallūrilum ivvūrroṭum tevatāṉa iṟaiyili māṟik kūṭiṉa kiḻānanaṭimaṅkalattilum vāṇakulaviḷakkamaṅkalattilum uṭaiyār irājarājiśvaramuṭaiyār tevatāṉa iṟaiyili ...... tu māṭilaṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ nakkkaṉāṉa poṉmentacoḻappiramamārāyaṉperil āttirayaṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉṉāṉa neṟiuṭaiccoḻappiramamārāyaṉum pāratāya ....... .āṇṭaṉum viyākkirapātaṉ appiramekaṉ karuṇākaraṉum ivaṉai mutukaṇṇākavuṭaiya ivaṉ peraṉ cokkaṉ ārāvamutu.... pperumāṉum kevutamaṉ kaṇṇaṉ kāraṇaṉum māṭilaṉ māṟaṉ śrīkṛṣṇapaṭṭasarvvakratuvāyaveyāciyārum vaṭukaṉ mātevapaṭṭaṉum kāraṇa ... agnicittaṉum civatevaṉ cemaṉum vighneśvaraṉ pāṇṭaṉun tāḻai nārāyaṇaṉum māṟaṉ cāttapaṭṭa agnicit=taṉum māṟaṉ viṉāyakatevaṉum pālāṣriyaṉ parameṣṭi śrīkṛṣṇapaṭṭaṉum iraṇiyakeṟppaṉ tāmotaraṉum cakrapāṇi kecavaṉum kevutamaṉ jātavetaṉai mutukaṇṇākavuṭaiya ivaṉ tampi kāmakkāṇi mātevaṉum mokiliyaṉ tiruvaṭikaḷ cūriyaṉum kāmakkāṇi iḷaiyacirāmaṉ vaṭukaṉum cirāmaṉ caṅkaraṉum tiraṅkuṭaiyāṉ umaiyaṉ tiruvuḷḷaṉum pakkal vilaikoṇṭa pramāṇappaṭiyum kavuṇiyaṉ yogeśvaraṉ vāsutevapaṭṭaṉum pūṇṭiyuṭaiyāṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉumuṭaṉ parivarttaṉai paṇṇiṉa nilattukku ivarkaḷ eḻuttiṭṭa tiṭṭuppaṭiyuñ cuṅkattavuttacoḻanallūrilum ivvūṟ piṟinta kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ paṉṟimaṅkalattilum naṟaiyūrkiḻavaṉ nacciṉāṟkiṉiyāṉ tillaiampalamuventaveḷāṉum paṉṟimaṅkalamuṭaiyāṉ poṉṉampalakkūttaṉum ciṅkaḷatevaṉum naccināṟkiṉiyāṉum maṭappuṟakkuṭaiyāṉ periyāṉum ikkoyil āticaṇṭeśvaratevar pātattu nirvārttuk kuṭutta nilattukku ivarkaḷ eḻuttiṭṭa pramāṇappaṭi yinnilamāy ........ tukku ūrkaṇakkut tirukkuṭantaiyuṭaiyāṉ eḻuttiṭṭa kaṇakkuppaṭi brahmadeyam tirukkuṭamukkil nirnila maraiye yiraṇṭumā varaikkāṇiyum puṉcey nilam mummā varaiyeyaraikkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻmukkālum āka nilam mukkāle mukkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻmukkālum uḷḷaṉa vaḷakkak kuṟainta nilattopāti nilaṅ kāṇi yaraikkāṇik kiḻmukkāṇik kiḻmukkāle orumā mukkāṇi yaraikkāṇiyum cuṅkattavutta kulottuṅkacoḻadevarkkup patiṉāṟāva taḷakkak kuṟainta nilatto ......... ṇi muntirikaik kiḻkkāṇi araikkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻeṭṭumāk kāṇi araikkāṇi muntirikaiyum āka nilam mukkāle mākāṇi yaraikkāṇik kiḻmukkāle mākāṇi yaraikkāṇik kiḻ ..... la kāṇimuntirikaiyum cuṅkantavuttacoḻanallūṟ ....... nilam nālumā ..... raikkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻ ....... kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ paṉṟimaṅkalattu nila morumāviṉ kiḻmukkāle orumāvum ........ ṟa orumā mukkāṇi araikkāṇik kiḻmukkāle mākāṇi yaraikkāṇik kiḻmukkāle kāṇi muntirikaiyum paṇṭuṭaiyārum paḻamperum uṭaiyār rājarājiśvaramuṭaiyār tevatāṉa iṟaiyili .... lattu niṉṟa .... tteva ... tevatāṉaiṟaiyiliyāy svasti śrī ■ tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīrājarājadevarkku yāṇṭu irupattiraṇṭāvatiṉ etirāmāṇṭu miṉṉāyaṟṟu aparapakṣattu . ye ..... veḷḷikkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa aviṭṭattu nāḷ cuttavallivaḷanāṭṭut taṉiyūr śrīrājādhirājaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu uṭaiyār rājādhirājiśvaramuṭaiyār koyilil iruntu iṉṉāṭṭup pāmpuṇikkūṟṟattu akaram tiruñāṉacampantaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu sabhaiyārum mahāsabhaiyārum jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻapperiḷamaināṭṭum irājādhirājapperiḷamaināṭṭum nālāyirap periḷamaināṭṭum āḷappiṟantāṉperiḷamaināṭṭum gaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻapperiḷamaināṭṭavarroṭum kūṭa iruntu vyavastai paṇṇiṉapaṭi ceṉṉirveṭṭi ceyyummiṭattu āḷākacceyyam tirumukattevai ceyyummiṭattu kāveri āṟṟaṅkaraikaraikkuk kuṭippaṟṟāṉa nilattāl kollaṟai ceyyakkaṭavarkaḷākavum nikki varum tirumukattevaikku āḷāy vantatu ūṇopāti ceyyakaṭavarkaḷākavum peruṅkuṭikaḷperāl kaṭamaikku veḷḷāḻaraic ciṟaipiṭittal ivarkaḷ akaṅkaḷil oṭukkutal ceyyakkaṭavatallātākavum parampil nelluṅ kācum veḷḷāḷar pakkal niyeraka meḻuti koḷḷakkaṭavatallātākavum ciṟumuṟi kācu iṭakkaṭavārallavākavum sabhāviniyokam varikkoḷḷummiṭattu maṭakku oru māvukku kār nāṟpatum pacāṉam eṇpapatum varikkoṇṭu iṟukkakkaṭavomākavum kūṭa viniyokattukku ulakuṭaiyaperumāḷ prasādamñceytaruḷi niṉaippiṭṭapaṭi iṟukkakkaṭavomākavum itukku melppaṭa celavaḻiya veṇṭittuṇṭākil mahāsabhāniyokam eḻuti nilam .. ppaṭiyum kuṟailaṟa eḻuttiṭuvittukkoṇṭu celavaḻippatākavum mutalikaḷpakkalap pukku brāhmaṇarātal veḷḷāḻar ātalk kaṇakkar ātal ūṟkkeṭu nāṭṭukeṭu poṟkeṭu conṉār uṇṭākil kirāmatturokikaḷum nāṭṭutturokikaḷumāy ivarkaḷ paṭṭateṇṭam paṭakkaṭavakaṭavarkaḷākavum ippaṭi sammatittu mahāsabhāvyavasthai paṇṇi uṭaiyār śrīkaiyilāsamuṭaiyarrāṉa irājādhirājīśvaramuṭaiyār koyililuma vaṇṭuvarāpati maṉṉaṉār koyililum kalveṭṭa conṉom ippaṭi peruṅkuṟipperumakkaḷ tiruviḷḷamāka itu eḻutinen ivvūrūrkkaṇakku cekaluṭaiyāṉ tanmapiriyan eḻuttu kaṇakku kiḻaiyiluṭaiyāṉ eḻuttu ■

svasti śrī ■ ■ tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīrājarājadevarkku yāṇṭu irupattiraṇṭāvatiṉ etirāmāṇṭu miṉannāyaṟṟu aparapakṣattu navamiyum tiṅkaḷkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa pūrāṭattu nāḷ cuttavallivaḷanāṭṭut taṉiyūr śrīrājādhirājaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu uṭaiyār śrīkayilāsamuṭaiyārāṉa rājādhirājiśvaramuṭaiyār koyilile sabhaiyārum mahāsabhaiyārum jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻapperiḷamaināṭṭum rājādhirājapperiḷamaināṭṭum nālāyirapperiḷamaināṭṭum āḷappiṟantāṉperiḷamaināṭṭum gaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻapperiḷamaināṭṭumnāṭṭavaroṭum kūṭa iruntuvyavasthai paṇṇiṉapaṭi nammūr parappile kācum nellum ākap palavakai vantapaṭi svasti śrī ■ kovicaiyakampavikkiramavarmmarkku yāṇṭu eṭṭāvatu meṟkūrnāṭṭu atiaraiyamaṅkalattu arayantaipramāṇiyeṉ nāṉ uttaramerucaturvvetimaṅkalattuvāmanacceri eṭuppitta maṇṭapattu mahāviṣṇukkaḷ iruntaperumāṉaṭikaḷukku nāṉ arccanābhogamākak kuṭutta nilam maticūtaṉaccerik koṟuttalaik koṇṭayakramavittarpakkal ūriṉ teṟku parameśvaravatiyiṉ meṟku oṉpatāṅ kaṇṇāṟṟu mutaṟ catukkattu viṟṟukkoṇṭuṭaiya pāṭakam iraṇṭiṉāṟ kuḻi nāṉūṟṟeṇpatu kuḻiyum iccatukkatte tirunāraṇaccerik kārampicceṭṭuc civatāmotiraccaturvvetiyā ruḷḷiṭṭārpakkal viṟṟukkoṇṭuṭaiya pāṭakam oṉṟiṉāl irunūṟṟunāṟpatu kuḻiyum iccatukkatte vāmaṉacceric ciṟupuḷḷuvaṉ tomaṇiccaturvvetiyār makaṉ kecuvakravittaṉpakkal viṟṟukkoṇṭuṭaiya pāṭakam oṉṟiṉāl irunūṟṟunāṟpatu kuḻiyumāka nālu pāṭakattālumākat toḷḷāyirattaṟupatu kuḻiyum ivvūr śrīgovarddhaṉattu vaikhānasan śrīdharabhaṭṭaṉ makaṉ tāmotirapaṭṭaṉ pūrvvāhṇat toru tiruvamirtum nāyaṟupāṭu oruviḷakku miṭṭut tevarmuṉpu pala kaṇiyu maḻivu nīkkit tevaraiyum putukka śrīgovarddhaṉattu vaikhānasa nātrayaṉputukka veṇṭu nāḷ putukki ipparicu ārādhittu uṇpāṉāka udakatāraiyāl peṟṟuṭaiya tāmotirapaṭṭaṉuṭaiya puttirapeḷatrādikaḷukke urittāka uṇṇak kuṭutteṉ meṟcollappaṭṭa piramāṇiyeṉ uttarameruccatturvvetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyo meḻuttu ipiramāṇi kuṭut=ta tevadānattukku vaikhānasan śrīdharabhaṭṭaṉ makaṉ tāmotirabhaṭṭaṉ pakkal epperppaṭṭa iṟaikkum poṉ aṟakkoṇṭu iṟaiyiliyāka paṇittuk kuṭuttom mahāsabhaiyom sabhai paṇippa eḻutineṉ śrīpuruṣa ācāryyaneṉ ■■
svasti śrī ■ kovicaiyakampavikkiramaparumarkku yāṇṭu eṭṭāvatu uttaramerucaturvvetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyom eḻuttu emmūr śrīkovarddhaṉattu māhāviṣṇukkaḷukku arccanābhogamāka kuṭutta bhūmi emmūr malliyaṉ kārāṇai madhyamamāyk kiṭanta bhūmiyil araiyar taḷikku kuṭutta bhūmiyiṉ teṟku malliyaṉa kārāṇai erikaraiyiṉ kiḻakku kuḻivantavāṟṟāl āyirattirunūṟu kuḻiyum śrīgovarddhanattu mahāviṣṇukkaḷukku arccanābhogamāka kuṭuttomivvarccanābhoga marccittukkoṇ ṭuṇpānāka emmūr vaikhānasan śrīdharabhaṭṭan makaṉ tāmotirabhaṭṭanukku putrapautrikam upāsit tuṇṇauṭaiyanāka kuṭuttom ivvāyirattirunūṟu kuḻiyum iṟaiyiliyākap paṇittu kuṭuttom śrīgovarddhaṉattu nantāvaṉamumtāmotirapaṭṭane pūmara muḷḷiṭṭa payaṉmaramum iṭṭukkoṇṭu arccit tuṇpānāka kuṭuttom uttaramerucaturvvetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyomsabhaiyār paṇippa eḻutinen śrīpuruṣaācāriryyanen ■

svasti śrīḥ ■ tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ koṉerimelkoṇṭāṉ koṅkāṉa vīracoḻamaṇṭalattu vaṭapūvāṇiyanāṭṭu tāramaṅkalattil nalluṭaiyappar vaitta akaram śrīlakṣmaṇaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu bhaṭṭarkaḷukku ivvūril kāraikuḷattāl nirpāyum nilaṅkaḷ uḷḷavaiyum ceyaperumāḷeriyālum perumārkāmiṇṭaṉeriyāl nirpāyum kañcumalaināyaṉāyaṉār tevatāṉamāṉa erikku meṟkku uḷḷa nilamum kaṇṇantai eriyāl nīrpāyum taṇṇāyakkaṉerikku vaṭakkuḷḷa nilamum kiḻaippoykaraiyāl nirpāyum nilamum innāṭṭu kaḷakkuḷattil nāṉkellai yuḻppaṭṭa naṉcai puṉcai nattam ūruṇi uḻpaṭṭa ivaiyum cemappaḷḷieri uḻpaṭṭa kuḷaṅkaḷāl nirpāyum nilamuḷḷa ivaiyum kārimaṅkalattil taṅkaḷ kuṭiyiruppu nattamāṉa vāstuvum vāstuśeṣamum āṟāvatu āṭimāta mutal taṅkaḷukku mutalaṭaṅka bhūdāṉa iṟaiyiliyāka tantatu iṉṉilaṅkaḷāl varum nelkaṭamai kācukaṭa.....āyam pañcupīli cantuvikkirakam vācalviṉayokam kāṇikkai kāttikaippaccai āṭippūrappaccai piḷḷaiyārnoṉputtevai āṉaiccālai kutiraippanti karuāḻttāḻvu taccuttāḻvu taṟiiṟai cekkiṟai taṭṭolitaṭṭārppāṭṭam pācippāṭṭam oḻukku nir miṉpāṭṭam toloṭṭu ervari iṉavari vācalvari āḷvari nallerutu nalppacu kāṇam uḷppaṭṭa ivaiyum variyilār kaṇakkilum kaḻikkumpaṭi colliviṭṭom iṉṉāḷmutal tāṅkaḷ kaikkoṇṭu kārum pacāṉamum orupūvum maṟuvum vampuṅ ka⌈ṭaiypūvum kamukum teṅku vāḻai koḻuntu mañcaḷ iñci karuṇai karumpu ceṅkaḻunīr uṭpaṭṭa vāṉpayirum māp palā iluppai puḷi uḻppaṭṭa palamaraṅkaḷum pullu varaku tiṉai cāmai iṟuṅku āvaṇakkup parutti vaḻutilai pūcaṇi eḷḷuk koḷḷu payaṟu avarai tuvarai uḻppaṭṭa puṉpayirum tāṅkaḷ cetum ceyvittumṅ koḷḷuvārākac colliviṭṭomippaṭikku ivvolai piṭipāṭāka koṇṭu atikārakaṇakkilum nāṭṭukkaṇakkilum kaḻippittu kallilum cempilum veṭṭivittukkoṇṭu candrādityavatc cella aṉupavittuppotuka ivai tuñcalūruṭaiyāṉ eḻuttu iyāṇṭu āṟāvatu nāḷ muppattunālu ■ tulyam ivai pallavarāyar eḻuttu ■

bhaṭṭarkaḷukku yippaṭi kuṭutta kuḷam iṉṉāḷmutal kaikkoṇṭu uṭaikuḷaṅkaḷum aṭaittu kāṭu veṭṭi tirutti tāṉ veṇṭu maṉaittup payirkaḷum ceytukoṇṭu candrādityavarai cella kallilum cempilum veṭṭi aṉupavikkakaṭavarkaḷākavum itu ivarkaḷukku dānādhamanavikrayaṅkaḷukkum urittāvutākavum itu ivarkaḷukku sarvvaāmānnya iṟaiyiliyāvatākavum ippaṭi cammatittu iddharmmadānapramāṇam paṇṇikkuṭuttom śrīlakṣmaṇaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu bhaṭṭarkaḷukku pūvāṇiyanāṭṭu nāṭṭavarom ■ippaṭikku ivai amarakuṉṟiyil mutalikaḷil kaṭuntarkkamutaliyār eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai tāramaṅkalattu mutalikaḷil āṉaiyār eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai cemmaṇikūṭal mutalikaḷil āḷappiṟantār mutaliyār eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai kaṇapatinallūr mutalikaḷil piḷḷaiyappaṉ eḻuttuippaṭikku ivai ceṭṭimāṅkuṟicciyil mutalikaḷil iḷamāṇṭai cokkaṉāyaṉ cuvaṭaṉceyyāṉ kuṉṟakāmuṇṭaṉ eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai veḷḷaṟaipaḷḷiyil mutalikaḷil cākāṭaṉ iḷamaṉ perumāḷkkāmuṇṭaṉ kaimmāṭṭāṅkāṉamaikku tiruveḷḷaṟaiyuṭaiyāṉ paṅkayaccelviyāṉa ulakaṉ eḻuttu ■
svasti śrī ■ koṟcaṭapaṉmarāṉa tribhuvaṉaccakravat=tikaḷ śrīcuntarapāṇṭiyatevarkku yāṇṭu patiṉmuṉṟāvatu siṁhanāyaṟṟu pūrvvapakṣattu trayodaśiyum tiṅkaḷkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa uttirāṭattu nāḷ koṅkāṉa vīracoḻamaṇṭalattu vaṭapūvāṇiyanāṭṭutāramaṅkalattu mutalikaḷil kaṭuntarkkamutaliyum cāttarmutali uṭaiyappaṉum cūriyatevar periyamutaliyum āṉaikkuṭṭi cilampāṇṭaiyum uṭaiyappaṉ āṉaiyārum piḷḷaimutaliyār mutaliyum ciṟuuṭaiyāṉ mutaliyum melppaṭi iḷamāṇṭaiyum ivaṉaivom ivvūr nīruṇi iḷaiyāṉ nalluṭaiyappar taṅkaḷ mutaliyārperāl vaikkiṟa akarappaṭṭarkaḷukku nāṅkaḷ udakapūrvvadharmmadānapramāṇam paṇṇikkuṭutta paricāvatu ivvūr kāraikuḷam uṭaikuḷamāyp pāḻekiṭakkiṟa kuḷam utaippukku muṉpe maṇa loḻukki kuḷamum aṭaittu ikkuḷattāl nir kāṭṭikoḷḷalām nilam tirutti iṉṉilamum ikkuḷattil nīrkovaiyum meṉokkiṉa maramum kiṇokkiṉa kiṇaṟum uṭppaṭa udakapūrvvadharmmadānamākak kuṭuttom ivvakarattil bhaṭṭarkaḷukku ivvaṉaivom ippaṭi kuṭutta innilam tāṉ veṇṭum aṉaittu payirkaḷum ceytu⌈koṇṭu veṇṭum phalavṛkṣaṅkaḷum vaittukkoṇṭu candrādityavat cella bhūdāna iṟaiyiliyāka aṉubhavikkakaṭavarkaḷākavum itu ivarkaḷukku dānādhamanavikrayaṅkaḷukku urittāvatākavum ippaṭi cammatittu udakapūrvvadharmmadānapramāṇam paṇṇikkuṭuttom ivvakarappaṭṭarkaḷukku ivvaṉaivomippaṭikku ivai ciṟuuṭaiyāṉmutali eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai piḷḷaimutaliyār makaṉ mutali eḻuttu ippaṭikku cāttarmutali uṭaiyappaṉ eḻuttu ippaṭikku ciṟuuṭaiyāṉ iḷamāṇṭai eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai āṉaiyār eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai āṉaikkuṭṭi cilampāṇṭai eḻuttu ippaṭikku i⌈vai kaṭuntarkka mutaliyār eḻuttu ippaṭikku ivai periyamutaliyār kaiymāṭṭāṅkāṉamaikku tāramaṅkalattu taṭṭāṉ tirukkaivel eḻuttu ■
svasti śrīḥ ■ koṟccaṭapaṉmarāṉa tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīcuntarapāṇṭiyatevarkku yāṇṭu 6■vatu āṟāvatu kaṟkaṭakanāyaṟṟupūrvvapakṣattu caturtthiyum tiṅkaṭkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa uttirattu nāḷ koṅkāṉa viracoḻamaṇṭalattu pūvāṇiyanāṭṭut tāramaṅkalattu mutalikaḷil niruṇi iḷaiyāṉ nallauṭaiyappaṉ taṅkaḷ pitākkaḷper vaitta iḷaiyaperumāḷ ka śrīlakṣmaṇaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu bhaṭṭarkaḷukku innāṭṭu nāṭṭavaromviṟṟukkuṭutta innāṭṭuk kārakkuḷam nāṉkellaik kuṭppaṭṭa puṉceyum nattamum cemappaḷḷieri uḷḷiṭṭa erikaḷāl nirpāyum nañcaiyum ivvūrppaṟṟil nīrnilai maranilai uḷḷiṭṭa samastaprāptikaḷum uṭppaṭṭavaiyiṟṟil tevatānam tiruviṭaiyāṭṭam uḷḷiṭṭa nilam niṅkalāka ivvūr viṟṟukkuṭuttom śrīlakṣmaṇaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu akarappaṭṭarkaḷukku innāṭṭu nāṭṭavarom ippaṭi viṟṟukkuṭutta ivvūrkku viṟṟukkuṭuttukoḷvatāna emmilicaintu vilaipporu ḷaṉṟāṭu naṟpaṇam 1000 5 100 ippaṇam āyirattaññūṟṟukkum vilaikkuṟa viṟṟup poru ḷuṟak kaikkoṇṭu udakapūrvvamāka viṟṟu vilaipramāṇam paṇṇikkuṭuttom ivvakarattu paṭṭarkaḷukku innāṭṭu nāṭṭavaromippaṭi viṟṟukkuṭutta ivvūr iṉṉāḷmutal ivarkaḷ kaiykkoṇṭu tāṅkaḷ veṇṭum aṉaittup payirum cey

svasti śrī ■ śrīmatkittikkumel koccaṭapaṉmarāṉa tribhuvaṉaccakravat=tikaḷ śrīcuntarapāṇṭiyatevarkku yāṇṭu 2 10 7■vatu taimātam mutaṟtiyati koṅkāṉa vīracoḻamaṇṭalattu vaṭapūvāṇiyanāṭṭut tāramaṅkalattu uṭaiyār iḷamīśvaramuṭaiya nāyaṉārkku innāṭuṭaiya tevar kaṇṭiyatevarum inta nāṭṭavarum perumāḷ tirumeṉikkum tevar kaṇṭiyatevar vāḷukkun toḷukkum naṉṟāka iṟṟaināḷil udakapūrvvamāka bhūdāna karadāna iṟaiyiliyākak kuṭutta ūrāvatu innāṭṭuk koṉakappaḷḷi naṉceyi puṉcey nāṟpālellaiyum meṉokkiṉa maraṅkaḷum kiṇokkiṉa kiṇaṟukaḷummaṟṟum ivvūril eppeṟpaṭṭa samastaprāptikaḷum uṭpaṭa iṟṟaināḷil candrātittavarai cellakkaṭavatāka utakapūṟuvamākak kuṭuttom uṭaiyār iḷamīśvaramuṭaiya ṉāyaṉārkku ikkaṇṭiyatevarum ippūvāṇiyanāṭṭavarum ■

svasti śrīḥ ■ grāmādāmunitaṇṭalāt prathamadiśyā hiṁgukagrāmataḥ pratyak·diśyatha sindhutoyanadadiśyāvegavatyāstataḥ ■ yāmyāyāndiśi bhūramācavaḷavagrāmāt paṭugrāmataḥ prādādāhavapuṁgavāya vijayī śrīvīracampeśvaraḥ ■ koccaṭakopapatmarāṉa tribhu vaṉaccakravattikaḷ śrīvikramapāṇḍyadevaṟku yāṇṭu eṭṭāvatu kaṉṉināyaṟṟu pūrvvapakṣattu tritiyaiyum veḷḷikkiḻamaiyum peṟṟa āyiliyattu nāḷ jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattup paṭuvūṟkoṭṭattup paṭuvūrāṉa vīracampanallūr kiḻpāṟkellai muṉikaḷ taṇṭalattār ellaikku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai vaḷavanallūrār ellaikku vaṭakkummelpāṟkellai peruṅkāyanallūrār ellaikku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai veḵkāvāṟṟukku teṟkum āka innāṟpāṟkellaikkum naṭuvuṭpaṭṭa nilattil iṟaiyili tevatāṉam tiruviṭaiyāṭṭam paḷḷiccantam muḷḷiṭṭanilaṅkaḷ nikki nikkiyuḷḷa naṉcey puṉcey nilattu kaṭamai āyam poṉvari kutiraivari pala kāṇikkai puṟakkalaṉai taṟiiṟai taṭṭārppāṭṭam cekkukkaṭamai iṉavari erimiṉpāṭṭam irunatuparimāṟuvārperiṟkaṭamai maṟṟum eppeṟpaṭṭa aṉaittuvarikaḷum inta toṇṭaimaṇṭalattut tāmaṟkoṭṭattut tāmarnāṭṭut tiruppati tiruppuṭkuḻi emperumāḷ vijayarāghavapperumāḷukku nām nammuṭaiya nakṣatramāṉa āyiliyattile tirtthamākak kaṇṭa āvaṇittirunāḷukku tirunāḷpaṭikkum nāṅ kaṇṭa viracampaṉsandhikku amutupaṭi kalaaricikkum itukku veṇṭum kaṟiviñcaṉaṅkaḷukkum tiruppavitrattukkumperiyatirumañcaṉattukkum veṇṭuvaṉa candrādittavaraikkum celvatākac cilālekaiyum tāmraśāsanamum paṇṇikkuṭutteṉ campukulottuṅkaṉ campuvarāyaṉviracampaṉeṉ ■ campaścampukulot=tuṁgassārvvabhaumassabhāpatiḥ ■ bhrātṛbhissaha rājyastho vibhātyācandratārakam ■

piṅkalavaruṣam vaikāci ṭṭa 2 10 5 ■ ikkoyilukku mutalmai peṟṟaper tiruccelvam ..ṇṭu kuṭuttapeṟku naṉceyil per oṉṟukku civitam aṭaitta kuḻi ṉūṟṟuaimpatum cantiṟātittavaraiyum sarvvamāṉṉiya■iṟaiyili āka naṭattikkoḷḷavum ■
ciṟapparuḷik koṟṟavaṉ makiḻnta koḷkaiyaṉāki meyttavattirkku veṇṭuvatiyāteṉa attavaṉuraippo ṉiṉṉakaṉṟalai ñālattuc ceyaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalantaṉṉiṟ payaṉpaṭucolaip palkuṉṟakkoṭṭattu veṇṭiyatu curakku meyūrnāṭṭup pūṇṭiyeṉpatu kāṇṭaku tirunakar ciyaṉ campumaṉ ṟiru.. ṟamāppoykālattuppurantuṭaṉ vantatu aṟaneṟivaḷara varuṇamakkeṉṉa maṟamalitāṉai maṉṉarmaṉṉaṉ ciṉavaraṉṟaṉakkuc cempoṟkoyi ṉivaṉtakavaruḷi niṉṟu nīṭuviḷaṅka vīravīraciṉālayameṉṟu taṉpeyar poṟittamaittup peruñciṟappiyaṟṟi muṉikaḷpūṇṭiyeṉ ṟiṉitiṉiṉaṭappa vellaitaḻuviya virumpeṭuṭpaṭa nallaṟan taḻaippa.. kamaittaṉaṉeaḵtāṉ ṟaṇinaka rakaṉpeya rellaiyāvatuṅ kaṇiyiluppaikkuk kāṇṭaku meṟku nerunaṟpākkattellai vaṭameṟkum porunaṟkuṉṟip puṉalyāṟṟiṉ vaṭakkuṅ kulāmalikuṇṭikaittuṟaikku vaṭakiḻakku milāṟaiyātittamaṅkalattellaikkey kiḻakku mirumpuṉaṟpoykai meyūrellai.. nta teṉkiḻakku mallaṟṟolcīrmaṟaiyo rātaiyellai nilattukkiyainta teṟku mivvātaṉūri lakaṉpeyarellaiyiṟ pīlimaṭuviṟkup piṟaṅku teṉmeṟku meṇṭicaimaruṅkiṉu miyaṉṟavellaiyiṟ kuṇṭikaikkallu nāṭṭik kaṇkavarkollai naṉṉilaṅ kuṟaiviṉṟi virin ... ṉellaimuṟṟu miṟaiyum variyu mantarāyamu māyamu mamañciyum vantaṉa piṟavumāṟṟi vaḷamalimāḷikai yeṭukkavu maṇikkulaikkamuku nāḷikeramu naṉkuṭaṉākkavuṅ karumpuñ cennelu moruṅkuṭaṉaṭavuñ campakan tamaṉakañ cāti ketakai vaṇkaḻunīruṭaṉ malarpala viyaṟṟavum .... ñ cekku mamaikkavumaruḷic cālaiyun tavamun tarumamun taḻaippac cempiluṅ kalliluñ ceytu taṉ puka ḻalarkatiraḷavuñ cella malartalaiyulakiṉ vāḻvamaittaṉaṉe ■
svasti ■ samastajagadādhāra somakulatilaka madhurāpurimādhavakeraḷavaṁśanirmmūlana laṅkādvīpaluṇṭanadvitīyarāma coḷakulaśailakuliśa karṇāṭarājavidrāvaṇa kāṭhakakarikūṭapākalavividharipudurggamarddana viragaṇḍagopālavipinadāvadahana kāñcīpuravarādhīśvara gaṇapatihariṇaśārddūla nellūrapuraviracitavirābhiṣeka praṇatarājapratiṣṭhāpaka maharājādhirāja parameśvara tirupuvaṉaccakkaravattikāḷ śrīsundarapāṇḍiyadevar kāñcīpurattu tiruvattiyūri ṇiṉṟṟaruḷiya aruḷāḷapperumāḷ kovilukku teṟkku namperāl nām vaitta cuntarapāṇḍiyaccaturvvedimaṅkalattupaṭṭarkaḷukku murukamaṅkalappaṟṟil śrīpuruṣamaṅkalam uḷḷūrum ivvūr piṭākaikaḷil paṭiyaṉpaṭṭum maṭuvuṅkaairaippaṭṭum uḻutamaṅkalam coḻaṉpaṭṭum kaḷaṉikaḷamum pirāypaṭṭum muṉṉakapaṭṭum muṉṉūṟṟuvaṉceriyum paṟayaṉceriyum ūṟavarkiḻavaṉpaṭṭum nantamuḻāṉpaṭṭum kāṭāṭuceriyum kaliccaṅkaliccaṅkaraipaṭṭum makiḻampūṇṭiyum iruṅkoḷanallūrum uñcipiḷḷaieṉtalum kalpūṇṭiyum kaliṅkaneṉtalum ākāṟum kūṟṟattaientalum tirumaṇiyum uḷpaṭa nilam munnūṟṟu irupat=te⌈ḻemukkāle iraṇṭṭumāvil palataḷitevatāṉam tiruvi
svasti śrī ■ kopparakecaripaṟmaṟkku yāṇṭu aiñcāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattup palakuṉṟakkoṭṭattu teṉṉāṟṟūrnāṭṭu ciyamaṅkalattu tirukkaṟṟaḷimahātevaṟkku śrīpāṇṭināṭṭu vecālippāṭi vaṭakarai kiḻkūrnāṭṭup pullāli veḷḷāḷaṉ kāḷi pūṇṭiyeṉ vaitta tirunun=tāviḷakku onṟukkum koṇṭu viṭṭa nilamāvatu perierip peruntūmpiṉ peruvākkāl kiḻmelppuṟṟampulattup perumaṇalipperuñceṟu eṭṭu māvum nan=ti muḻāṉtūmpil nan=timuḻāṉvāykkāliṉ teṉpāṟ kiṭan=ti viṭṭil kuṇṭil iraṇṭu māvum āka nilam pattu māvum ciyamaṅkalattūrāriṭaip poṉṉaṟa iṭṭu maṇṇaṟakkoṇṭu viṭṭeṉ innilattukkuc cilliṟai coṟumāṭum veṭṭi muṭṭaiāḷum ceññirramañciyum maṟṟum epperpaṭṭaṉa kāṭṭavum collavum peṟātomākavum innilattukku poṉ ṉaṟakkoṇṭu vilaiaṟa viṟṟu kuṭuttom ciyamaṅkalattūromey celuttuvippatāka poṉ ṉaṟakkoṇṭu maṇṇaṟa viṟṟom ciyamaṅkalattūrom itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai aṟamaṟavaṟkka itu kāttāṉ śrīpāta meṉ talaimeliṉa ■■■■

svasti śrī ■ tripuvaṉaccakravat=tikaḷ śrīvikramacoḻatevaṟku yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu palakuṉṟakkoṭṭattut teṉṉāṟṟūr nāṭṭuc cīyamaṅkalat tāḷuṭaiyār tūṇāṇṭārk=kuc ceṅkeṇi nālāyiravaṉ ammaiyappaṉāṉ rājendracoḻaccampuvarāyaṉeṉ tiruvarddhayāma ssandhikku amutupaṭi uḷḷiṭṭa aḻivukku ittevar tevatāṉam uḷḷur nilamum aruntoṭum ciṟupāṭikāval kaṇkāṇi māppatakku veṭṭi uḷḷiṭṭa cillāyaṅkaḷāl cerum nellu śrīpaṇṭārattile kūṭṭi tiruvarddhayāmapūjaiyu mamutupaṭiyuñ candrātit=tavarai cellumpaṭi kalveṭṭi viṭṭeṉ eṉ vaṁśat=ti likkaṭamai koḷvāṉ kaṅkaiyiṭai kumariyiṭai ceytār ceyta pāvaṅ koḷvār itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■ ■
pūmevuvaḷar tiruppoṉ mārvu puṇara nāmmevu kalaimakaḷ nalamperitu ciṟappa vicaiyamāmakaḷ velpuyat tiruppa vicaiyam celviyum meṇṭicai viḷaṅka nirupar vaṉ tiṟaiñca niṇilamaṭantaiyait tirumaṇampuṇarntu cīrvaḷar tarumam maṇimuṭi cūṭi mallaiñālattup palluyirkkellām ellaiyi liṉpa miyalviṉil leytu veṇkuṭai niḻaṟṟac ceṅko locci vāḻi pallūḻi yātu naṭappac cempoṉ viraśiṅndāśaṉattup puvaṉamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya kovirācakeśarivatmarāṉa tiripuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻatevarkku yāṇṭu muṉṟāvatu ceyaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu palakuṉṟakkoṭṭattut teṉnāṟṟūrnāṭṭuc ciyamaṅkalattu āḷuṭaiyārtanmiśvaramuṭaiyār koyilile campupurattirukkum paḷḷi celvaṉivvūrirukkum paḷḷi veṇāṭṭaraiyaṉaik kaippiḻaiyā leytu cettamaiyil nāṭṭavarum campuvarāyarum kūṭi iva ṉivveṇāṭṭaraiyaṉukkākac cāvaveṇṭām kaippiḻai pukun=tutu itukkut tūṇāṇṭār koyilile araiviḷakku vaikkaccolla araiviḷakkukku pacu patiṉā ṟuruvum poṟittu viśiyaṉ celvaṉeṉ candirātittavarai celvatā ..vvaṟam iṟaṅkāmaṟk kāttār ciripātam talai .. ṉa itu cirimā yecuvamār taṉmam ■
svasti śrī ■ tiruvāykkeḻvi muṉṉāka iruṅkoḷappāṇṭināṭṭu meṟkālnāṭṭup paruvūrkkūṟṟattu neṟkuppaiyāṉa tirumutukuṉṟattuk kāṇiuṭaiya tirumeṉikaḷil ciṟṟāmuruṭaiyār toṇṭartiyākapperumāḷ peṇṇākiya perumāḷ kāṅkeyarkku viśvāvasusaṁvatsarattuc cittiraimātamutal jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattup palakuṉṟakkoṭṭattut teṉṉāṟṟūrnāṭṭuc cīyamaṅkalattuāḷuṭaiyanāyaṉār tūṇāṇṭārkkut tiruvācalukku veṇṭum naṉmai ceytaitukku ikkoyiliṟ tirukkai oṭṭi tirumuṉ otukaiyum pallavaṉtiruvitiyil teṉciṟakil kiḻtalaiyiṟ cittirameḻimaṭamum kāṇiāṭciyākak kuṭuttom ivar nāḷ oṉṟukku patakku nellum āṇṭu oṉṟukku paṉṉiraṇṭu paṇamum nam parikarattār peṟumuriyāka peṟṟu candrātittavaraiyum naṭakkumpaṭi cilālikitam paṇṇikuṭuttom stānattārom itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■ pukaḻmātu viḷaṅka jayamātu virumpa nilamakaḷ nilava malarmakaḷ puṇara yurimaiyiṟ ciṟanta maṇimuṭi cūṭi miṉavar nilaikeṭa villavar kulaitara eṉai mannava ririyaluṟ ṟiḻitara tikkanaittun tan cakkaranaṭāttic cempon virasiṁhāsanat tavanimuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya kovirājakecaripanmarāna tribhuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu 3 10 1■āvatu malāṭākiya jaṉaṉātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattut tirukkovalūrt tiruviṭaikaḻiāḻvārkku rājentiracoḻavaḷanāṭṭuk kiḷiyūr malaiyamān nāṉūṟṟuvan attimallanāna rājentracoḻac cetiyarāyanen ivvāḻvārkkut tiruvattacāmaccan=ti onṟukku amutupaṭi arici nāṉāḻiyum kaṟiyamutu neyyamutu tayiramu taṭaikkāyamutum eṅkaḷ vaṁśa muḷḷatanaiyuñ celvatāka ivvāḻvār tiruviṭaiyāṭṭattil nāṅkaḷ koḷḷakkaṭava perumpāṭikāva luḷḷiṭṭa āyaṅkaḷ koḷḷāte viṭṭa ■ 2■li in=nila miruveliyuṅ kārum picānamuñ can=tirātittavaṟ cella viṭṭen kiḷiyūr malaiyamān nānūṟṟuva nattimallanāna rājentracoḻac cetiyarāyanen itukku viṭṭa nilamāvatu kiḻpāṟkellai comaṉ kiḻvarampukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai ciṟutūmpuvāykkālukku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai ivvāykkāliniṉṟum punniruṭṭikku poṉa vāykkālukku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai añcukuṭṭikkum tiruveṅkaṭattukkuṭṭimarutañcey vāykkālukkum teṟkum innāṉkellaiyilu mikutikkuṟai vuṭpaṭa nilam iraṇṭu veliyum viṭṭeṉ rājentracoḻac cetiyarāyaṉeṉ ittaṉmam śrīvayiṣṇavarakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ pūmevuvaḷar tiruppoṉmātu puṇara nāmevu kalaimakaḷ nalamperitu ciṟappa vicaiyamāmakaḷ velpuyat tiruppa vicaiyuñ celviyum meṇṭicai viḷaṅka nirupar van=tiṟaiñca niṇilamaṭaṉtaiyait tirumaṇam puṇarn=tu mallañālattup palluyiṟ kellām ellaiyi liṉpa miyalvini leyta veṇkuṭai niḻaṟkiḻc ceṅko locci vāḻi ūḻi āḻi naṭappac cempoṉvirasiṁhāsanattu avanimuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟirun=taruḷiya kopparakecaripatmarāṉa tribhuvanaccakravarttikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu 7■āvatu meṣanāyaṟṟu aparapakṣattu viyāḻakkiḻamaiyum saptamiyum peṟṟa uttirāṭattunāḷ malāṭākiya jaṉanātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattut tirukkovalūr brahmadeyam śrīmaturān=takaccaturvedimaṅkalattu tiruviṭaikaḻiyāḻvār amutuceytaruḷavum ittiruppalam vaḻinaṭai śrīvaiṣṇavarkku prasādikaikkum nilayuṉperiyuṭaiyārāṉa kulottuṅkacoḻac cetiyarāyaṉ viṇṇappattāl iṟaiyiḻicci iṟaiyilitevatānamāka viṭṭa nilam ivvūrk kiḻerippaṟṟil kiḻpāṟkellai kallaṅkāṭṭukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai ivvāḻvār tevatānam cetirāyaviḷākattukku vaṭakkum melpārkkellai erikkaraikku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai ittevar tevatāṉam kaṟkol tenvarappukkum itankiḻaip puḷiyañceṟu vaṭavarappiṟ periyakallukkut teṟkum āka innāṉkellaiyu ḷuṭpaṭṭa taṭi palaviṉāl nilam oruveli innilam oruveliyum ivvāḻvārkku iṟaiyili tevatāṉamākac can=tirātittavaṟ nittaniman=tañ celvatāka iccetiyarāyaraikkoṇṭu innilam viṭuvittāṉ kaḻumarutaṅkiḻāṉ mātavaṉ ulakaḷan=tāṉāṉa ulakaḷan=tacoḻa muven=taveḷāṉ ■
svasti śrī ■ pūmelarivaiyum poṟceyappāvaiyum temeviya tiruppuyaṅkaḷiṟ ṟiḷaippa vaṅkome lilaṅku koṭṭiyāṉaiyum yāṉu meṉ kaiyyil tulaṅku poṟppaṭaiyumey tuṇaiyeṉṟaruḷi palaṅkiḷar tārāvaracar tāmicai koḷḷa svasti śrī ■ coḻakeraḷadevaṟku yāṇṭu munṟāvatu milāṭāna janaṉātavaḷaṉāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu brahmadeyam tirukkovalūr tiruviṭaikaḻiāḻvārkkuivvūr paruṭaiyāruḷ bhāradvāji ūran vāsudevan tan=nuṭaiya mātā māṟi poṟkāḷinaṅkaikkāka vaitta tirunun=tāviḷak konṟukku vaitta cāvā muvā perāṭu toṇṇuṟṟāṟu ivvāṭu kaikkoṇṭu ivviḷakkuonṟum can=tirātittaval erikkakkaṭavom stānattu vaikā nasarom ■ ivvāṇṭey jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūr sabhaiyom vāṇakoppāṭiyāna marutān=takavaḷanāṭṭup peṇṇai vaṭakarai brahmadeyam maṇalūr paruṭaiyāruḷ kaucika aṇṇāvan tiruvikkiramanukku viṟṟukkuṭutta nilamāvatu ivvūr melvarappulattu kayaṟkāṇi taṭi iraṇṭināl karutteṭṭumāviluṅ kiḻakkaṭaiyak kāl nikki meṟkaṭaiya munṟu māvum viṟpataṟkku kiḻpāṟkellai ikkayaṟkāṇi kiḻakka⌈ṭaiya niṅkuṅ kāṟceykku meṟkum tenpāṟkellai ivvūr bhāradvāji nakkanārāyaṇan uḷḷiṭṭāruṭaiya kuṉṟinkiḻk kāṟceykku vaṭakkum melpārkkellai tiruviṭaikaḻiāḻvār tiruvamutupuṟattuk kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai vaidyapokattukku pāyn=ta vāykkālukkut teṟkkum innāṉkellaikkum uḷppaṭṭa innilam muṉṟumāvum 3 1/20 kuṭuttu iṉnilattu ... innilattukku vilaidravyamum iṟaidravyamum kaiyyile poruḷaṟakkoṇṭu innilam iṟai iḻicci viṟṟu vilaiyāvaṇam ceytukuṭuttomivvūr sabhaiyom aṇṇāvan tirivikkiramaṉukku innilam kayaṟkāṇiyil muṉṟu māvum tiruviṭaikaḻiāḻvārkkuk koṇṭu kuṭutteṉ aṇṇāvan tiruvikkiramaneṉ iṉnilam kaikkoṇṭu ceyyum niman=tamāvatu ayppacit tiruvoṇam tiruveṭṭai nāḷ tiruveṭṭaieḻun=taruḷippukun=tu ittiruvolakkattil amutuceyya appaamutukku arici kuṟuṇi nānāḻiyum ney yirunāḻiyum veḷḷikallāl nāṟpatin palac caṟkaraiyum koṇṭu nūṟu appaamutu camaittu ceyvippatākavum aṭaikkāyamutu nūṟum veṟṟilai āṟu paṟṟum koṇṭu amutuceyvittu ittiruvolakkattil tiruneṭun=tāṇṭakam viṇṇappam ceyvārkku oru kācu iṭuvatākavum innilam koṇṭu iniman=tam ceyyakkaṭavomstānattu vaikāsanarom ■
svasti śrī ■ coḻakeraḷatevarkku yāṇṭu muṉṟāvatu milāṭāna jananātavaḷanāṭṭṭu kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu brahmadeyam maturān=takaccaturvvetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyom tiruviṭaikaḻiaḻvārkkuviṟṟukkuṭutta nilamāvatu kayaṟkāṇi taṭi iraṇṭiṉāl nilam kāṟceyyum viṟṟukkuṭuttaṟk=ku kiḻpāṟkellai amutakuṭṭicceykku meṟkkum teṉpāṟkellai bhāradvāji nakkaṉ nārāyaṇaṉ uḷḷiṭṭār nilattukku vaṭakku melpāṟkellai tiruviṭaikaḻi āḻvār nilattukkey kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai kiḻakkunokki vajyavākkālukku teṟkku iṉnānkellaiyilum uḷpaṭṭa nilamtaṭi iraṇṭiṉāl karuttukkāl⌈ceyyum viṟṟukkuṭuttu iṉṉilattukkuk koḷḷauṭaiya vilaidravyamum iṟaidravyamum tiruviṭaikaḻi āḻvāriṭai aṟakkoṇṭu iṉṉilam iṟai iḻicci iṉṉilattukku sabhaiyome iṟaiyiṟuppatāka viṟṟu vilaiyāvaṇam ceytukuṭuttom tiruviṭaikaḻi aḻvārkku sabhaiyomiṉnilam kaikkoṇṭu anubhavittu nicatam uḻakkuney cendrādittavaṟ tirunan=nāviḷakku oṉṟum erikkakkaṭavo mistānattu vaikāsanarom itu śrīvaiyiṣṇava rakṣai hari ■

svasti śrī ■ tirumakaḷ polap perunilaccelviyu n=tanakke urimai pūṇṭamai manakkoḷak kān=taḷuṟcālai kalamaṟuttu veṅkaināṭum kaṅkapāṭiyum nuḷampapāṭiyu n=taṭiyaivaḻiyuṅ kuṭamalaināṭuṅ kollamuṅ kaliṅkamum eṇṭicai pukaḻtara īḻamaṇṭala muḻuvatum iraṭṭapāṭi eḻarai ilakkamu n=tiṇṭiṟal veṉṟit taṇṭāṟ koṇṭu tanṉeḻil vaḷar ūḻiuḷ ellā yāṇṭu n=toḻutakai viḷaṅkum yāṇṭe ceḻiyarait tecukoḷ śrīkovirājarājakecarivanmarāna śrīrājarājadevaṟkuyāṇṭu 2 10 3■āvatu milāṭāna jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu brahmadeyam attanamponnūrccaturvetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyiṭai vāṇakappāṭip peṇṇai vaṭakarai brahmadeyam maṇalūr paruṭaiyāruḷ kaucikan aṇṇāvantiruvikkiraman vilaikoṇṭa nilam viḷan=taikkolāl irunūṟṟaimpattāṟu kuḻi koṇṭatu orumāvāka vilaikoṇṭa nilam eḻumāvaraiyum koṇṭu vilaidravyamum iṟaidravyamuṅ kaiyile aṟakkoṇṭu iṟaiyiḻiccik kuṭuttomattanamponnūr sabhaiyom aṇṇāvan tiruvikkiramanukku in=nilattukku nir vilaikkūliyum collappeṟātomānom sabhaiyom brahmadeya n=tirukkovalūr tiruviṭaikaḻiāḻvārkku iṉṉilam eḻumāvaraiyum iṟaiyili vilaikoṇṭu kuṭutta nilam ittevar tevatānam ciñciliveliyoṭuṅ kiḻakkaṭaiya eḻumāvaraiyuṅ koṇṭu ellaikkal naṭṭukkuṭutten aṇṇāvaṉ tiruvikkiramaneṉ innilaṅ koṇṭu istānattu vaikānasarom ceyvitāna nivan=tam uttaramayanamum dekṣiṇa mayanamum tirumañcaṇam kaḻañce eḻumañcāṭiyum kaḻañce eḻumañcāṭiyum ponner iraṇṭu tirumañcaṇamuñ ceytu ipponnil tirumañcaṇamtoṟum eṇṇāḻikkālālk kalakkala arici amutuceyvittu neyyamutu irunāḻiyuṅ kaṟiamutu āṟumtayiramutu patakkum aṭaikkāyamutu nūṟum veṟṟilai nālu paṟṟum puḷiṅkaṟi amutukku puḷi aimpalamum caṟkkarai aimpalamum kaṭuku uḻakkum miḷaku āḻakkum kalacam nūṟṟeṭṭum snamanadravyaṅkaḷ aṉaiccum kalacattiṉ kiḻaṭṭu nellu 1■kalamumviṟakum āṟṟi nīrum ācāriyapūcaṉaiyum puṭavai nālum snamanattukku veṇṭuvana ellāṅ kuṟaivaṟuttu innilaṅ koṇṭu ceyyakkaṭavom stānattu vaikānasarom ■
svasti śrī ■ pukaḻmātu viḷaṅka jayamātu virumpa nilamakaḷ nilava malarmakaḷ puṇara urimaiyil ciṟan=ta maṇimuṭi cūṭi villavar nilaikeṭa minavar kulaitara ēnaimannavar iriyaluṟ ṟiḻitara tikkaṉaittu n=taṉc cakkara naṭātti vicaiyābhiṣekam paṇṇi virasiṁhāsanattu avanimuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟirun=taruḷiya cakravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu muppattiraṇṭāvatu milāṭākiya jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattut tirukkovalūrāṉa śrīmaturan=takaccaturvvetimaṅkalattut tiruviṭaikaḻiāḻvāṉ koyilil eḻun=taruḷina maṇavāḷāḻvāṉaiyum pirāṭṭiyaiyum jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu ūṟṟukkāṭṭukkoṭṭattu ciyapuranāṭṭu aḷakūr vijaiyanalluḻāṉ ciriḷaṅkopperiyaveḷāṉ viṇṇappañ ceytu amutuceytaruḷa niman=tañ ceytapaṭi nāḷ 1■kkut tirupponakap paḻavarici patakkukkunellu ayṅkuṟuṇiyūm kaṟiyamutukku nānāḻiyum uppamutukku nāḻiyūm miḷakamutukku nānāḻiyūm neyyamutu uḻakkāḻākkukku kuṟiṇi nānāḻiyum tayiramutu irunāḻikku nānāḻiyum aṭaikkāyamutu patiṉāṟukkum ilaiyamutu nāṟpatukkum nellu muṉnāḻiyum āka nāḷ oṉṟukku nellu irutūṇi muṉṉāḻiyum ulakaḷan=tāṉmarakkāllāl celvitākavum nāḷ oṉṟukk=kuc can=taṉakkāppu araikkaḻañcum iṉnellum celkaikku ipperiyaveḷāṉ ceyvitta tirunan=tavānam rājentracoḻanil kamukum teṅkum koṇṭu celvitāka niman=taṅkaṭṭi

svasti śrī ■ śrīkomāṟapaṉmarāṉa tiripuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ emmaṇṭalamuṅ koṇṭaruḷiya śrīvikkiramapāṇṭiyatevarkku yāṇṭu añcāvatu malaimaṇṭalattu kuḷiccaip paḷḷikoṇṭāṉ pūmaṉāṉa puvaṉiviccātiratevaṉeṉ ceyaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuk kaḷattūṟkoṭṭattu śrīmaturāntakaccaruppetimaṅkalattut taṉiyūrt tiruacciṟupākkattu uṭaiyār āṭcikoṇṭaruḷiya mahādevaruṭaiya iḷaṅkaruṇaippāvai nan=tavanañ ceyyuṅ kuṭikaḷukku ... tta nan=tavanattut tirumaṇṭapattu eṟiyaruḷiṉa nāḷ tiruppāvāṭai amutuceytaruḷa veṇṭuvaṉavukkum viṭṭa nīrnilamāvatu śrīmaturān=takaccaturvetimaṅkamaṅkalattut teṉpiṭākai kūṉaṉpaṭṭuk kāṇiuṭaiya sarvādittaṉ peraṉa comaṅkalattu aruḷāḷapaṭṭaṉ pakkalk koṇṭu viṭṭa nilamāvatu ivvūṟ kaḻaṉiyil maṭappuṟattukkut teṟkut teṉpākkattukku nirppāykiṟa vāykkālukkuk kiḻakkut teṉāmpulam uṭpaṭak kuḻi iraṇṭāyirattu muṉṉūṟuṅ koṇṭu viṭṭeṉ pūmaṉāṉa puvaṉaviccātiratevaṉeṉ itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■innilattil ṉāvalkkiṇaṟum ikkiṇaṟu cūḻnta maramum ittiru nan=tavaṉakkuṭikku iraṇṭu maṉaiyuṅ koṇṭuviṭṭeṉ pūmaṉāṉa avaṉiviccātiratevaṉeṉ itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■
