svasti śrī ■ tribhuvaṉaccakravattikaḷ śrīvirapāṇṭiyatevaṟkku yāṇṭu 7■vatu kaṟkaṭakaṉāyaṟṟu aparapakṣattu nāyaṟṟukiḻamaiyum saptamiyum peṟṟa aśvatiṉāḷ jeyaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu kaḷattūrkoṭṭattu śrīmadhurān=takaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu taṉiyūr tiruacciṟupākkattu uṭaiyār imma āṭcikoṇṭaaruḷiyamahādevarkku āticaṇṭecura tevakaṉmikaḷukku immaṇṭalattuśrīmaturāntakaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu kāvalkāvalkāṇi uṭaiya pūvaṭaiyāṉ mātavarāyaṉ mutali cempiyataraiyaṉum ivaṉ tampi cokkaṉ campuvarāya malaiyamāṉum ivaṉ tampi tevapperumāḷ maturānta pallavaraiyaṉum immūvarom ināyaṉārkku nāṅkaḷ tiruṉāmattukkāṇiyāka tiruppaṭiyil utakampaṇṇikuṭutta śrīmaturāntakaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu parakecariceri vaṟṟalūr kavinārāyaṇapaṭṭaṉpakkal nāṅkaḷ koṇṭuuṭaiya teṉpiṭākai kūṭalūril uṭaiyār tiruvakkicuramuṭaiya nāyaṉārkku ivvūr nāṟpāṟkellaikku uṭpaṭṭa nilattil nilaṅkalantavāṟṟile nālil oṉṟum nāṟpatteṇṇāāyiraviṇṇakar emperumāṉ tiruviṭaiyāṭṭamnilam oruveliyum tiruviruppumaṉai iraṇṭum nikki kiḻpāṟkellai muṟappākkatteuṟa teṉpāṟkellai ..ṇikuṭṭamaṅkalatte ...uṟavum melpāṟkellaitaṇṭalattellai u ....aṟkellai kuppa ....vāṇiyarilkumaṉippākkam tiruvaraṅkaviḷākattellai uṟavum inānkellaiuṭpaṭṭa nattamum kaḻaṉiyumeri erivāy puṟavaṭaikollaiyummelnokkiṉa maramumkiḻnokkiṉa kiṇaṟum uṭppaṭa innāyaṉāāṟkku tiruṉāmattukkāṇiyāka ṉāṅkaḷ tiruppaṭiyile utokampaṇṇikkuṭuttom cempiyataraiyaṉum campuvarāyamalaiyamāṉum maturāntakapallavaraiyaṉum immūvaromivai mutali .. cempiyataraiyaṉ eḻuttu ivai cokkaṉcampuvarāyaṉ malaiya
svasti śrī ■ pūmaruviya tirumātum puvimātum ceyamātum nāmaruviya kalaimātum pukaḻmātum nayan=tu pulka arumaṟaiviti neṟiyaṉaittu n=taḻaippa varumuṟai yurimaiyil maṇimuṭicūṭit tiṅkaḷveṇkuṭait ticaikkaḷuṟeṭṭun=taṅku tanikkūṭa n=tānenaviḷaṅkak karuṅkalippaṭṭiyaic ceṅkol turappa porukati rāḻi puvi vaḷart tuṭanvara villava riraṭṭar minavar ceralar pallavar nutaliyar pāttivar paṇiya eṇṇaruṅ kaṟpakam maṇṇakam puṇan=tu cempon virasiṁhāsanattup puvanamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟirun=taruḷiya kopparakesaripanmarāna tiripuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīrājarājadevaṟku yāṇṭu patineṭṭāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuk kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattut taniyūr śrīmaturān=takaccaturvvetimaṅkalattut tiruvacciṟupākkattu āḷuṭaiyanāyanār āṭcikoṇṭāṟku ceṅkeṇikaḷil irājanārāyaṇaccampuvarāyanen innāyanāṟkut tiruman=tiraponakattatukku tiruvacciṟupākkattu pāṭikāvaluḷḷutu patineṭṭāvatu mutal can=tirātittavarai āṭcikoṇṭanāyanāṟkut tiruman=tiraponakattukku amutupaṭiyākak kuṭutten ceṅkeṇi rājanārāyaṇaccampuvarāyanen itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■ ivai pallavan eḻuttu ■
svasti śrī ■ koṟcaṭapaṉmar tiripuvaṉaccakkaravatti śrīvikkiramapāṇṭiyatevaṟkku yāṇṭu 4■vatu teṉpākkappaṟṟil nāṭṭārom uṭaiyār āṭcikoṇṭanāyaṉārkkup puraṭṭātittirunāḷukku kampattāṉveḷiyāṉa cittirameḻinallūr nāṟpāṟkellaik kuḷpaṭṭa naṉcey puṉcey uḷpaṭṭa cakalappṛāttikaḷum tirunāmattukkāṇiyāka mutal aṭaṅkal iṟaiyiliyākak kuṭuttom nāṭṭavarom nāṭṭār paṇiyāl ivai toṇṭaimaṇṭala villavarāyaṉ eḻuttu ■
svasti śrī ■ pūmevi vaḷar tiruppon mātu puṇara nāmevu kalaimakaḷ nalamperitu ciṟappa vijayamāmakaḷ velpuyat tiruppa icaiyin celviyu meṇṭicai viḷaṅka nirupar van=ti ṟaiñca nīṇilamaṭan=taiyait tirumaṇam puṇarntucīrvaḷar taruma maṇimuṭi kavittena maṇimuṭi cūṭi mallaiñālattu palluyiṟyiṟ kellām ellaiyi linpa mikavini teyta veṇkuṭainiḻaṟ ceṅko locci vāḻi yūḻi yāḻi naṭappac cempon vīrasiṁhāsanattup puvanamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟirun=taruḷiya korājakesaripaṟmarāna tiripuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevar.......... mā maṇṭapattu muttuppan=talinkiḻ paḷḷippiṭattu eḻun=taruḷiyirun=tu tiruvāymoḻin=taruḷinapaṭi jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuk kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattut taniyūr śrīmaturān=takaccaturvvetimaṅkalattu tiruvaicciṟupākkattu āṭcikoṇṭamahādevaṟku munpu tevatānam illaiyenṟu ittevaṟku veṇṭum nimantaṅkaḷukku iṟuppatāka āyirakkala nellukku ōymānāṭāna vijaiyarājen=ti ravaḷanāṭṭu neṟkunṟamāna cempiyancāttanūrum muṭiyampākkamum kaṭakavaṭṭiyum innāṭṭu arin=ta vancāttanūrenṟu kūṭina ūrkaḷil ciṟukaṭuvanpākkamum vayalūril nāle kāṇik kiḻaraiye irumāvaraiye araikkāṇik kiḻaraiye araimā mun=tirikai nilamum ōkūrppāl puḷiyuṇṇiyum tevatānam iṟaiyiliyāka iṭṭup paḻamper tavirttu munpu kāṇiyuṭaiya kāṇiyāḷaṟkey kāṇiyāy kalikaṭin=tacoḻancāttanūrennum perāl ōrurākak kūṭṭappeṟaveṇṭumennu ikkōyiliṟ piṭārar civalokamuṭaiyāraina kāṭṭi kulottuṅkacoḻabahmramārāyan namakkuc connamaiyil iyāṇṭu munṟāvanumutal paḻamper tavirttut tevartānam iṟaiyiliyāka iṭṭu munpu kāṇiyuṭaiya kāṇiyāḷaṟcey kāṇiyāy kalikaṭin=ta coḻan cāttanūrennum perāl ōrurākak kūṭṭik kuṭuppatu ippaṭi tiruvāymoḻin=ta ruḷinār ivai vicaiyarājan eḻuttu ivai kaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻakkaḷappāḷan eḻuttu ivai vayalnāṭṭaraiya........... ṉattu mukaveṭṭi keṭuṅkunṟaṅkiḻān eḻuttu ivai puravaric ciykaraṇanāyaka.....
svasti śrī ■ pūmevi vaḷar tirupponmātu puṇara nāmevu kalaimakaḷ nalamperitu ciṟappa vijayamāmakaḷvelpuyat tiruppa icaiyin celviyum eṇṭicai viḷaṅki nirupar vantiṟaiñca niṇila maṭantaiyaitirumaṇam puṇarntu cīrvaḷar taruma maṇimuṭi kavitteṉa maṇimuṭi cūṭi mallaiñālattu palluyiṟ kellām ellaiyil iṉpam mika initeyta veṇkuṭai niḻal ceṅko locci vāḻiyūḻi āḻi naṭappac cempoṉ vīrasiṁhāsaṉattup puvaṉammuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟiruntaruḷiya korājakecaripaṉmarāṉa tribhuvanaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻatevar vikkiramacoḻapurattu koyiluḷḷālai abhiṣekamaṇṭapattu muttuppantaṟkīḻ eḻuntaruḷiirukka āṇṭār kaicciṟumaṟayaṉkāṭṭi vikkiramacoḻabrahmamārāyar viṇṇappañceytapaṭi jeyaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu kaḷattūrkoṭṭattu śrīmadhurāntakaccaturvvedimaṅkalattu tiruvacciṟupākkattu āṭcikoṇṭamahādevaṟkku veṇṭum pūjaikkum amutupaṭikkum maṟṟum veṇṭum nimantaṅkaḷukkum tiruppaṇikkumtevatāṉam peṟaveṇṭum enṟu viṇṇappañceyya tiruvuḷḷamāy iṭṭaruḷiṉa ūr śrīmadhurāntakaccaturvvedimaṅkalattut tenpiṭākai oṭuvattūr nirnilamum puñcainilamum itaṉ pāl amaṇpākkam nīrnilamum puñcainilamum añcāvatumutal tevatāṉa iṟaiyiliyāka viṭṭu ittevar koyilil eḻuntaruḷat tiruvuḷḷamāṉa kulottuṅkacoḷiśvaramuṭaiyāṟku pūjaikkum amutupaṭikkum uṭalāka oymānāṭṭu vijayarājendravaḷaṉāṭṭu paicāṟu nīrnilamum puñcainilamum iṟaiyili tevatāṉamāka viṭṭatu ivvūrkaḷāl vanta kaṭamaikaḷ ikkoyilt tāṉattāṟke kaṭamai kuṭimai iṟukka eṉṟu tiruvāyamoḻintaruḷinār ippaṭikku ivai vicaiyarāyaṉ eḻuttu ■ ippaṭikku ivai kaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻakkaḷappāḷaṉ eḻuttu ■ ippaṭikku ivai puravari śrīkaraṇaṉāyakam ṉeṭuṅkuṉṟaṅkiḻāṉ eḻuttu ■
svasti śrī ■ pūmeviy vaḷar tiruppon mārpu puṇara nāmevu kalaimakaḷ nalamperitu ciṟappa vijaiya māmakaḷ velpuyat tiruppa icaiyuñ celviyum eṇṭicai viḷaṅka nirupar vantiṟaiñca niṇila maṭan=taiyait tirumaṇam puṇarn=tu cirvaḷar taruma maṇi muṭi kavitteṉa aṇimuṭi cūṭi mallaiñālattup palluyirk kellā mellaiyi liṉpa miyalviṉi leyta veṇkuṭainiḻaṟc ceṅko locci vāḻipallūḻi āḻi naṭappac cempoṉ virasiṁhāsanattup puvaṉamuḻutumuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟirun=taruḷiya kovirājakecaripaṟmarāṉa tripuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevarkku yāṇṭu oṉpatāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu kaḷattūrkkoṭṭattu taṉiyūr śrīmaturāntakaccaturvvetimaṅkalattut tiruvaicciṟupākkattu āṭcikoṇṭārkku ivvūrt tenpiṭākai aṟuvarkāraṇaiyi lirukkum maṉṟāṭi coṟaṉaṇiñcāṉai viḻupparaiyanāṭṭu maṉṟāṭi kuḷattūr paṉṉiruvan kaipiḻai kuṟṟattai tiruvāyppāṭināṭṭu ivarkaḷ makanāṉa i . rukkaiyum kaṭavaṉ ippanniruvaṉ kaiypiḻai kuṟṟattukkāka ippaṉniruvaṉ aṇantānukku viṭṭatirinun=tāviḷakku oṉṟukku viṭṭa āṭu toṇṇūṟṟāṟum kaikkoṇṭu śantrātittava rerikkakkaṭavomāṉom ikkoyililk kāṇiuṭaiya śivabrāhmaṇarom itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■

uṭaiyār tiruppātirippuliyūruṭaiya nāyaṉārkoyil tevakaṉmi koyilkaṇakkarkku ciṟumuṟi tiruppātirippuliyūr nattamum viḷainilamum puṉceynilamum ivvūr piṭākaikaḷil nattamum viḷainilamum puṉceynilamum uṭaiyār tiruppātirippuliyūruṭaiyār tirunāmattukkāṇiyāka aṉupavittup potukaiyil perumāḷ vikkiramapāṇṭiyatevaṟku muṉṟāvatu nāḷil uṭaiyār vikkiramapāṇṭiyak kāliṅkarāyar ikkoyilile peruvilai koḷḷakkaṭavatalla eṉṟum eṅkaḷ kāṇi eṉṟu aṉucayam paṇṇiṉapaṭiyāle māheśvarar tirukkūṭṭamāka iruntu oru tirumeṉi tiyilum viḻuntapaṭiyāle perumāḷ tirumuṉpekeḻviyāy piḷḷai pallavarāyaraiyum piḷḷai aḻakiyamaṇavāḷapperumāḷaiyum nīṅkaḷ nāṭṭile poṉa aḷavile ivvūr maruṅku cūḻnta iṭattu nāṭṭārai aḻaittuk keṭṭuk kāṇiuṭaiya ivarkaḷukku viṭuvittukkuṭuppateṉṟu tiruvāymoḻintaruḷiṉapaṭiyāle nālāvatu aippaci mātam aiñcāntiyati coḻakulavallinallūr ampalattile eṅkaḷaiyuṅ kūṭakkoṇṭu keṭṭa iṭattup pirāmaṇarai uṅkaḷ kāṇiyāṉapaṭikkuc cātaṉaṅ kāṭṭuṅkoḷeṉṟu coṉṉaiṭattu intappirāmaṇar brammakṣetram eṉṟu collukaiyāle uṅkaḷ brammakṣetramākil niṅkaḷ uḻutu iṟukkai iṉṟiye veḷḷāḻar aḷavar paḷḷikaḷ parampar uṭpaṭa uḻutu iṟuttu āṇṭumāṟi ivarkaḷ uṭaṉuṅkūṭak karaiiṭṭu uḻutupontapaṭiyāle kāṇiāṭci alla eṉṟum aṉupokattāl colla oṇṇāteṉṟum niṅkaḷ iṉṉāḷvaraiyāka ittirukkoyilile kāṇinilamutalākat tirunāmattukkāṇiyāka niṅkaḷ kuṭuttuk kalveṭṭikkiṭappatuṇṭo eṉṟu keṭṭaiṭattu ippaṭikku oru mulam eṅkaḷāl kāṭṭa oṇṇāteṉṟum taṉṉil tāṉ viṟṟum oṟṟivaiyttum potuvomeṉṟum ivarkaḷ cilacātaṉaṅ kāṭṭiṉaiṭattu uṅkaḷil niṅkaḷ oṟṟivaiyttum viṟṟum ceytavai oṉṟalla eṉṟum ivarkaḷaik keṭṭṭuviṭ ṭuk koyil tāṉattārai aḻaittu marutāṭu keraḷāntakanallūr kiḻkūṟum vārkālppaṭṭu pullāli tirucciṟṟampalanallūr cūriyaṉmeṭu ivvūrkaḷilnāyaṉār teyvanāyakaṉukkum nāyaṉār eḻicainātapperumāḷukkum iraṇṭāyiravaṉ maṭattukkum tiruviḷakkuppuṟamākavum tirumālaippuṟamākavum maṭappuṟamākavum tiruvayintirapurattu ivar vaitta akaram puttuḻāṉ brahmadeśattukku akarappaṟṟākavum perumāḷ cuntarapāṇṭiyatevar perumāḷvikkiramapāṇṭiyatevar perumāḷ virapāṇṭiyatevar eḻutiṉa tirumukappaṭi naṉcai puṉcai nilaṅkaḷum ūrkkiḻ iṟaiyiliyāka nam niyokappaṭi eḻutiṉanilaṅkaḷum inta pattāvatu āṭimātavaraiyāka aṉupavittuppotukiṟa nilaṅkaḷ kaiolaippaṭi nilaṅkaḷ uṭaiyār villavarāyar nammil oruttarāyittaṉmaṅkaḷ ceytapaṭiyāle nāme cantirātittavaraiyāka naṭattik kuṭukkakkaṭavomākavum ivar ceyta inta taṉmaṅkaḷil tiruvayintirapurattut tāṉattār talakāriyam ceyvārkaḷātal virotampaṇṇiṉār uṇṭākil nam ūrāka eḻuntiruntu tirttuk kuṭukkakkaṭavomākavum nam ūriloruttar virotam paṇṇiṉārruṇṭākil ivarkaḷ nammil orutta rallavākakkaṭavatākavum ippaṭi kallilum cempilum veṭṭikoḷvatākac coṉṉom coḻakulavalli ūravarom vyavasthai ■ kaṇṇamaṅkalattu muttuḻāṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉāṉa villavaṉ viḻupparaya ṉeḻuttuivai neṭṭaipākkattup pāvālikiḻāṉ veḷāṉ tillaiṉāyakaṉāṉa tillaināyakamuventaveḷā ṉeḻuttu ivai nittaviṉotappallavarayaṉ eḻuttuivai nittaviṉotamuventaveḷāṉ eḻuttu ivai eytaṉūr meykiḻāṉ veḷāṉ oppilātāṉāṉa vecālippāṭi muventaveḷā ṉeḻuttu ivaitiruviḷakkaṉ teṉṉavaṉ viḻupparaya ṉeḻuttu ivai oḻukaṟaip paṉaippāṅkiḻāṉ veḷāṉ āparaṇamiṭṭāṉāṉa arintamaṉmuventaveḷā ṉeḻuttuivai erippākkamuṭaiyāṉ mīṉavaṉ muventaveḷāṉeḻuttu ivai puttuḻāṉ araiyaṉ maṇayāḻvā ṉeḻuttu ivai erippākkamuṭaiyāṉ kāṉakaṉāṭuuṭaiyāṉeḻuttu ivai keraḷarāyaṉ eḻuttu ivai tipattarayaṉ eḻuttu ivai caṅkirāmakecari muventaveḷā ṉeḻuttu ivai maḻavarāyaṉ eḻuttu ivai kaṇṇāḻvā ṉeḻuttuivai aḻicupākkamuṭaiyāṉ vāṉavaṉ pallavaraiya ṉeḻuttu ivai puṭaiyamuḻāṉ araiyaṉ tevāṇṭā ṉeḻuttu ivai uḷcūṭṭu nalluḻāṉ tevaṉkatirāyiramuṭaiyā ṉeḻuttu ivai tiruviḷakkaṉ viḻiñattaraya ṉeḻuttu ivai cīṉattaraya ṉeḻuttu ivai tiruppeṟukiḻā ṉeḻuttu ivai cikkaluṭaiyāṉkulatīpa muventaveḷā ṉeḻuttu ivai pullāliveḷāṉ vicayarāyaṉ eḻuttu ivai tiruniṟṟuccoḻa svasti śrī ■ tiripuvaṉacakkiravarttikaḷ śrīvikkiramacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu 5■āvatu virutarājapayaṅkaravaḷanāṭṭu meṟkānāṭṭu tiruvayintirapurattāḻvār koyilil tiruvārātaṉaipaṇṇum kāśyapan maticūtaṉ kaṇṇapaṭṭaneṉ kaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu paṭṭāṉpākkaināṭṭu coḻakulavallinallūr eytanūr meykiḻāṉ ceṉaṉ tiruvayintiraṉpakkal ikkoyilil amāvāsai eḻuntaruḷu maṉṟu cevikka vanta śrīvayṣṇaṇavaṟku amutuceykaikku ivaṉpakkal nāṉ upaiyamāka śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu 3 10 5■āvatu koṇṭa kācu mūṉṟu tiṅkaḷ oṉṟukku kācu oṉṟukku palicaiyāl nellu mukkuṟuṇi āka kācu muṉṟukku palicaiyāl nellu irutūṇik kuṟuṇiyum śrīvikkiramacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu 5■āvatu ikkaṇṇapaṭṭan tiruvāykkulamuṭaiyān koṇṭa kācu onṟukku palicaiyāl nellut tiṅkaḷ patak korunāḻiyum ākak kācu nālu māsam oṉṟukku palicaiyāl celuttakkaṭavenāna nellu irutūṇi mukkuṟuṇi oru nāḻi ikkoyilil śrīvaiṣṇavarkaḷ amutucevikkum maṭattile innelluaṉṟāṭu kācukālāle aḷantukuṭukkakaṭavenāneṉ kaṇṇapaṭṭaṉ tiruvāykkulamuṭaiyāneṉ patineṭṭunāṭṭu civaiṣṇava rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■ cālai kalamaṟutta kovirājarājakesarivanmarkku yāṇṭu panniraṇṭāvatu vākūr māhāsabhaiyom nammuṭaiya cālaimūlaip poṟcālainaṅkaikku tiruvamutukku bhogamāka nāṅ kuṭutta nilam ivvūrkaṭamperikiḻ tenkaḻanip pulikkollai ampaṭukkai tamaṭiperumānum punnattuiḷaiya ayyanperumānum nilattukku meṟkum erikkālukku vaṭakku erikkālukkukiḻakkuerikkālukku teṟkum innāṉkellai akattuḷpaṭṭa nilam munṟekāle araikkāle muntirikai innilam nammūr tirukkoyiluṭaiya śivabrāhmaṇare payireṟṟi yinta bhogamaṭakkiip(po)poṟcālai naṅkaikku iraṇṭu santiyum yirunāḻit tiruvamutu muṭṭā me amutuceyvippārkaḷākavum santiviḷakku erippārkaḷākavum yinnilattukku veṇṭu miṟaiyum sabhaiyome yiṟuttu annilam yiṟaiyiliāvatākavum yippoṟcālainaṅkaikku nammur periyeri nilam veṭṭiyārākiyanānūṟṟuvap poṟcālaip periḷa maiyāreperāl patakku nellu āṇṭutoṟumvai ppitākavu mivarkaḷe ippoṟcālainaṅkai śrīkāriyam ārāyappeṟuvārākavumerivāriyapperumakkaḷaṭikkiḻ niṟkum cempunavane tiṅkaḷ nāḻi yeṇṇai aṭṭuvatākavumyivvūrāḷum kove yiddhanmam rakṣippārāka yipparicu paṇittom mahāsabhaiyom ■

svasti śrī ■ pukaḻmātu viḷaṅka jayamātu virumpa nilamakaḷ nilava malarmakaḷ puṇara urimaiyiṟ ciṟan=ta maṇimuṭicūṭi minavar nilaikeṭa villavar kulaitara eṉai maṉṉavar irita lamarat tik=kaṉait=tun=taṉ cakkara naṭāt=ti vijaiabhiṣekam paṇṇi vīrasiṁhāsanat=tu puvaṉamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟirun=taruḷiya korājakecaripanmarāṉa uṭaiyār śrīkulot=tuṅkacoḻadevaṟkuyāṇṭu irupatteṭṭāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu oymānāṭṭu kiṭkkaināṭṭu kiṭaṅkilāna mummuṭicoḻanallūr tiruttiṇṭīśvaramuṭaiya mahādevaṟku īcūrk=koṭṭattu maṉṟāṭi tiṇṭi āruḷaneṉ eṉ kaipiḻaiyāl iṉṉāṭṭuokan=tūr maṉṟāṭi cāmitīttaṉukku pramātam viḷain=tamaiyil ivaṉukkāka vait=ta tiruṉun=tāviḷakku 1 oṉṟukku viṭṭa cāvā muvā perāṭu 9 10 ivvāṭu toṇṇūṟum kaikkoṇṭu ivviḷakku cantrātit=tavaṟ erikkakkaṭavomānom ikkoyilil tiruvuṇṇāḻikai sabhaiyom itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ cālai kalamaṟutta kovīrājarājakecarīpanmaṟkī yāṇṭu 10 1■āvatu oymānāṭṭuk kiṭkkaiñāṭṭuk kiṭaṅkil tiruttiṇṭīśvaramuṭaiya mahādevar koyīluḷp piḷḷaiyār kaṇavatiyārkkuc coḻanāṭṭut teṉkaraiārkkāṭṭukkūṟṟattupperārkkāṭṭu ārkkāṭukiḻāṉ kāṭa ṉāṉai ṉāṭpoṉakattukku vaittatūkkuttal laricī iruṉāḻi koṇṭu tiruvamurtukāṭṭuvatāka tevatānamuruṅkaippākkattuvilaikuṭuttuk koṇṭa nilamāvatucaṅkilikaikkuṇṭillitaṟkuk kiḻpāṟkellaivaṭṭacceṟuvin melaivāykkālukku meṟkun tenpāṟkellaivūrnattattil toṭṭattukku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai pūvātticeṟuvukkuk kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai kālukkut teṟkum iṉṉāṉkellaiyuḷḷu makappaṭṭa caṅkilikaikkuṇṭilum veppettaṅ kiḻpāṟkellai viṇaippaṭṭikkup pāyntavāykkāllukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai nampaṉkampaṉ tiruttiṉa pututtiruttukku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai nantavāṉattukku pāynta vāyikkālukkukiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai kuṭiyompikkut teṟkumyinnāṟperellaikku muḷppaṭṭa nilamum kiṇaṟum nirum koṇṭu cantirātittavaṟ ārkkāṭukiḻāṉ kāṭaṉāṉaikkāka uḷḷālai gaṇavatiyārkku nāṭppoṉakam iruṉāḻitūkkuttalarici koṇṭu tiruvamitu kāṭṭuvomāṉomtiṇṭiśvarattu śrīkoyiluṭaiyom itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■pukaḻmātuviḷaṅka jayamātu virumpa nilamakaḷ nilava malarmakaḷ puṇan=tu urimaiyiṟ ciṟan=ta maṇimuṭi cūṭit tikkaṉaittum tan cakkara naṭātti virasiṁhāsaṉattup puvaṉimuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟirun=taruḷiṉa kovirājakecarivanmarāṉa uṭaiyārśrī kolottuṅkacoḻa⌈tevaṟku yāṇṭu 6■āvatujaṉaṉātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūr uṭaiyār tiruviraṭṭāṉamuṭaiya nāyaṉārkku kiḷiyūr malaiyamāṉ periyauṭaiyāṉāṉa irācarāca cetiyarāyaṉeṉ iṉṉāyaṉārkkut tirukkāttikai tirunāḷukkum tirunāṭpaṭikkum cantikkum ariyūr nāṉkellaikkuḷpaṭṭa nañcai puñ⌈cai aṉaittāyam uḷpaṭṭa kaṭamai kuṭimai eppeṟpaṭṭaṉavum iṉṉāyaṉārkku cantirātittavaraicelvatāka kal veṭṭikkuṭutteṉ irācarāca cetirāyaṉeṉ itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■ pūmiyum tiruvum tāme puṇarn=tu vikkiramattāl cakkara naṭātti vijayasiṁhāsanattu viṟṟirun=taruḷina kopparakecarivanmarāna uṭaiyār śrīrājentracoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu iṟaṇṭāvatu jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūr tiruviraṭṭānam uṭaiyār koyililey peṇṇai vaṭakarai vilaiyūrnāṭṭu neṟkuppai irukkum nelkkuppaiuṭaiyānāna kotaṇṭaṉ kaṇṭanāna maturān=takavaḷanāṭāḻvānen eṉ ciṟṟappaṉ upakāri mallaṉ parukkaluṭaiyān piritiveṇkāṭan kaiyiley piramātalpaṭṭamaiyil avaṉaiccārtti vaitta viḷakku arai araikkum vaitta cāvā muvā naṟpacu patināṟu ivai kaikkoṇṭu niman=tam celuttakkaṭavomānom ikkoyilil tiruvuṇṇāḻikai sabhaiyom itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■■
svasti śrī ■ tirumakaḷ polap perunilac cevviyum taṉakke yurimai puṇṭamai maṉakkoḷa kān=tataḷūrcālai kalamaṟuttu veṅkaiñāṭuṅ kaṅkapāṭiyum nuḷampapāṭiyum taṭikaivaḻiyūm kuṭamalaināṭuṅ kollamum kaliṅkamum eṇṭicai pukaḻtara īḻamaṇṭalamum tiṇṭiṟalveṉṟi taṇṭāṟ koṇṭu taṉneḻil vaḷar ūḻi ellā yāṇṭum toḻutakai viḷaṅkum yāṇṭey ceḻuñarai tecūkoḷ śrīkovirājarājakecaripanmaṟkki yāṇṭu 10 8■āvatu milāṭāna caṉanātavaḷaṉāṭṭu kuṟukkaikūṟṟattu brahmateyam tirukkovvalūr sabhaiyom ivvūr tiruviraṭṭāṉattu sukhāsanam meḻuntaruḷḷiirunta kovalviṭaṅkaṟku nāṅkaḷ tiruvamutukku ceytukuṭutta nilam pattu māvukkum ivvūr kiḻvaḷaiiṟ pulattukku teṟkaṭaiya pattu ceṟuvukkum kiḻpālkellaitiruviraṭṭāṉa talaivāykku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellaiy kaḷiyakkaḻani koṟpāṭṭukku vaṭakkum melpāṟkellai kaḷiyammuṭaiyāṉ ceṟuvukku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai tiruviraṭṭāṉa talaivāykku teṟkum ivvicaitta perunāṉkellaiilu makappaṭṭa nilam pattu ceṟuvumtiruviraṭṭānattu kovalviṭaṅkaṟku tiruvamitukku iṟai iliyāka iṟai iḻicci caṉtrātittavaṟ ceytukuṭuttom sabhaiyomitu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ pukaḻmātu viḷaṅka cayamātu virumpa nilamakaḷ vaḷara malarmakaḷ puṇara urimaiyiṟ ciṟanta maṇimuṭi cūṭi villavar kulaitara minavar nilaikeṭa vikkalan ciṅkaṇan melkaṭal pāyt turatti tikkanaittilun tan cakkara nāṭātti virasiṁhāsanattup puvanamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟirun=taruḷiya korājakecarivanmarāna uṭaiyār śrī kulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu 10■āvatu rājentracoḻavaḷanāṭṭu tāmarnāṭṭu tirumunaippāṭip peṇṇaittenkarai kiḷiyūruṭaiya malaiyamān cūriyan cāvaṉacākayanāna malaiyakulararācan ivvūruṭaiya malaiyamān catiran malaiyanāna rājentracoḻa malaiyamāṉaic cārtti milāṭākiya jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūr tiruviraṭṭānamuṭaiya mahādevaṟku cantirātittaval niṉṟeriya vaitta tirunantāviḷakku eḻukku viṭṭa cāvā muvā pacu .........ṭan kaikkoṇṭa pacu irunūṟ ṟirupattunālum ivai panmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■virame tuṇaiyākavu n=tiyākameyaṇiyākavuñ ceṅko loccik karuṅkali kaṭin=tu teṉṉaṉai talaikoṇṭu ceraṉait tiṟai⌈koṇṭu veṅkaḷat tāhavamallaṉai aimmaṭi veṉkaṇṭu veṅkaināṭu miṭṭu taṉṉuṭaṉ piṟan=ta muṉṉavar virata muṭittu tannaṭi paṇin=ta vijaiyātittark=ku veṅkaimaṇṭala maruḷa taṉ kaḻalaṭipaṇin=ta maṉṉark=ku kaṭāram eṟin=tu kuṭuttaruḷi comicuvaraṉaik kannaratecattaik kaiviṭat turattitaṉṉaṭi yaṭain=ta vikkiramātittaṟku iraṭṭapāṭi eṟin=tu kuṭuttaruḷi ulakamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum vīṟṟirun=taruḷiṉa kopparakecaripanmarāṉauṭaiyār śrīvirarājentradevaṟku yāṇṭu eḻāvatu jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūr tiruviraṭṭānamuṭaiyār koyilile uttamacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu veṭṭavalattu irukkum pūtuṭaiyācicaṉ paḷḷimalli pūcalil paṭṭamaiyil paṅkaḷanāṭṭu mātaḷampāṭi mātaḷampāṭiuṭaiyāṉ comaṉ tevanāna kaṅkaikoṇṭacoḻa pirutikaṅkaraiyaṉeṉ meṟpaṭiyāṉaic cārtti vaitta tirunun=tāviḷakku oṉṟukku vaitta cāvā muvā perumpacu 3 10 2 ivai kaikkoṇṭu ivviḷakku ṛṣapavāhanadevaṟku erikkakkaṭavom sthānamuṭaiya civabrāhmaṇaromcantrātittavaṟ panmāheśvara rakṣai hara ■
svasti śrī ■ tirumaṉṉi vaḷara irunila maṭantaiyum poṟceyap pāvaiyuñ cirttaṉic celviyun taṉ perunteviyarākiiṉpuṟa neṭutuyi ruḻiyuḷiṉpuṟaṉe iṭaituraināṭun tuṭarvaṉavelip paṭar vaṉavācic cuḷḷiccūḻmatiṭ koḷḷippākkaiyum naṇṇaṟkarumuraṇ maṇṇaikaṭakkamum porutaṭart tiḻattaraicar tam muṭiyum āṅkavaṉ teviya roṅkeḻil muṭiyu muṉṉavarpakkal teṉnāvar vaittita cuntaramuṭiyum intiraṉāramun teṇṭirai īḻamaṇṭala muḻuvatum eṟipaṭaik keraḷar muṟaimaiyiṟ cūṭuṅ kulataṉamākiya palarpukaḻmuṭiyuñ ceṅkatirmālai veṅkatirvelai tolperuṅkāval palpaḻantivu māpperun taṇṭāṟ koṇṭa kopparakecaripanmarāṉa śrīrājentiracoḻatevark=ku yāṇṭu6■vatu milāṭāṉa jaṉanātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūr tiruviraṭṭāṉamuṭaiya māhātevark=ku milāṭuṭaiyāṉ irāmaṉ mummuṭicoḻaṉāṉa irājentiracoḻa milāṭuṭaiyāṉ iṭṭa poṉṉiṉ taṭṭam oṉṟu kuṭiñaikkallāl niṟai irupatiṉ kaḻañcum ivar tampiyār irāmaṉ maṟavaṭikaḷāṉa muṭikaṇṭacoḻa milāṭuṭaiyār iṭṭa poṟkai īccoppi oṉṟu niṟai kuṭiñaikkallāl alaku ni⌈ṟaippaṭi poṉ irupattu mukkaḻañce araikkālum i⌈vai cantirātittavaṟ paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ tirumaṉṉi vaḷara irunila maṭaṉtaiyum poṟceyap pāvaiyum cīrttaṉic celviyum taṉ perunteviyarāki iṉpuṟa neṭutiyil ūḻiyuḷ iṭaiytuṟaināṭun tuṭarvaṉavelip paṭar vaṉavāciyuñ cuḷḷiccūḻ matiṭ koḷḷippākkaiyum naṇṇaṟkarumuraṇ maṇṇaikkaṭakkamum porutaṭa rīḻattaraicar tam muṭiyum āṅkavar teviya roṅkeḻil muṭiyu muṉṉavarpakkaṟ ṟeṉṉavar vaitta cuntaramuṭiyum intira ṉāramun teṇṭirai īḻamaṇṭala muḻuvatum eṟipaṭaik keraḷar muṟaimaiyiṟ cūṭuṅ kulataṉamākiya palarpukaḻ muṭiyuñ ceṅkatir mālaiyuñ caṅkatir velait tolperuṅkāvaṟ palpaḻantīyvu māpporu taṇṭāṟ koṇṭa kopparakecaripatmarāṉa śrīrājentracoḷadevarkku yāṇṭu 6■āvatu malāṭāṉa jaṉanātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu marutūr ūrom tirukkovalūrt tiruvīraṭṭāṉamuṭaiya mahādevar tirunan=tavāṉam irājentracoḷaṉnan=tavāṉakkuṭikaḷ muvarkku nilanivan=tamāka nāṅkaḷ viṟṟukkuṭutta nilamāvatu eṅkaḷur irājavijjātirappererikkiḻ potunilamāṉa nilattukkuk kiḻpāṟkellai peruñcāttakkāvatikaḷ koṟpāṭṭukku meṟkun teṉpāṟkellai paḷḷiccan=tam iyakkipaṭṭikku vaṭakku melpāṟkellai eṭṭikaḷ koṟpāṭṭukkuk kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai eriniṉṟuṅ kiḻakkunokkippon=ta peruvāykkālukkut teṟkum ivvicaitta perunāṉkellaiyu ḷakappaṭṭa nilam patiṉaṟucāṇkolāl irunūṟ ṟaimpattāṟu kuḻi koṇṭa torumāvāka kuḻi āyirattu toḷāyirattu irupatiṉāl nilam eḻumāvarai iṉṉila meḻumāvaraikku van=ta vilaidravyamum iṟaidravyamum iddevar śrīpaṇṭāratte yaṟakkoṇṭu iṉṉilañ can=tirātittaval iṟaiyiliyāka viṟṟukkuṭuttom marutūr ūrom iṉṉilattukku muṉpu nīr pāyum paricey miyñīruṅ kiṇīrum pāyappeṟuvatākavum iṉṉilattukku veṭṭivetiṉai amañci kāṭṭappeṟātomāka ipparicu iṟaiyiliyāka viṟṟukkuṭuttom marutūr ūrom ittirunan=ta vāṉattut tiruppaḷḷittāmam ittirunan=tavāṉakkuṭikaḷ muvarum paṟit taṭṭakkaṭavārkaḷākavum ipparicu ittirunan=tavāṉañ ceyviyttu ittirunan=tavāṉakkuṭikaḷ muvarkkucan=ti rātittaval iṟaiyili nilanivan=tamāka iddevar śrīpaṇṭārattey iṉṉilattukku veṇṭum vilaidravyamum iṟaidravyamuṅ kuṭuppittu nivan=tañ ceyvittāṉ coḻamaṇṭalattu arumoḻitevavaḷanāṭṭu maṅkalanāṭṭuiḷamaṅkalamuṭaiyāṉ niccal śrīyārur itu patmāheśvara rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ pūmaruviya ticaimukatton paṭaitta perumpuvi viḷaṅka temaruviya patantuḷavit tiruneṭumāl livanenna nirāḻi puṭaittu .......... tayakulat tavatarittu karuṅkaliyiṉ niru ḷotuṅkak katirveṇkuṭai nilā veṟippa varuṅkatirin veyil virikkum maṇimakuṭam puṉaintaruḷi maṇ kaḷippavum maṉaṅ kaḷippavum malarmaṭantaiyarmutal maṅkayar kaṇ kaḷippavun taṇṇaḷippa peruṅkaruṇaiyāl mutalkkāval pūṇṭu cempoṉ virasiṁhāsanattu puvaṉamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntataruḷiya koirājakecaripaṟmarāṉa tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīirājātirājadevaṟku yāṇṭu 5vatu irācātirācavaḷaṉāṭṭu milāṭṭu kuṟukalakkakuṟattu tirukkovalūruṭaiyār tiruviraṭṭāṉamūṭaiya nāyanāṟku kiḷiyūr malaiyamān malaiyan periyuṭaiyanāyanṉāna irācarāca cetiyarāyaṉum iṟaiyūran periyuṭaiyāṉāṉa irācarācakkovalarāyaṉum ivviruvom inṉāyaṉār koyilil aiyar oṟṟiyāḻvārpulavaraṭiyāna irācarāca cetiyarāyan ceṉaimikāman eḻuntaruḷivitta cetināyakaṟkum nācciyāṟkum periyāṉaippiḷḷaiyāṟkum tirunāḷḷeḻuntaruḷum aḻakiya piḷḷaiyāṟkum cāttupaṭi amutupaṭikkum taittirunāḷ eḻuntaruḷavum maṟṟum palapaṇi nimantakkāṟaṟkum tirukkovalūril akatteripaṟṟil nāṅkaḷ viṭṭa nilattukku melpāṟkellai cākaraikkum kuḷivikuḻi paḷḷiccantattukku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai nattattukku teṟkum kiḻpāṟkellai kiṟṟerittoṭṭukku meṟkkum tenpāṟkellai cantirātittan tūmpininṟum kiḻakkunokki ponta vāykkālukkum ponnitirumāl periyakkaraikkum vaṭakku akatteri nāṟpāṟkellaiuḷ akappaṭa nilattil paḻantevatānam nikki nikkiniṉṟa nilattukku maramañcāṭi pāṭikāvalum veṇṭukoḷum .. vicatam putiyitu maṉaikāṭcippeṟum kūraikkācu kiṭākkācum maṟṟum eppeṟpaṭṭa āyamum koḷḷakkaṭavutallavākavum inta nilattukku ni .. kālile koḷḷakkaṭavatākavum maṟṟoṉṟum koḷḷakkaṭavutallavākavum innāyaṉār eḻuntaruḷukiṟakiḻaittiruvitiāṉa cetiṉāyakapperunteruvum itukkuk kiḻakkuḷḷa nattamum kukaṉkuḻi iṉṉāyaṉāṟku ceṅkaḻuṉirt tiruppaḷḷittāmam ākki cāttiyaruḷukaikku .......... le ... itu .. vallavaraiyan cattiyam itu paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrīrastu ■ tribhuvanacakravarttikaḷ śrīkolottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku ■ 4■āvatumalāṭākiya jananātavaḷanāṭṭuk kuṟukkaikkuṟṟattu tirukkovalūr āḷuṭaiyārtiruviraṭṭānamuṭaiyār koyilil ittirumaṭaippaḷḷi cevvittāḷ vaṭakaraiuṭaiyān makaḷ malaiyaṉperiyuṭaiyāṉāna vikkiramacoḻac cetiyarāyan akamuṭaiyāḷ vikkiramacoḻakkovalarāyaṉ tāy uttamacoḻi itu patmāheśvara rakṣai ■■
svasti śrī ■ tiripūvaṉacakkaravattikaḷ śrīvikkiramacoḻatevarkku yāṇṭu 5■āvatu uṭaiyār tiruvirāṭṭāṉamuṭaiya nāyaṉārkku kiḷiyūr malaiyamāṉ vikkiramacoḻacetiyarāyaṉeṉ vaitta tirunuṉtāviḷakku oṉṟukku iṉṉāyaṉār tiruviḷakkumaṉṟāṭi āruṉaṉcelvakkoṉpakkal viṭṭa pacu muppattiraṇṭu iṣapam oṉṟum tiruvirāṭṭāṉanāḻiyāle māttu eṇṇāḻi neyāka aḷakkakkaṭaveṉ āruṉaṉ celvakoṉnen itu

svasti śrī ■ tiripuvanacakkaravattikaḷ śrīrājarājatevarkku yāṇṭu 2■āvatu rājarājavaḷanāṭṭu kuṟukkaikkūṟṟattu tirukkovalūruṭaiyār tiruvīrāṭṭānamuṭaiya nāyanārkku kiḷiyūr malaiyamān iraiyūrāna periyauṭaiyān irācarācac cetiyarāyannen tai uttaraayanattil uṭaiyārait teṇṭanpaṇṇi yeṅkaḷ tavappanārkkum enakkum naṉṟāka nān vaitta tirununtāviḷakku eṭṭukku tirukkovalūril akatteri pokkil vāvāttukkai tevatānattukkukiḻakku naṭuvupona vāykkālukku teṟkku iṟaiili tirununtāviḷakkuppuṟamāka nāṉ viṭṭa taṭi eṭṭināl kuḻi 2 1000■mum tiruvitikku kiḻakku paḻantevatānam citāripokkukku kiḻakku kiḻainūṟṟukku kiḻakku tirunantavanattukku teṟku naṭuvil pokkaraikku vaṭakkum naṭu uṭpaṭṭa taṭi eṭṭināl kuḻi 2 1000mum āka kuḻi nālāiramum tirunuṉtāviḷakkuppuṟamāka viṭṭen ikkoil tiru vuṇṇāḻikai capaiyār kaikkoṇṭu tāṅkaḷe uḻutu paircceytu cantrātittavaraiyerikkakkaṭavarkaḷākavum inta nilattukku niramañciyum maṟṟum yeppoṟpaṭṭa aṇtarāyaṅkaḷum ciṟupāṭikāvalum uḷpaṭa viṭṭen irācarācac cetiyarāyanenitu iṟakkuvān keṅkaiiṭai kumariiṭai kurālpacu konṟān pāpam koḷvān en kutiraikku pullu iṭukiṟa paṟaiyanukku tan miṇāṭṭiyaik kuṭuppānitu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■■

svasti śrī ■ pūmevu vaḷar tiruppoṉmātu puṇara nāmevu kalaimakaḷ nalapperutu ciṟappa vicaiyamāmakaḷ velpuyat tiruppa icaiyuñ celvamum eṇṭicai viḷaṅka nirupar vantiṟaiñca niḻnilamaṭantaiyait tirumaṇam puṇarntu cirvaḷar tarumam aṇimuṭi kavittena maṇimuṭi cūṭi mallaiñālattu palluyirk kellām ellaiyi limpam iyalvini leyti veṇkuṭai niḻaṟṟi ceṅko locci vāḻi pallūḻi āḻi naṭappa cempoṉ virasiṁhāsaṉattu puvaṉamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya kopparakecaripanmarāṉa tribhuvanacakravattikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟkku yāṇṭu 5■ āvatu irājarājavaḷanāṭṭut tirumuṉaippāṭi melūrnāṭṭu tirunāvalūrāna irājātittapurattu uṭaiyār tiruttoṇṭiśvaramuṭaiya mahādevar koyilil civabrāhmaṇarom upaiyam ivvūr viyāpāri peruvalamuṭaiyāṉ peṇṇainetivāṇan tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ ittevaṟku vaitta tirununtāviḷakku 1 oṉṟu ittirununtāviḷakku 1 oṉṟukkum ivaṉ eṅkaḷvacattu viṭṭa pacu 3 10 2 ippacu muppattiraṇṭuṅkaikkoṇṭu cantrādittavarai upaiyamāka nāṅkaḷe ittiruṉuntāviḷakku oṉṟum peruvalamuṭaiyāṉ peṇṇainetivāṇan tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉukkāka erikkakkaṭavomāka sammatittom ikkoyilil civabrāhmaṇarom ittiruṉuntāviḷakku oṉṟum eriyakkaṭavutāka ivaṉ iṭṭa tarāk kuttiviḷakku nārāyam uḷpaṭa iṭai ṉūṟṟeḻupatiṉ palam itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■ meṟpaṭiyāṉa ■
svasti śrī ■ pūmevi vaḷar tiruppoṉ mārvu puṇara nāmevu kalaimakaḷ nalamperitu ciṟappa vicaiyamāmakaḷ velpuyat tiruppa icaiyuñ celviyum eṇṭicai viḷaṅka nirupar vantiṟaiñcaniṇilamaṭantaiyait tirumaṇam puṇarntu cirvaḷar tarumamaṇimuṭi kavitteṉa aṇimuṭi cūṭi mallaiñālattup palluyiṟ kellām ellaiyi liṉpam iyalviṉu ḷeyta veṇkuṭainiḻaṟṟac ceṅko locci ūḻi pallūḻi āḻi naṭappac cempoṉ vīrasiṅṅāsaṉattup puvaṉamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya korājakecaripanmarāna tribhuvaṉaccakkaravarttikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu eḻāvatu irājarājavaḷanāṭṭu tirumuṉaippāṭi melūrnāṭṭut tirunāvalūrāṉa irācātittapurattu uṭaiyār tiruttoṇṭīśvaramuṭaiyāṟku peṟukanūrṉāṭṭukūṭalūr paḷḷi āḷappiṟantāṉ mokanāṉa kulottuṅkacoḻakacciyarāyaṉ iṭṭa makaratoraṇam onṟināl oṉpatemukkāl māṟi poṉ nūṟṟukkaḻañcum piṟai onṟiṉāl eṭṭemukkāl māṟipon mukkaḻañcum kūttāṭundevaṟku cātti aruḷa iṭṭa abhiṣekam onṟiṉāl onpatarai māṟi poṉ irupatiṉ kaḻañcum amutuceytaruḷa iṭṭa veḷḷittaḷikai oṉṟiṉāl iṭaiāyirattu aiññūṟṟu nāṟkaḻañ caraiye yiraṇṭu mañcāṭiyum nālumāvum aracanārāyaṇan veḷḷik kaccukkoram oṉṟiṉāl iṭai irunūṟṟu irupattunāṟ kaḻañcum veṇkalam āḷappiṟantāṉtaḷikai oṉṟināl iṭai irunūṟṟup palamum tiruaṭṭaṇaikkāl tarā onṟiṉāl iṭai nūṟṟu eṇpattu aimpalamumkompu orāṇaiyāl tarā iṭai muppattaṟu palamum tirunāvalūrāṉa irācātittapuramum ittoṭum kūṭina kārāṇaiyāṉa viracoḻanallūrum ivviraṇṭuril pāṭikāvaluṭaiyār tiruttoṇṭiśvaramuṭaiyāṟku veṇṭum nimantaṅkaḷukku viṭṭen āḷappiṟantāṉ mokanāṉa kulottuṅkacoḻa kacciyarāyaneṉ villiṭai piṭittāṉ itu aḻivāṉ keṅkaiiṭai kumarii
svasti śrī ■ kaṭalcūḻnta pārmātun tirumātuṅ kalaimātu maṭalcūḻnta pormātum pukaḻmātum puṇarntu vāḻa ṉāṟkaṭal cūḻ puvi yeḻum pāṟkaṭal poṟ pukaḻ parappi ātiyuka mituvāmeṉa aḻakumuṭi puṉaintaruḷi yaṟuvakaiyum aiympūtamum aruḷilvaḻi yaṟan taḻaippat tennavaruñ ceralaruñ ciṅkaḷaru mutalāya maṉnavar vantiṟai cumantu vantiṇṭi cevippa ūḻiyūḻi oruceṅko leḻupāru miṉitaḷippac cempoṉ vīrasiṁndāsaṉattu ulakuṭai mukkoṟkiḻāṉaṭikaḷoṭum vīṟṟiruntaruḷiya kovirācakecaripaṟmarāṉa tiripuvaṉaccakkaravarttikaḷ śrīirājairājadevaṟku yāṇṭu 8 eṭṭāvatu nāḷ 100 10 nūṟṟorupatināl piracātañceytaruḷiṉa tirumukappaṭi tripuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ koneriṉmaikoṇṭāṉ irājairājavaḷanāṭṭut tirumuṉaippāṭināṭṭut tirunāvalūrāṉa irājātittapurattu nakarattāṟkut taṅkaḷūriṟ kāṇiyuṭaiya viyāpārikaḷāyp pala viṭaṅkaḷilum poyiruntārai irājairājak kāṭavarāyaṉ aḻaippittu ivvūrile kuṭiyeṟṟa

svasti śrī ■ virame tuṇaiyākavun tiyākame yaṇiyākavuñ ceṅko locci k=karuṅkali kaṭin=tu kūṭalcaṅkamattu hāāhavamallaṉai yañcuvittu vikkalaṉaiyuñ ciṅkaṇaṉaiyum uṭaipuṟaṅ kaṇṭu maṟṟavaṉ mahādeviyoṭum vastuvāhanaṅ kaikkkoṇṭu iraṇṭāmvicaiyiluṅ kuṟitta kaḷattu hāhavamallaṉai yañcuvittut tan muṉṉavar viratamuṭittu veṅkaināṭu miṭṭaruḷi vijaiyābhiṣekam paṇṇi virasiṁhāsanattu ulakamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟirun=taruḷiya kovirājakesaripanmarāṉa uṭaiyār śrīvirarājentradevark=ku yāṇṭu añcāvatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuc cempūrkkoṭṭattup puṟaiyūrnāṭṭuc ceyyūrāṉa jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻanallūrp puṟṟiṭaṅkoṇṭaruḷiṉa mahādevarkku senāpatimārāyaṉ maturāntakanāṉa rājarājanayapālaneṉ ittevark=ku pūrvāṇhasan=ti oṉṟiṉuk=kut tiruvamurtariyci nānāḻik=kum kaṟiyamurtukkum neyyamurtuk=kum aṭaik=kāyamurtuk=kum santiviḷak=ku āṟuk=kum āka san=ti oṉṟiṉuk=ku nellup patak=ku muṉṉāḻik=ku innāṭṭu eṉ kāṇi ceyyūrāṉa virarājentranallūrnirnilattu iṟaiyiliyāka viṭṭa nilattuk=kuk kiḻpāṟkellai tiraiyacekaraṉ ceṟuvuk=kum palliṟuppāṉkarampaik=kum meṟkum vaṭapāṟkellai vaḷavatarayaṉceṟuvukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai palliṟuppāṉkarampaiyk=kum tillampaḷḷittukkup pāyum vāykkālukku vaṭakku taṭi iraṇṭukku vaṭak=kum melpāṟkellai nikarilicoḻavatiyiṉ kiḻiṉ taṭi muṉṟukkuk kiḻakkum iṉṉāṟpālellaik kuḷḷum naṭuvu kiṇaṟu akappaṭa caṭaiyaṉceṟuvu taṭi iraṇṭināl patineṇcāṇkolālk kuḻi eḻunūṟṟaṟupattiraṇṭe mākāṇiyum ittevarkku iṟaiyiliyāka iṟaiyiḻicci kal veṭṭuvittuk kuṭutteṉ senāpati mārāyaṉ maturān=takanāṉa rājarājanayapālaneṉ ■ ittaṉmam iṟakkuvā

tiruppaṇimāṟṟu celuttakkaṭavomākavum ■ ippacu muppatuṅ kācu aimpatum innilamum āṭupaṉniraṇṭum kaikkoṇṭu kal veṭṭuvittom ikkoyiliṟ civabrahmaṇan tiṇṭikūttaṉāṉa puṟṟiṭaṅkoṇṭamahādevapaṭṭanum cūriyan svasti śrī ■ vikkiramacoḻatevarkku yāṇṭu 9 cempūrkkoṭṭattup puṟaiyūrnāṭṭuc ceyyūrāṉa jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻanallūrp puṟṟiṭaṅkoṇṭaruḷiṉa mahādevaṟkumeṟpaṭi tiraiyan vaḷavataraiyan civakatikaṅkattevaṟkuṅ kāvan tiṇṭiyum itdevaṟku viṭṭa tirunantāviḷakku oṉṟukku viṭṭa nilam tiruvekampiṉil melkūṟu pāṭakam oṉṟum uṟappontāṉceṟup pāṭakamum araiyum ākappāṭakam oṉṟaraiyuṅ kaikkoṇṭu ittirununtāviḷakku oṉṟum cantirātittavarai celuttakkaṭavom ikkoyil kāṇiuṭaiya śivabrāhmaṇan kūttapaṭṭanum nāyakanum ivviruvom ■panmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■ rājarājadevaṟk=ku yāṇṭu 5■vatu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattu ceyyūrāna jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻanallūr puṟṟiṭaṅkoṇṭa mahādevark=ku ivvūrt tiraiyan tevarkaṇṭaṉ tāṅkuvānāna uttamacoḻavaḷavataraiyaṉ iddevark=ku vaitta dharmmaṅkaḷ ikkoyilil śivabrāhmaṇan sūriyan tāṅkuvāṉ puṟṟiṭaṅkoṇṭa mahāmuniyum ciyāṟudevabhaṭṭaṉ manavācakaṅkaṭantānum kaṭampantāṅkuvāṉbhaṭṭanum taḻuvak=kuḻaintāṉ celvabhaṭṭanum iṉnālvom kaikkoṇṭu candrādityavarai celuttakkaṭavomāka sammatittuk kaikkoṇṭom ikkoyilil tirumāḷikaip piḷḷaiyārk=ku amāvāsipaṉniraṇṭum iṭaiuvāp paṉniraṇṭum viṣuvayana saṁkramam nālumgra haṇamum ivarkaḷ mātākkaḷ piṟanta aippacippūramum āṇṭoru catayamum āṇṭu muppattiraṇṭu nāḷ piḷḷaiyārai amutuceyvikkaik=ku maddhyāhna candioṉṟuk=ku arici nānāḻi amutu ceyvittu itile nāḷuri ariciccoṟṟāl apūrvvarkaḷ pūcittārk=ku iṭakkaṭavomāka sammatittu kaikkoṇṭa kācu iraṇṭu āḷuṭaiyārk=ku maddhyānasaddhik=ku aiñcu tirumañcaṉakkuṭam nāṅkaḷe koṇṭu tirumañcaṉa meṭuttu abhiṣekam paṇṇa cammatittu kaikkoṇṭa kācu oṉṟum dakṣiṇāmūrttidevark=ku ciṟukālaisaddhi oru tirumālai cārtta sammatittu kaikkoṇṭa kācu mukkāle oru māvum āḷuṭaiyārk=ku oru sanḍiviḷak=ku erikkakkaṭavomāka sammatittu kaikkoṇṭa poṉ mukkāle mañcāṭiyum iraṇṭumāvum iddharmmaṅkaḷ nālum cantrādityaval celuttak=kaṭavomākak kaikkoṇṭu sa mmatittom ..... paṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■ rājātirājadevark=ku yāṇṭu 6■vatu ceyyūṟ tevarkaṇṭan=tāṅkuvānāna uttamacoḻavaḷavataraiyan yikkoyiluḷḷe tirukketāradevarai ppratiṭṭittu yiddevark=ku yikkoyilil śivabrāhmaṇar ciyāṟutevanum āḻvān munimahādevanum kaṭampan tāṅkuvānumyintadevarai trisandhikaḷum pūcittu amāvāsi viṣuvayanasamgramam āṭṭu 10 6 nāḷ nittamnānāḻinel van=ta arici amutuceyya poliūṭṭākak koṇṭa paḻaṅkācuaraiyum sandhiviḷakku onṟuk=ku āṭu paṉṉiraṇṭum ■ yitu candrādittavarai celuttakkaṭavo mimmuvom ..... piṭipāṭu meṟpaṭi śivabrāhmaṇarom ■ tiruketāratevar viśveśvarateva riruvark=kum viṣuvayanasaṁgramam grahaṇam pūcam kātti⌈kai tiruvātirai āṇṭuvarai eṭṭunā ḷāṭiyaruḷap pālamutukkup poliyūṭṭākak kaikkoṇṭa putukkācu 1 koṇṭu candrātittavarai celuttakkaṭavo mimmuvom ■ itu panmāheśvara rakṣai ■
■ pūmaṉṉu patumam pūtta veḻulakun tāmuṉ cey tavattāṟ parutivaḻit toṉṟi neṭumālivanena cuṭarmuṭi cūṭi irunilamakaḷai yurimaiyiṟpuṇarntu tirumakaḷ paṇaimulaic ceñcān taṇintupaṉaivarai mārva maṇivarai nikarppac cayamakaḷ centaṉac cuvaṭṭāṟ puya mirukayilaip poruppeṉṉat toṉṟa nāmakaḷtāṉu meṅkomakaṉ cevvāyp pavaḷac ceyoḷi paṭaittaṉaṉyāṉeṉa tavaḷanaṉniṟan tanittuṭaiyeneṉap pukaḻmakaḷ cintai makiḻ nāḷiṉu morukuṭainilavum porupaṭait tikiri veyiluṅ karuṅkaliyiruḷait turappa niṭu pallūḻi yeḻkaṭaṟ puṟattiṉuṅ koṭāc centaṉikko liṉitulāva miṉamuñ cilaiyuñ citaintu vāṉuyarp poṉneṭu meruviṟ puvi vīṟṟiruppa umpariyāṉai yoreṭṭiṉukkun tampameṉṉat taṉittaṉi ticaitoṟum vijaiyastambham niṟppa pacippakaiyāṉattu niṅki maṉnuyir taḻaippa maṉuvāṟu peruka mātavar tavamu maṅkaiyar kaṟpu mātiyantaṇa rākutip pukaiyu miteḻu koṇṭal vīcu taṇpuṉalu metiṉi vaḷamuñ cātiyoḻukkamu niki yaṟamum piṟaḻātu niṟpap pāvum paḻaṉapparappum paṇaikkai māvu mallatu vaṉṟaḷaippaṭutalkaṉaviluṅ kāṇṭaṟ kariteṉa varunatippuṭaiyiṉum palveṟu puḷḷiṉu mallatu ciṟaipaṭuta liṉṟi niṟai peruñ celvamo ṭavaṉivāḻ pallavar teluṅkar māḷavar kaliṅkar kocalar kaṉnaṭar kaṭārar teṉnar ceralar ciṅkaḷar koṅkaṇar tirikartta raṅka ravantiyar kaikayar jinaka raṟaikaḻal ventaru mallā varaicaru muṟaimaiyil varinta tiṟaikuṇan tiṟaiñcavum ampoṉmaṭakkoṭi cempiyaṉkiḻāṉaṭi aruḷmukan tiṉituṭaṉiruppa aruḷpuri cempoṟkoṭ ṭimaiyappāvaiyuñcivaṉum polac cempoṉvīrasiṁhāsanattup puvaṉamuḻutuṭaiyāḷoṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya kovirājakesaripaṉmarāṉa tiripuvaṉacakravarttikaḷ śrīkulottuṅkacoḻadevaṟku yāṇṭu nālāvatu jayaṅṅkoṇṭacoḻamaṇṭalattuc cempūrkkoṭṭattup poṟaiyūrnāṭṭuc ceyyūrāṉa jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻanallūrp puṟṟiṭaṅkoṇṭaruḷina mahādevar tiruppaḷḷiyaṟainācciyāṟku ivvūr ūrom strīdhanamākak kuṭutta nilamāvatu ■ ivvūr erietirvāykku meṟku maturāntakattellaikkuk kuḻikkut teṟkuc ceyyūrāṉa virarājentranallūrkku vaṭavellaikku vaṭakku maturāntakattellaikkut teṟku iraṇṭām tarattu nila muṭpaṭa nirnilamum puṉceyyun tāṅkalum uṭppaṭṭa nilam pattu veliyum ippaḷḷiyaṟainācciyāṟkuc cantirātittavarai cellakkaṭavatākavum ■ iṉnilattāl vanta iṟaiyum āḷum amañciyum epperpaṭṭa cilvariyumūrile eṟṟi nāṅkaḷe iṟuttuk ■ svasti śrī ■■ cakalapuvaṉaccakkaravatti kaḷ avaṉiāḷappiṟantārāṉa śrīkopperuñciṅkatevaṟku yāṇṭu 5■vatu ■ nāḷ 3 100 10 4 ṉāl coḻako ṉolai ■ teṉṉavaṉ brahmamārāyarum jayatuṅkappallavaraiyarum tillaiyampalappallavaraiyarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyil śrīmāheśvara kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum śrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum sāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilṉāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇ(ṭ)ṭu viṭutantatāvatu ■koyilukkum tirukkāmakkoṭṭamuṭaiya periyanācciyārkkum cāttiaruḷa tirucceṅkaḻunirt tirupaḷḷittāmamākka perumāḷ tiruvoṭai eṉṉum perāl ceykiṟa tiruvoṭaikku perumpaṟṟappuliyūrt teṉpiṭākai puvalokamāṇikkavaḷanāṭṭu koppāṭiyāṉa kaṇapatinallūrppāl coḻamātevivatikku meṟkum śrīdevivāykkālukkut teṟkum aiñcāṅ kaṇṇāṟṟu ṉālāñ catirattu teṉkiḻ kaṇṭattu vācciyaṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉ comaṉpakkal vācciyaṉ etirilāpperumāḷ tiruvalañcuḻiyuṭaiyāṉperil kācu āyirattaiññūṟṟukku vilaikoṇṭa kuḻi aiññūṟ ṟorupattiraṇṭum ivvūril ikkaṇṇāṟṟu iccatirattu uḻaiccāṇaṉ koṟṟaṉ kovaṉpakkal meṟpaṭiyāṉperilk kācu āyirat taiññūṟṟukku vilaikoṇṭa kuḻi aiññūṟ ṟorupattiraṇṭum ākak kācu muvāyirattukku vilaikoṇṭa kuḻi āyirat tirupattunāliṉāl ūrppaṭi nilam eṭṭumā innilam eṭṭumāviṉāl virivunilam araiye kāṇi iṉnilam araiye kāṇiyum aiñcāvatu mutal tirucceṅkaḻunī riṭṭut tiruppūmaṇṭapattu mutalāka eṇṇavum iṉṉilam vilaikoṇṭa sādhanaṅkaḷum innilattukku maṭaṅku kaḻitta ūravar eḻutiṉa niyogaṅkaḷum tirukkaiy oṭṭip paṇṭārattup pukaviṭṭu etiriṭai iṭṭu ippaṭikkut tirumāḷikaiyile kal veṭṭappaṇṇuvate ■ ivai coḻako ṉeḻuttu eṉṟum pukunta ēvalttiṭṭiṉpaṭi kal veṭṭiyatu ■
svasti śrī ■ cakalapuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ avaniyāḷappiṟantārāṉa śrīkopperuñciṅkadevarkku yāṇṭu muṉṟāvatu nāḷ eṇpattoṉṟu coḻako ṉolai ■ teṉṉavaṉ pirammārāyarum maturāntaka viḻupparaiyarum uṭaiyārtirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyil śrīmāheśvarak kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum cikāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum cāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum paṇṭārappottaka muṭaiyārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇṭu viṭutantatāvatu ■ vikkiramaciṅkapurattu melpuṟattil ceyvitta āḷiyār tiruttoppil maraṅkaḷāākkavum ittiruttoppil palākkāy vāḻaikkāy paḻaṅkaḷ uḷḷiṭṭaṉa tirumaṭaippaḷḷip paṇṭārattukku mutalāka eṭukkavum toppukkuṭikaḷāka aimpatu āḷ mutalkoḷḷavum ivāḷukku iraṇṭumāvāka nūṟumā nilam ivvūr eriyālum mutalaipāṭieriyālum nīrpāyum nilattile muṉṟāvatu āṉimāāta mutal aṭaittuk kuṭukkappaṇṇuva teṉṟu tevar tiruveḻuttuccāttiṉa tirumukam vantamaiyil āḷiyārtiruttop peṉṉum perāl ceyta tiruttoppukku nāṟpatteṭṭu āḷum iraṇṭu nāyakamum āka aimpatu āḷmuṉṟāvatu nāḷ eḻupatumutal mutalkoḷḷavum ipperkku ilakkaikkum koṟṟukkum cerkkacciyaṉ kamukutirunantavaṉak kuṭikaḷ peṟṟuvarukiṟapaṭiye nāyakapper iraṇṭukku koṟṟukku per oṉṟukku nāḷ oṉṟukku mukkuṟuṇiyāka vanta nellum puṭavaimutal āṭṭaikkup perāl muṉṟāka vanta kācum per nāṟpatteṇvarkku koṟṟukkup per oṉṟukku nāḷ oṉṟukku patakkāka vanta nellum puṭavaimutal āṭṭaikkup perāl iraṇṭāka vanta kācum innāḷmutal peṟṟu ittiruttoppil maraṅkaḷumākki ittiruttoppil palākkāy vāḻaikkāy paḻaṅkaḷ uḷḷiṭṭaṉa tirumaṭaippaḷḷip paṇṭārattukku mutalāka eṭukkavuṅ kaṭavarkaḷākavum ivarkaḷukkuk koṟṟukkuṭaiya nellukkum puṭavaimutal kācukku kācu oṉṟukku patiṉaiṅkalappaṭiyāl vanta nellukkum ivvūril iṭṭa nilam nūṟumāvum ivarkaḷukku aṭaittukkuṭukkavum ippaṭikkuk kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ tirumāḷikaip puṟavāyile kalveṭṭavuṅ kaṭavatākavum paṇṇuvate ■ ivai coḻakoṉ eḻutteṉṟu vanta evaṟtiṭṭiṉpaṭi kal veṭṭiyatu ■
svasti śrī ■ cakalapuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ avaniyāḷappiṟantārāṉa śrīkopperuñciṅkadevarkku yāṇṭu muṉṟāvatu nāḷ eṇpattoṉṟu coḻakoṉōlai ■ teṉṉavaṉ pirammārāyarum maturāntakaviḻupparaiyarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyil śrīmāheśvara kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷumcikāriyañceyvārkaḷum cāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum paṇṭārappottaka muṭaiyārkaḷuṅ kaṇakkaruṅ kaṇṭu viṭutantatāvatu ■ koyilukkum tirukkāmakkoṭṭamuṭaiya periyanācciyār koyilukkum pālamutu ceytaruḷavum pāṟpoṉakap pālukkum kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ tirukkocālai aṇukkaṉ curavikaḷukku mutalāka iṣapamum tiruccūlamuñ cāttit tirukkocālai yiṭaiyarkku mutalāka muṉṟāvatu nāḷ aṟupattāṟināl viṭṭa pacu nāṉūṟ ṟorupatiṉāl uru oṉṟukku celavirācakecariyāl uḻakkāka nāḷoṉṟukku pāl kalaṉe aṟunāḻiuriyumviṭṭu amutuceytaruḷavum muṉpu nivantakkaṭṭuppaṭi viṭṭu amutu ceytaruḷi vanta pāllile ippāl kalaṉe aṟunāḻi uriyum viṭukai tavirntu ippālukku muṉpi lāṇṭukaḷum ney oṭṭukoṇṭu varumpaṭiye ney mutalkoṇṭu tirumaṭaippaḷḷip paṇṭārattukku mutalāka aḷakkavum intap pacukkaḷukku pacu nūṟṟaimpatukku per oṉṟāka vanta per mutalkoḷḷavum ipperkku koṟṟukku per oṉṟukku nāḷ oṉṟukku patakkāka vanta nellum puṭavaimutal āṭṭaikkup perāl oṉṟaraiyāka vanta kācukkup patiṉaiṅkalappiṭiyāl vanta nellum palapaṇi nivantakkāṟarkku jīvitam aṭaikkumpaṭiye jivitam aṭaikkavum periyatevarkku muṉṟāvatu kuṭutta pacu eṇṇūṟ ṟeḻupatum nālāvatu kuṭutta pacu irunūṟṟorupattāṟum ākat tirumañcaṉattukku āṭiyaruḷa veṇṇaiurukku neykkum pāluk kuṭalākavum tevakoṉpacu āyiratteṇpattāṟiṉāl uru oṉṟukku celvirācakecariyāl uḻakkāka aḷantuvarukiṟa pāl irukalaṉe irutūṇik kuṟuṇi eḻunāḻi uriyum ākap pacu āyirattunāṉūṟṟut toṇṇūṟṟāṟum viṭṭapaṭikku kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ tirumāḷikaip puṟavāyilile kal veṭṭavuṅ kaṭavatākavum paṇṇuvate ■ ivai coḻakoṉ eḻutteṉṟu vanta evarṟtiṭṭiṉpaṭi kal veṭṭiyatu ■
� svasti śrī ■ sakalapuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīkopperuñciṅkadevaṟku yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu nāḷ irunūṟ ṟaṟupattiraṇṭu coḻakoṉ olai ■ teṉṉavaṉ brahmamārāyarum maturāntakaviḻupparaiyarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyilśrīmā heśvarak kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum śrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum sāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum paṇṭārappottaka muṭaiyārkaḷum kaṇakkaruṅ kaṇṭu viṭutantatāvatu ■ koyillukkumtirukkāmakkoṭṭamuṭaiya periyanācciyārkkum vecālippāṭippaṟṟu pūvālaiyil cokkacciyaṉ kamukutirunantavaṉattukku tirunantavaṉañ ceyya mutal koṇṭa nāyakam per aiñcum per teṇṇūṟṟaiñcum ākap per nūṟṟuvarkku ilakkaikkum koṟṟukkum ivvūril aṭaitta nilam irunūṟṟu nāṟpat teḻumā araikkāṇiyiṉāl nellu āṟāyirattu toḷāyirat torupatteṇ kalaṉe irutūṇik kuṟuṇiyum patiṉaiñcāvatu nāḷ irunūṟ ṟaṟupat tiraṇṭumutal antarāyam pāṭṭam uḷppaṭa iṟaiyiliyāka iṭṭut tevar tiruveḻuttuc cāttiaruḷiṉa tirumukam vantamaiyil cokkacciyaṉeṉṉum tirunāmattāl ceyta kamukutirunantavaṉattukkum cuṟṟukkulaikkum vecālippāṭināṭṭuk kuṟuñci aḷanāṭṭut tevatāṉam ciṟupālaiyūrppāl pūntamaṅkalattum irājādhirājavaḷanāṭṭu kuṟuñci aḷanāṭṭut tevatāṉam tāmaraiyāṉpāṭiyāṉa veḷaṅkaṉpaṭṭilum veḷḷāṟṟukku melkaraippaṭṭa tuṇṭattum kūṭiṉa nilattuk kamukutaṟaiyum cuṟṟukkulaiyum uḷppaṭa virivu nilam aṟupattumuṉṟumā mukkāṇi kīḻ mukkālum nīṅkalākavum ittirunantavaṉañ ceyya veṇṭum perāy niccayitta nāyakam per aiñcum per toṇṇūṟṟaiñcum ākap per nūṟu itil nāyakam per aivarkku koṟṟukku nāḷ oṉṟukku per oṉṟukku mukkuṟuṇiyāka nellu kalaṉe mukkuṟuṇiyum puṭavaimutal āṭṭaikku perāl muṉṟākak kācu patiṉaiñcum per toṇṇūṟṟaivarkku koṟṟukku nāḷ oṉṟukku po oṉṟukku nellu patakkāka nellu patiṉaiṅkalaṉe irutūṇip patakkum puṭavaimutal āṭṭaikkup perāl kācu iraṇṭāka kācu nūṟṟuttoṇṇūṟum ākap per nūṟṟuvarkku koṟṟukku nāḷ oṉṟukku nellu patiṉeḻu kalaṉe kuṟuṇiyum āka āṭṭaikku uṭaiya nellukkum puṭavaimutal āṭṭaikku kācu irunūṟṟaiñcukkum kācu oṉṟukku patiṉaiṅkalappaṭiyāl vanta nellukkum tevatāṉamāṉa ūrkaḷil palapaṇi nivantakkāṟarkku cīvitamaṭaikkumpaṭiyāluḷḷa nellukku vecālippāṭippaṟṟu jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻaccaruppetimaṅkalattuk kīḻpiṭākai pūvālaicuntaracoḻanallūril patiṉaiñcāvatu nāḷ irunūṟ ṟaṟuppattiraṇṭu mutal antarāyam pāṭṭam uḷppaṭa tevatāṉa iṟaiyili iṭṭa nilam irunūṟṟu nāṟpatteḻumā varaikkāṇikku māttāl nellu irupatteṇ kalamāka nellu āṟāyirattu toḷāyirat torupat toṉpatiṉ kalaṉe tūṇip patakkum ākat tirunantavaṉattaṟai uḷppaṭa nilam eḻupatteḻaraiye nāṉmā varai muntirikaik kīḻmukkāliṉāl virivu nilam muṉṉūṟ ṟorupatumā mukkāṇi araikkāṇik kiḻmukkālum antarāyam pāṭṭa muḷppaṭa tevatāṉa iṟaiili iṭṭamaikku kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ tirumāḷikaiyil puṟavāyile kal veṭṭikkoḷḷakkaṭavatākap paṇṇuvate ■ kamukutaṟaiyum cuṟṟukkulaiyumnilam aṟupattumuṉṟumā mukkāṇik kiḻmukkālum tirunantavaṉakkuṭikaḷukku jivitam aṭaitta nilam irunūṟṟu nāṟpatteḻumā araikkāṇiyiṉāl nellu āṟāyirattut toḷāyirattu orupattoṉpatiṉ kalaṉe tūṇi patakkukkum ■ ivai coḻakoṉ eḻuttueṉṟu vanta evaṟtiṭṭuppaṭi kal veṭṭiyatu ■

tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyiṟ śrīmāheśvarak kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum śrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum sāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum paṇṭārappottaka muṭaiyārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇṭu viṭutantatāvatu ■ koyilukkum tirukkāmakkoṭṭamuṭaiya periyanācciyārkkum ciṟappākac cāttiaruḷacoḻakoṉār perumpaṟṟappuliyūrp piṭākai paḷḷippaṭaiyāṉa vikkiramacoḻanallūril palavaravaiyāṉa nilattuc ceyvitta ceṅkaṉivāyaṉ tirunantavaṉattaṟaikku pratikṣetramākavum ittirunantavaṉañ ceyya veṇṭum perāy ivar niccayitta nāyakam per iraṇṭum per muppattunālum tiruppūmaṇṭapattu tiruppaḷḷittāman toṭukkum per iraṇṭum āka per muppatteṇvarkkum ilakkaikkum koṟṟukkum virudharājapayaṅkaravaḷanāṭṭu śrīvīranārāyaṇaccaturvvetimaṅkalattu vaṭapiṭākai maturāntakanallūril ivar vilaikoṇṭu tirunāmattukkāṇiyākat tirukkaioṭṭip paṇṭārattuk kuṭutta pramāṇappaṭi nilamāy pāṭikāval veḷḷāṉveṭṭi antarāyam pāṭṭam uḷppaṭa tevatāṉa iṟaiyiliyāka iṭṭa tiṟappu kārmaṟu nilam muppattāṟumā mukkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻaraiye mummā varaiyiṉāl nellu āyirattu nāṉūṟ ṟoṉpatiṉkalaṉe aiṅkuṟuṇi irunāḻi uri yāḻākkum orupū nilam araikkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻoṉpatumā varaiye araikkāṇiyiṉāl nellu nāṟkalaṉe eḻukuṟuṇi eḻunāḻiyum āka kārmaṟuvum orupūvum nilam muppatteḻumā muntirikaik kiḻ muṉṟumā varaikkāṇiyiṉāl nelluāyirattu nāṉūṟ ṟorupattunāṟ kalaṉe kuṟuṇi irunāḻi uri āḻākku itil ittirunantavaṉattaṟaikku pratikṣetramākak kuṭutta nilam paṉṉiraṇṭu māviṉāl nellu nāṉūṟṟu aṟupattoru kalaṉe aiññāḻi nikki ittirunantavaṉakkuṭikaḷukku ilakkaikkum koṟṟukkum uṭalāṉa nilam irupattañcumā muntirikaik kiḻ muṉṟumā varaikkāṇiyiṉāl nellut toḷāyirat taimpattumukkalaṉe nāṉāḻi uriyum āka nilam muppatteḻumā muntirikaik kiḻ muṉṟumā varaikkāṇiyiṉāl nellu āyirattu nāṉūṟ ṟorupattunāṟkalaṉe kuṟuṇi irunāḻi uriyum tirunāmattukkāṇiyum tevatāṉa iṟaiyiliyumāy antarāyam pāṭṭam uḷppaṭa iṟaiyiliyākavum nikki ittirunantavaṉakkuṭikaḷukku aṭaikkaveṇṭum nellu āyirat teḻunūṟṟu nāṟpat taṟukalaṉe irutūṇi mukkuṟuṇimuṉṉāḻi svasti śrī ■ kovicaiya kampavanmaṟki yāṇṭu pattoṉpatāvatu tiruvoṟṟiyūrppuṟattu maṇali sabhaiyom nilavilaiyāvaṇa ■ memmur yāṅkaḷ viṟkiṉṟa nilattiṟkukkiḻpāṟkellai poruḷāpperiuṭaiya toṇayaṉār ceṟuviṉ svasti śrī ■ sakalabhuvaṉacakravattikaḷ śrī kopperuñciṅkatevar kkulaaḻakiyapallavarāṉa virapratāpar pocaḷarkaḷaiyum ciṟaikoṇṭaruḷip pāṇṭiyarkaḷait tiṟaikoṇṭaruḷi miṇṭu eḻuntaruḷic coḻamaṇṭalam pāttaruḷik kāveriāṟṟukkut teṉkaraiye kiḻakkunokki eḻuntaruḷi tiruppatikaḷḷellām kumpiṭṭaruḷi tevatāṉaṅkaḷum tiruviṭaiyāṭṭaṅkaḷum iṟaiyili viṭṭaruḷit tiruppaṇikaḷ ellāmceyvittaruḷi jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻavaḷaṉāṭṭu brahmade ......... le eḻun taruḷip pukuntaruḷi immaṇṭalam paṟṟaṭaitta ivarkaḷ nāṭu ceytapaṭi .. pāllā.ai ... le aḻintu kiṭanta paṭiyaiykkaṇṭaruḷi immaṇṭalattukku neṭuṅkoṭi kācu cikai iḻantaruḷi ināṭṭukku irupattu nālukoṭi kācucikai iḻantaruḷi neṭuṅkālaṅ kiṭanta kuṟaikaḷai veṭṭiviṭṭaruḷik kāruṇya m paṇṇi aruḷi tecāntiraṅkaḷiṟpoṉa ivarkaḷ tantām ūrkaḷum kāṇikaḷum maṉaikaḷum peṟukaveṉṟu tiru vuḷḷamāṉapaṭiyāle keṅkai pariyantamākap poṉa jaṉaṅkaḷ nerākap pukuntu tantām ūrkaḷum kāṇikaḷum peṟṟu oru kuṟaikaḷ aṟa irukkumpaṭi ceytaruḷiṉār aḻakiyapallavarāṉa virapratāpar ■ ippaṭiye rakṣittaruḷa veṇum ■

svasti śrī ■■ sakalabhuvaṉaccakravatti kaḷ śrīavaṉiāḷappiṟantārāṉa kopperuñciṅkatevaṟku yāṇṭu pattāvatu coḻakoṉ olai ■ teṉṉavaṉbrahmamārāyarum jayatuṅkappallavaraiyarum tillaiampalappallavaraiyarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyil śrīmāheśvara kkaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷumśrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum sāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇṭu viṭu tantatāvatu ■ nāyakar tirukkaṭalukku eḻuntaruḷum vikkiramacoḻaṉ teṅkuttiruvitit teṉpakkattu eḻuntaruḷivitta piṭāri tirucciṟṟampalamākāḷi śrīkoyilum tirumuṟṟamum tirumaṭaviḷākattilum akappaṭṭa paḷḷippaṭaiyāṉa vikkiramacoḻanallūril cuntaracoḻavatikkuk kiḻakkuk kaṇṭarātittavāykkālukkut teṟku muṉṟāṅkaṇṇāṟṟu mutaṟ catirattilum ivvatikku meṟku ivvāykkālukkut teṟku muṉṟāṅkaṇṇāṟṟu mutaṟ catirattilum kūṭṭiṉa nilam nilavaravu kūṭṭapperumakkaḷum kaṇkāṇikkuk kaṭavārum aḷantu kaṇṭa kuḻi nūṟṟunāṟpate mukkāle araikkālukkut talai māṟu ■ ikkaṭṭaḷaiyil vāraṇavāci mahātevar koyiltāṉattār pakkal intat tirucciṟṟam palamākāḷi caṇḍeśvarapperuvilai koṇṭa ivvatikkuk kiḻakku ivvāykkālukkut teṟku muṉṟāṅkaṇṇāṟṟu mutaṟ catirattu inta vāraṇavāci mahādevar tirukkuḷattukkum tirunantavaṉattukkum tirumaṭaviḷākattu vāṉiḷavaṟitikkuk kiḻakkum inta vikkiramacoḻaṉ teṅkutiruviti ellaikkut teṟkum kūttāṭu nāyakaṉ tiruvoṭai melai ellaikkulaikku meṟkum inta vāraṇavāci mahādevar tevatāṉa viḷainilattukku vaṭakkum naṭuvupaṭṭakuḻi nūṟṟunāṟpattoṉṟum pattāvatu siṁhanāyaṟṟu oṉpatān tiyati mutal ikkoyiṟ kāṇiuṭaiya pāracavaṉ tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉāṉa kanakasabhāpati paṇḍitaṉ eḻuttiṭṭut tanta sādhaṉappaṭiye pratikṣetramākak kaikkoṇṭu ituvum iṉṉilam vilaikoṇṭa pramāṇaṅkaḷum iṉṉilam ūrmāviyntakaṭamai kuṭimai kaḻiyap perumpaṟṟappuliyūr mulaparuṣaiyār eḻutiṉa niyokamum tirukkai oṭṭip paṇṭārattile oṭukkavum ■ ippaṭikku vikkiramacoḻaṉ tirumāḷikaip puṟavāyil vaṭakkil tirumāḷikaiyile kal veṭṭavum paṇṉuvate ■ ivai coḻakoṉ eḻutteṉṟu pukunta evaṟttiṭṭuppaṭi kal veṭṭiyatu ■ itu tevartirumeṉikku naṉṟākap perumāḷpiḷḷaiyāṉa coḻakoṉār ceyvittatu ■■
svasti śrī ■ sakalabhuvanaccakravattikaḷ śrī avaṉiāḷappiṟantārāṉa kopperuñciṅkatevarkku yāṇṭu pattāvatu coḻakoṉ olai ■ teṉṉavaṉbrahmamārāyarrum jayatuṅkappallavaraiyarum tillai ampalappallavaraiyarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyil śrīmaraheśvarak kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum śrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷumsāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇṭu viṭu tantatāvatu ■ tirukkāmakkoṭṭamuṭaiya periyanācciyār koyil antappurapperumāḷ tiruvācalukku vaṭapakkattu eḻuntaruḷiirukkum aṇṭāparaṇatevarkkut tiruppaṇṇikārappuṟamākavum ciṟappākat tiruttoḷmālai ceytu cātta tirunantavaṉamum tirunantavaṉañ ceytu ivar tiruppūmaṇṭapattil tiruppaḷḷittāmam aḷappārkku jivaṉattukkum perumpaṟṟappuliyūrp piṭākai nallāliyāṉavikkiramacoḻanallūril śrīcuntaracoḻavatikkuk kiḻakku irājarājavāykkālukku vaṭakku āṟāṅkaṇṇuṟṟu iraṇṭāñ catirattu caṭaiyaṉ koṇṭuviṭṭa viḷainilamum kollaiyumūrppaṭi ṉilam eḻumāvum iṅke nirurimaikkuk koṇṭa kuḻi nāṟpattaiñcum koyilpūṇṭiyāṉa kṣatriyacikāmaṇinallūrppāl śrīcuntaracoḻavatikkuk kiḻakku rājarājavāykkālukkut teṟku nālāṅkaṇṇuṟṟu muṉṟāñ catirattum nālāñ catirattum aṟputar koṇṭu viṭṭa kuḻi nūṟum vaṭakkilkuḷattil irupatu kūṟiṭṭa orukūṟṟāluḷḷa kuḷamum intakkuḷavopāti nirurimaiyum tevatāṉam jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻapaṭṭiṉattup piṭākai aḷakkuṭiyil ampalavatikkuk kiḻakku jayaṅkoṇṭa coḻavāykkālukku vaṭakku iraṇṭāṅkaṇṇāṟṟumuṉṟāñ catirattu commukaṉ aḻakiya tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyāṉum viḷakkāḻvāṉum kāciṭṭu ivar tirunāmattu vilaikoṇṭa viḷainilamum kollaiyum kuḻi eḻunūṟṟaimpatum uḷpaṭa ivvūrppaṭikaḷ nilaṅkaḷ vilaikoṇṭapramāṇaṅkaḷum iṉṉilaṅkaḷil ūrmāviynta kaṭamai kuṭimai kaḻiyap perumpaṟṟappuliyūr mulaparuṣaiyār eḻutiṉa niyokamum jayaṅkoṇṭacoḻapaṭṭiṉattār eḻutiṉa niyokamum tirukkaioṭṭip paṇṭārattu oṭukki inta aṇṭāparaṇatevar koyilile kalveṭṭavum paṇṇuvate ■ ivai coḻakoṉ eḻuttu eṉṟu pukunta evaṟtiṭṭuppaṭi kal veṭṭiyatu ■

svasti śrī ■■ sakalabhuvaṉacakravattikaḷ avaṉiyāḷappiṟantārāṉa kopperuñciṅkatevarkku yāṇṭu pattoṉpatāvatu coḻakoṉ olai ■ teṉṉavaṉbrahmamārāyarum jayatuṅkappallavarayarum kurukulattarayarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyārkoyil śrīmāheśvarak kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum śrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum sāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilnāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷikaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇṭu viṭu tantatāvatu ■ koyilukkum tirukkāmakkoṭṭamuṭaiya periyanācciyārkkum vecālippāṭippāṟṟu pūpālacuntaracoḻanallūrril ceyvitta cokkacciyaṉ kamuku tirunantavaṉam nilam aṟupattu muṉṟumā mukkāṇikkiḻ mukkālum cokkac ciyaṉ kolāl aḷanta iṭattu ittirunantavaṉattu cuṟṟukkulaik kuṭpaṭṭatu patiṉāṟumā varaikkāṇi muntirikaik kiḻkkāl nilam aḷaveṟṟa muṇṭākaiyāle innilattukku pati ṉeṭṭāvatuvaraiyum kaṭamaiyākak kūṭṭiṉa kācu tavirvatākavum innilam uṭpaṭa eṇpatumā nilamum tirunantavaṉamāvatākavum tirumāḷikaiyile kalluveṭṭivippatākat tevar >tiru mukam vantamaiyil ittirumukam tirukkaioṭṭip paṇṭārattile kottukkoṇṭu tirumukap paṭiye aḷaveṟṟamāṉa nilam patiṉāṟu māvaraikkāṇi muttirikaik kiḻkālum uṭpaṭa eṇpatu mā nilamum tirunantavaṉa māvatāka muṉpu periyatevarkkup patiṉaiñcāvatu nāḷil ittirunantavaṉattukkut tirumāḷikaiyil kalveṭṭiṉa iṭattile kallu veṭṭivikkavum kaṭavatākap paṇṉuvate ■ ivai coḻakoṉ eḻuttu eṉṟu eḻutip pukunta evaṟtiṭṭuppaṭi kalluveṭṭiyatu ■

svasti śrī ḷa sakalabhuvaṉaccakravattikaḷ śrī avaṉiāḷappiṟantārāṉa kopperuñciṅkatevaṟku yāṇṭu muppattāṟāvatu veṇāṭuṭaiyāṉ olai ■ teṉṉavaṉpirammārāyarum jayatuṅkappallavaraiyarum tillaiampalappallavaraiyarum uṭaiyār tirucciṟṟampalamuṭaiyār koyil śrīmāheśvara kaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷumśrīkāriyañ ceyvārkaḷum cāmutāyañ ceyvārkaḷum koyilṉāyakañ ceyvārkaḷum tirumāḷi kaikkūṟu ceyvārkaḷum paṇṭārappottakamuṭaiyārkaḷum kaṇakkarum kaṇṭu viṭu tantatā vatu ■ nāyakar tiruttereḻuntaruḷumpotu tiruppuṟakkuṭaiyil adhyayaṉam paṇṇi cevikkavum nāyakar kulottuṅkacoḻaṉ tiruttoppil eṟiaruḷiṉāl svasticolli cevikkavum ittiruttoppil tirumañcaṇam paṇṇi aruḷumpotu adhyayaṉam paṇṇavum divasaṅkaḷukku piḷḷaiyār civapātacekaraṉ cittaittuṇaipperumāḷ etirili coḻaṉ tirunantavaṉattu tiruppālikai valañceyya eḻuntaruḷiṉāl mṛtgrahaṇam paṇṇavum etirilicoḻaṉ tirunantavaṉattu melpakkattu tillaināyakaccaruppetimaṅkalam eṉṉum tirunāmattāl tiruvaiyāṟuṭaiyār vaitta akarattu brāhmaṇarkkup perum paṟṟappuliyūrp piṭākaikaḷil ivar palar pakkalilum vilaikoṇṭu kuṭutta nilamum inta brāhmaṇar palar pakkalum dānamāka peṟṟa nilamum uḷppaṭa nilam oṉpataraiyum ampala nāyakap perunteruvil tirunāvukkaracu teṉtirumaṭattu uṭaiyār aḻakiya tiruvaiyāṟuṭaiyār tirukkoyil kiḻpakkattu mukakkaṭṭaṇattu eḻuntaruḷi irukkum kulottuṅkacoḻa viṉāyakappiḷḷaiyārai rācākkaḷtampirāṉ tiruvitiyil nāyakar eḻuntaruḷit tirukkaṇ cātti aruḷum nāṭkkaḷil tirukkāṭcci cevikkavum tiruppaṇṇikāram amutu ceyyavum ivarkoṇṭu viṭṭa nilam araiyum āka nilam patiṟṟiveliyum mulaparuḻaiyār eḻutiṉa mahāsabhāniyokappaṭiye koyil kuṭimai tiruvaraṅku viniyokam paḻavarici uḷḷiṭṭaṉa tavirvatākavum vikkiramacoḻaṉ tirumāḷikaiyil koṟṟaṅkuṭiyil irumarapuntuyyaperumāḷ caruppetimaṅkalattu brāhmaṇarkku kalveṭṭiṉa iṭattukku aruke kalveṭṭavumaṭavatākap paṇṇuvate ■ ivai veṇāṭuṭaiyāṉ eḻuttu eṉṟu pukunta evaṟtiṭṭiṉpaṭi kalveṭṭiyatu ■

varivaḷaipolam pūṇkoṭutta maṅkaiyar mayaluṟa maṉantāṉ tuṭakkukiṉṟaṉa matikati riraṇṭāṅkeṉac ciṟantoḷir vayiramu micaintāṅ kiṭappicaintaṉa parimaḷataḷantāṉ camaitta kuṅkuma parivoṭu pacuñcān teḻakkamaḻntaṉa palikoḷa virantāṅ kumikka ciṅkaḷar paravaiyil viḻuntāṅkeṭat tuṭarntaṉa karipari uṭaṉ cernteṭutta kaṅkarkaḷ karuvarai yiṭantāṉ pukakkaṭantaṉa kaṉaleṉa vukantāṉ cuṭattuṭaṅkiya kalivali pelantāṉ pukatturantaṉa varipeṟa virantāṉ taṭakkai oṉṟiṉi lakaliṭa mukantām puṉaṟcorintaṉa varacarai neṭuñcāṅkiṭak kaikoṇṭaṉa aḻakiya vaḷantāṉ tiruppuyaṅkaḷe■■itu vaḷantāṉārāṉa kāṭavarāyar kavi ■■

svasti śrī ■ kovirājakecaripanmarkku yāṇṭu munṟāvatu puliyūrkkoṭṭattu neṭuṅkuṉṟa nāṭṭu māṭampākkamākiya aṇitiramaṅkalattuc cavaiyom coṇāṭṭu vaṭakaraip poykaināṭṭu alaiyūr nakkan pirān=takanākiya brammaśrīrājan kaiyyāl yāṅkaḷ koṇṭu kaṭava pon ūrkaṟc cemmai pon patinaiṅkaḻañcu ip pon patiṉaiṅ kaḻañcukkum policainicatam uḻakkeṇṇaiyāka āmurkkoṭṭattup paṭuvūrnāṭṭu tevartāna n=tiruviṭavantait tevarkku vaiytta tirunan=tāviḷakkonṟinukku nicatam uḻakkeṇṇaiyāka āṭṭaiviṭṭam toṇṇūṟṟu nāḻi neyyeṇṇai muṭṭāme koṭuvan=tucantrārātittavaṟ aṭṭuvom mānom aṇitiramaṅkalattuc cavaiyom itaṟ ṟiṟampil tanmāsanatte nicatam eṭṭekāṟ kāṇa n=taṇṭappaṭuvatākavum anṟāḷ kovukku nicata mañcāṭip pon manṟupāṭu iṟuppomākavum ippon iṟuttum ivveṇṇai tiruvuṇṇāḻikaivāriyap perumakkaḷ kaikkoṇṭerippomānom ippaṭi oṭṭi iṭṭuk kuṭuttom tiruviṭavantai śavaiyom ittanmam śrī vayiṣṇavarakṣai ■

svasti śrī ■ kovirācakesarippanmarkku yāṇṭu 3■vatu vaṭakarai nalvayalūrkkūṟṟattu devatānam uṟumurc ciṟuttirukkoyil perumāṉaṭikaḷukku ivvūr āritaṉkaṇṇaṉ kaṇṇaṉ tiruvamurtukku kuṭutta nilam mārāyampaḷḷamākiya kaṇattāḷ kiḻpālkkellai uḻaiccāṇaṉ tattaṉ mātevaṉ nilattukku melkkum teṉppālkkellai kaṭampāṟṟukkupāyñca vāykkālukku vaṭakkum melpālkkellai āṉāṟṟukkukiḻakku vaṭapālkkellai ēṟivāykkālukku teṟkkum ivvicainta perunāṉkellai uḷ mikitikkuṟaivuḷḷaṭaṅka nilamēḻumā itu uḻu(t)tup payireṟṟikkoṇṭu nicatam nāṉāḻi araciyāl oru tiruvamurtuk kāṭṭak kaṭavār intat tirukkoyil upāsakaṉ inta tiruvamurtu kāṭṭuvikkakkaṭavom sabhaiom itu panmāheśvarar rakṣai ■
svasti śrī ■ kovirājakecarivaṉmaṟkku yāṇṭu 3■āvatu teṉkarai ..... yomum kaviranāṭṭu eṟumpiyūr ūromum viṟṟukkuṭutta nilavilaiyāvaṇam ■ kiḷiyūrnāṭṭuc ciṟutavvūruṭaiyāṉ veḷāṉ viranārāyaṇaṉ ..... kuṭutta nilamāvatu eṅkaḷil simāvivātamāyk kiṭanta nilam ivarkkuviṟṟukkuṭutta nilattuk kiḻpāṟkkellai tirumalavāyk kecuva ṉakkaṉum ... teṉpāṟ kellai eṟumpiyūrk kuḷaṅkarai irukol nikki itukku vaṭakku mipāṟkellai iśrīkaṇṭa .......... ḻellaiyāka nāṭṭiṉ cūlakkallukkuk kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai tevatāṉattukkut teṟkku ......... kellaikku naṭuvupaṭṭa ....... emmilicainta vilaipporuḷ vilaiyāvaṇakkaḷiye kaiccella aṟakkoṇṭu ittiruveṟumpiyūrāḷvāṟkkāka iccempiyaṉ vetiveḷāriṭai vilaiyāvaṇakkaḷiye vilaipporu ḷaṟakkoṇṭu viṟṟu vilaiyāvaṇañ ceytu kuṭuttom cempiyaṉ vetiveḷārkku śrīkaṇṭaścaturvvetimaṅkalattu peruṅkuṟi sabhaiyomum eṟumpiyūr ūromum ivviraṇṭu tiṟattom innilattukku ituve vilaiyāvaṇamum poruḷmāvaṟutipporuṭcelavolaiyu mituve yākavum ituvallatu veṟu poruṇmāvaṟutipporuṭ celavu kāṭṭakkaṭavatallātatākavum ipparicoṭṭi viṟṟukkuṭutta innilattukkuiṟaikāvalukku veṇṭum poṉṉum ivviraṇṭu tiṟattomum koṇṭu innilattukku iṟaiyu meccoṟum veṭṭivetiṉaiyuñ cantirātittavaṟ nāṅkaḷe iṟuppomāṉom ivariṭaiye dravyaṅ koṇṭu vilaikkaṟa viṟṟup poruḷaṟak koṇṭu viṟṟu vilaiyāvaṇañ ceytu kuṭuttoñ cempiyaṉ vetiveḷārkku śrīkaṇṭaccaturvvetimaṅkalattup peruṅkuṟi sabhaiyomum eṟumpiyūrūromum ivviraṇṭu tiṟattomum iṉnilattukku śrīkaṇṭaścaturvvetimaṅkalattu kuḷattāre nirkkintavāṟu kumuḻiya ... ttuñcā kumiḻi pāyappeṟuvatākavum eṟumpiyūrk kaḻaṉikkey vārappeṟuvatākavum ivvāvaṇappaṭiye tiruveṟumpiyūrt tirumalaimelāḷvārkku tevatāṉamākak kallilum veṭṭuvikkap peṟuvatākavum ipparicoṭṭi viṟṟukkuṭuttoñ cempiyaṉ vetiveḷārkku śrīkaṇṭaścaturvvetimaṅkalattup peṟuṅkuṟi sabhaiyomum eṟumpiyūr ūromum ivviraṇṭu tiṟattom perumakkaḷ paṇittaruḷavum vūrār collavum ivvilaiyāvaṇavolai eḻutiṉeṉ śrīkaṇṭaścaturvvetimaṅkalattu maddhyastaṉ dharmmapriyaṉāṉa ...... taruṇentucekaraṉeṉ ivai yeṉ eḻuttuippaṭi aṟiveṉ valavūr māppāni kāri svasti śrī ■ kovirājakecaripaṉmarkku yāṇṭu mūṉṟāvatu teṉkarai brahmateyam śrīkaṇṭaścaturvvetimaṅkalattup peruṅkuṟi ssabhaiyom ciritiruveṟumpiyūrāḻvāṟkku śrīvimāṉameṭuppitta ciṟutavūruṭaiyāṉ veḷāṉ viranāraṇaṉāṉa cempiyaṉ veytiveḷār tiruveṟumpiyūrāḻvāṟkut tiruppatiyampāṭuvāṟku nivan=tamāka ivaṟku viṟṟukkuṭutta nilamāvatu eṅkaḷūriṉ ṟeṉpāṭeyeṅkaḷ potunilattukku kiḻpāṟkellai tiruveṟumpiyūrāḷvār nilamnākarkālukku meṟkum teṉpāṟkellai nākarkālukku vaṭakku mipāṟkellai iccempiyaṉ veytiveḷār śrīmukaṅ kuṇantu kalli viṭṭa kiḷiyūr vāykkālukku kiḻakkum vaṭapāṟkellai ivvūr valavūr māppāni kāri nakka ṉilattukkum ittiruveṟumpiyūrāḷvār nilattukkut teṟkkum ivvicaitta perunāṉkellaiyu ḷakappaṭṭa ṉilam attuṇaiyilumittiruveṟumpiyūrāḷvāṟkku ivvūrt tirukkūr maṟṟakkā viṭṭa ṉāraṇaṉ puruṣottamaṉ niroṭaṭṭikkuṭutta nilamum muṉ ittiruveṟumpiyūrāḷvār nilamāṉa nilamum niykki niṉṟa nilam sabhaiyom sabhaippotuvāy kiṭanta nilam attuṇaiyumuṇṇila moḻiviṉṟi cempiyaṉ vetiveḷāṟku viṟṟukkuṭuttu nāṅkaḷ viṟṟukkuṭutta iṉnilattukku muṉ tevar kuṭivāram peṟṟa iṉnilattukkum muṉ ittevar nilattukku candrātittavalam iṟaikāvalākavum nāṅkaḷ viṟṟa nilattukku kreyadravyamum āka.. emmilicainta viṟaikāvaṟpoṉṉum kreyadravyamum vilaiyāvaṇakkaḷiye kaiccela aṟakkoṇṭu iṉnilattiṉmel sabhaiyom vaiyppināl valavūr māppāni kāri nakka nilat ....... ṉai iccempiyaṉ vetiveḷāre kuṭuttuc coṉṟu koḷḷakkaṭavarāka ipparicoṭṭic cantirātittavalam iṟaikāvalāka vilaikkaṟa viṟṟup poruḷaṟak koṇṭu viṟṟu vilaiyāvaṇañ ceytu kuṭuttom veḷāṉ viranāraṇaṉāṉa cempiyaṉ veytiveḷāṉukku śrīkaṇṭaccaturvetimaṅkalattup peruṅkuṟisabhaiyom peruṅkuṟi sabhaiyār paṇittaruḷa paṇiyāl ivvilaiyu miṟaikāvalu meḻutiṉeṉivvūr maddhyastaṉ dharmapriyaṉāṉa kalivicaiyaṉ taruṇentucekaraṉeṉ ivai yeṉṉeḻuttu ■■ iṉṉilamum śrīkaṇṭaccaturvetimaṅkalattārun tiruveṟumpiyūrārun taṅkaḷil sīmāvivātamāyk kiṭanta nilam ivviraṇṭu tiṟattāriṭaiyum nāṉ vilaikkuk koṇṭa nilamuṅ koṇṭu ivvāḻvārai nāṉ pāṭit tiruppatiyam muṉṟu sanniyu muḍukkaiyun tāḷamuṅ koṇṭu nālvar aṭikaḷmār tiruppatiyam pāṭuvatāka candrādittaval ceytukuṭutteṉ cempiyaṉ vetiveḷāneṉ itupaṉmāheśvara rakṣai ■■■■

śrī koccaṭaiyamāṟaṟku yāṇṭu patiṉāṟu ivvāṇṭu paḻaṅkarai iḻittu ataṉaṭiiṟ kallu nāṭṭi maṉṉumaṭaikku mekkuk karuṅkuḷattukkuk kiḻakku nilattiṭṭu karai ceytu maṭai vaiyppittu iruppaikkuṭikkiḻavaṉ taṉperiṭṭu eṟuvittatu ■ ivvellaiiṟ kiṭanta karai kiḻavaṉeri eṉpatu ■■koṅkār malark kaṭampu cūṭṭātik kolvaḷaiyai eṅkoṉiruppaikkuṭikkiḻavaṉ poṅkārnta toṭṭār karumpiraikkun toṉṉir vayaliruñcoḻanāṭṭāṉṟār cūṭṭu tireṉeṉṟu ■■
antaratti ṉoṭiyaṅkuñ cantirātittar vaḻit toṉṟī ṇṭiya perunteyvat tiṟaṟ pāṇṭiyar palar kaḻinta piṉṉai maṟṟavar taṅkulam viḷaṅka vantu toṉṟi maṇkāttukkuṇṇūr mutal ciṅkaḷam varai kūṭāta vayamaṉṉarai viṇṇūrp puka vekuṇṭu veṉṟikaḷey palaviḷaitta teṉṉavarko neṭumāṟaṉ centaṉik koṟ cirivallava ṉiṉṉaruḷāṟpal ciṟappoṭiruppaikkuṭik kiḻavaṉeṉṉun takkacīr naṉṉāmantāṉ peṟṟa eṭṭi cāttaṉṟirumakaḷuñ cennaṉmālaiyun tikaḻntilaṅku maṇippūṇu maruviya poṉvaraittoḷva ṉirait teṅkum varaik kamukoṭu karumpuyaruṅ kalikkaḻaṉik katirc cenneṟ kavarikāṭṭu miruñcoḻanāṭṭavar talaivaṉ peruñcāntikkula maṉṉavaṉ kūṭaṟkuṭi nakar taṉṉoṭu kuḷattūravar kulakkuricil viḻāmaliyum liyaṉṟeruviṟ ṟuḻāyūravar kuṭittoṉṟal poruppait tikaḻ maṇimāḷikai iruppaikkuṭitaṉak katipati kaḷiyaṉṉaṅ kiḷaipayir puṉal veḷiyaṉkuṭi viṟalāṇṭakai ñālaṅkaḷiṟ pukaḻuñ cirālaṅkuṭi ataṟkiṟaivaṉ coṉmāt taṇṭamiḻk kūṭaṟ kaṉmāttiṇ palakaimicai muṉṉeḻutiya kuṭittoṉṟaṉ maṇiyaraṇ malaiccilampaṉṉa payatta puṉaṉ malki nāṭṭavarkku vaḷañciṟakkum .... ccāṟivai taṉṉoṭu maṇimaṭantait taṭantuṟaivaṉavaṉe yec camaiyattavar tamakku viyalviṉ kaḷavirota miṉmaiyiṉ mūṉṟeṉṉum payaṉ maṟṟuṇ mutalākiya tāmmattai eṉṟataṉ cintaiyiṉāliyaviṅkaṭkitu naṉṟeṉa irukkocai kallimutalū riccuvaraṉ makiḻntuṟaiyun tirukkoyileṭuppittun teṉveḷiyaṉkuṭi nakaruṭ kaṟṟūṇ ceytampalattoṭu kaṟaikaṇṭa ṉuṟai koilu maṟai karumpu viḷaivaṟā aḻakamainta kiḻavaṉeriyu māṟaṉūrp peruṅkuḷattiḻit teṟuvitta kiḻavaṉeriyum poruppaṉaiya neṭumāṭam polin tilaṅka mukiṟaṇiyu miruppaikkuṭi vaḷanakaru ḷeṭuppitta perumpaḷḷiyum vaṭivamaittāṅ keṭuppitta maṇṭapatto ṭampalamum vaḷḷaikkuḷattiḻit teṟiya veḷḷappuṉaṟ kiḻavaṉeriyu māṅkataṉ kaṇmaṭaitaṉṉoṭu vāṅkamaitta pattaṉ maṭaiyuṅ kaṟpiḷanta kuḷavāyi lamaippitta iṟpaṇampu mernūliṭ ṭeṟuvittaṉ cirmevu tirumāleriyu nīriyaṉaṟ pukaḻneṟinaṭai eritaṉṉoṭa racaṅkuḷamum vaḻuvāmai iḻitteṟiṉa koḻuvūruṅ kiḻavaṉeriyun tikaḻoli nirppukaḻ maliyeriyoṭu ceṅkuḷamu nāṭiṉer tamakkillā moṭa ṉiyaṅku māṟaṉeriyum neṉmalimānakar taṉṉiṟ coṉmali kuṭiyaṭai yārc ce .. ntaḷūrāṉ piḷḷai muventaveḷārum arumoḻiteva vaḷanāṭṭu neṉmeli nāṭṭu miṉavaṉ nallūruṭaiyār puṟampiyaṉ paḷḷikoṇṭārāṉa aḻakiyapāṇṭiya muventa veḷārum nittaviṉota vaḷanāṭṭup pāmpuṇṇik kūṟṟattu vaḷavaṉ nallūruṭaiyār ni—ḷārum naṭuvirukkum kṣatriyacikāmaṇi vaḷanāṭṭu veḷānāṭṭu rājendracoḻaccaruppeti maṅkalattuc cāṇṭiliya kottirattuk kāttiyāyaṉa sūttirattu uppampirālac caṅkaraṉ colaip pirāṉ paṭṭaccomāciyārum evap puravuvaritiṇaikkaḷattukkuk kaṇkāṇi rājarājappāṇṭi nāṭṭu rājentracoḻavaḷanāṭṭuk kiḻkuṇṭāṟṟuc coḻacikāmaṇinallūruṭaiyāṉ cāttanṉ eṭṭiyum puravuvari tiṇaikkaḷanāyakam maturāntaka vaḷanāṭṭu āṇmā nāṭṭu maṇṇaikoṇṭa coḻanallūruṭaiyāṉ virapāṇṭiyaṉ colaiyum rājentracoḻavaḷanāṭṭu miḻalaik kūṟṟattuk kiḻkūṟṟu uttamacoḻanallūr uṭaiyāṉ kaṇṭaṉaraṅkaṉum maturāntaka vaḷanāṭṭu rājendracoḻakkuḷakkiḻak kuṟicci uṭaiyāṉ kaṇavati pūvaṉum rājendracoḻa vaḷanāṭṭu vaṭakaḷavaḻi nāṭṭu kālā—ṉ piccaṉum rājarājap pāṇṭi nāṭṭurājendracoḻavaḷanāṭṭu miḻalaik kūṟṟattu naṭuviṟkūṟṟu śrī parāntakanallūrk kaṭṭikuṟicci uṭaiyāṉ parameśvaraṉ kaṇṭaṉum mukaveṭṭi maturāntaka vaḷanāṭṭu iruñcoṇāṭṭut tuṟṟuṭaikkuṭaiyāṉ pakavaṉ catturu kālaṉum rājentra coḻavaḷa nāṭṭu miḻalaikkūṟṟattuk kiḻkūṟṟu rājakecarinallūruṭaiyāṉ kaṇṭaṉ kaḷiviraiyum innāṭṭu naṭuviṟkūṟṟu śrīparāntakanallūruṭaiyāṉ paṟpaṉāpaṉ kuvalaiyacantiraṉum coḻa maṇṭalattup pāṇṭikulācaṉi vaḷanāṭṭuk kiḷiyūr nāṭṭuc cūraikkuṭi uṭaiyāṉ nakkaṉ viraiyāc cilaiyum varippottakak kaṇakku rājarājappāṇṭināṭṭu maturāntaka vaḷanāṭṭup pūṅkāṉa nāṭṭuk karaiyirukkai naralokacuntaranallūruṭaiyāṉ centaṉ cāttaṉum variyiliṭu irā jendracoḻavaḷanā—maturāntakavaḷanāṭṭu māliviravaḷanāṭṭuk kumutakkuṭaiyāṉ centaṉ ciṅkamum innāṭṭu veṇpu nāṭṭu viracoḻanallūruṭaiyāṉ araiyaṉ mātevaṉum rājendracoḻavaḷanāṭṭuk kiḻaraṇiya muṭṭattuc cintūruṭaiyāṉ caṭaiyaṉ kūttaṉum iruntu yāṇṭu patiṉeḻāvatu nāḷeḻiṉāl muṭikoṇṭacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu melvempa nāṭṭuk kallūrk kaḷanilaṉ iruvelikkuk kiḻellai ikkallūr niṉṟum koṭaṉūrkke poṉa vaḻi varampukku meṟkum teṉṉellai kalālaiyuṭpaṭak koṭaṉūrkku vaṭakkum melellai maṭaippaḷḷi vayakkaluṭpaṭa maṭaippaḷḷi vāykkālukkup pāynta vāykkālum vāykkālukkuk kiḻakkum vaṭavellai melvempanāṭṭu nāṭṭārkālukkut teṟkum āka ivvicaitta perunāṉkellai—valiyum yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutal veṟu mutalākkip paḻampiyar tavirntu civapātacekaranallū reṉṉum tirunāmamāy innilattāl nilavopāti vanta kāṇikkaṭaṉ kācu patiṉāṟeyāṟumāvum nellu irunūṟṟorupattoṉpatiṉ kalaṉe tūṇippatakku nāṉāḻiyum nikarilicoḻaccaruppeti maṅkalattu śrīkayilāyamuṭaiya mahātevaṟku veṇṭu nivantaṅkaḷukku yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutaliṟuppatākavum ■ tevatāṉaṅkaḷaikkoṇṭu varumpaṭi aḻakerutuk kāṭcikkācum kāṭci erutukācum ūrkkaḻaiñcuṅ koḷḷāte yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutal tevatāṉa iṟaiyili yāka variyiliṭṭuk kuṭuttu ikkeḻvi eḻutiṉeṉ puravuvari tiṇaikkaḷattu veḷḷūruṭaiyāṉ pūvaṇavaṉulakaḷantaraṉeṉ ivai eṉṉeḻuttu ■ ivai puravuvaritiṇaikkaḷa—mukaveṭṭi śrīparāntakanallūruṭaiyāṉeḻuttu ■ ivai rājakecarinallūruṭaiyāṉeḻuttu ■ ivai puravuvaritiṇaikkaḷattuk kaṇkāṇi coḻacikāmaṇinallūruṭaiyā ṉeḻuttu ■ ivai varippottakanācakam uttaraṅkuṭaiyāṉ koḻumāṉ piccaṉeḻuttu ■ ivai variyiviṭucoḻa cikāmaṇinallūruṭaiyāṉeḻuttu ■■ ivai mukaveṭṭi cūraikkuṭaiyāṉeḻuttu ■ ivai muka veṭṭi cūraṅkkuṭaiyāṉeḻuttu ■ ivai paṭṭolai kumutakkuṭaiyāṉ centaṉ ciṅkatti ṉeḻuttu ■ ivai paṭṭolai koṭuntai kuḷamuṭaiyāṉ cūṟṟiteva ṉeḻuttu ■ ivai paṭṭolai viracoḻanallūruṭaiyāṉ arai—

variyiliṭu ■ rājentracoḻavaḷanāṭṭuk kiḻkuṇṭāṟṟuc coḻacikāmaṇinallūruṭaiyāṉ centil centaṉum paṭṭolai innāṭṭu meliraṇiyamuṭṭattuk kaṇkāṭuntaikkuḷamuṭaiyaraṉ ātitevaṉum maturāntakavaḷanāṭṭu māṉaviravaḷanāṭṭu attikkuṭaiyāṉ centaṉ ciṅkamum i veṇṇināṭṭu vira coḻanallūruṭaiyāṉ araiyaṉ mātevaṉum rājentracoḻavaḷanāṭṭuk kiḻiraṇiya muṭṭattucciṟutūruṭaiyāṉ araiyaṉ kūttaṉum iruntu yāṇṭu patiṉeḻāvatu nāḷ patiṉeḻiṉāl rājarājappāṇṭināṭṭu muṭikoṇṭacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu muḷḷināṭṭu brahmateyam rājarājaccaruppetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyārkkuk kācu kuṭuttu vilaikoṇṭa ivvūr nilattil kākkalūr melellai peruṅkāliṉ kiḻkaraikkuk kiḻakkum vaṭavellai śrīvāsutevavāykkālukku vaṭakku mutaṟ kaṇṇāṟṟu vaṭavācaṟutikkut teṟkum kiḻellai kaṭiñaiyāṟṟukku meṟkum teṉ kollai śrīvāsudevavāykkālukku vaṭakkum āka ivvicaitta perunāṉkellaiyuḷ akap paṭṭa nilaṉaiveliyum brahmadeyamāy varukiṉṟapaṭi yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutal tavirntu veḷḷāṉ vakaiyil mutalākkip paḻampaṭiyārai tavirntu śivacaraṇaśevaranallū reṉṉun tirunāmamāy innilattāl innāṭṭu veḷḷāṉ varicaikkiḻ iṟai kaṭṭumpaṭi yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutal iṟai kaṭṭi mutalāṉa iṟaikkaṭaṉ añāḻinārāyattāl aṟunūṟṟu nāṟpattirukalaṉe aṟukuṟuṇiyirunāḻi muḻakkeyiru ceviṭṭaraiyum uruvukol nilaṉ kācu muppattaiñcey kāley mukkāṇiyum kāṭaviḷākattuk kācu aiñcum rājarājac caruppetimaṅkalattut tiruvāliśvaramuṭaiya mahādevarkkut tiruviḻāppotavum ittevar koyilil nittam irupattaivar brāhmaṇar uṇṇavum śivadharmmam vācippā ṉoruvaṉukkum maṟṟum ittevarkku veṇṭum nivantaṅkaḷukkum yāṇṭu patiṉāṟāvatu mutal iṟuppatāka variyiliṭṭuk kuṭuttu yāṇṭu patiṉeḻāvatu nāḷ aimpattu muṉṟiṉāl uṭaiyār śrīcuntaracoḻapāṇṭiyatevar maturāntakavaḷanāṭṭu māṭak kuḷakkiḻ maturaiyiṉ vaṭapakkattup pakalirukkai nantavāṉam puttaṉil cittirakūṭattut tiruvamirtu ceytaruḷi rājendracoḻa atimuṟkacceṅkiraiyil eḻuntaruḷi iruntu muṭikoṇṭacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu muḷḷināṭṭu brahmadeyam rājarājac caruppetimaṅkalattut tiruvāliśvaramuṭaiya mahādevarkkut tiruviḻāp potavum ittevar koyilil nittam irupattaivar brāhmaṇar uṇṇavum śivadharmmamvācippāṉ oruvaṉukkum maṟṟum ittevarkku veṇṭum nivan=taṅkaḷukku iṟuppatāka rājarājac caruppetimaṅkalattup piṭākai kākkalūriley nilaṅ kuṭukka veṉṟu ammāṉ aruḷic ceytamaiyil ivvūr sabhaiyārkkuk kācu kuṭuttu vilaikkuk koṇṭu civacaraṇacekaranallūr eṉṉun tirunāmattāl variyiliṭ ṭinnilam aivelikkum muṉpu ellai piḻaikkap peci variyiliṭṭamaiyil muṉ pukka śrī ■ komāṟapanmarāṉa uṭaiyār śrī vikkiramacoḻapāṇṭiyatevaṟku yāṇṭu 2 10 5 āvatu rājarāja ■ pāṇṭināṭṭu uttamacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu muḷḷi nāṭṭu brahmadeyam nikarilicoḻaccaruppetimaṅkalattu coḻen=tiraciṅka īśvarattum śrīkayilāsattum akanāḻikai śiva civabrāhmaṇar ampalavaṉakkavirāṉ paṭṭaṉum nakkaṉ caṅkaranārāyaṇaṉum karumāṇikkappaṭṭaṉum pavarakkiraṇi ceyyāṉum uḷḷiṭṭa śivabrāhmaṇarom naṭuvirukkum karippuṟattu nampiyai mutukaṇṇākavuṭaiya ivar tāyār mātevi naṅkaiccāṉiyāka pakkal ivvūr śrīkayilāsamuṭaiyār koyilil rājādhirājan tiruccuṟṟālaikku eṅkaḷaik koṇṭa licattukku celavākak koṇṭa kācu 10 2 ikkācu paṉṉiraṇṭukku miv vāṭṭai yāṭittiṅkaḷ mutal candrādittaval nittam uḻakku ney śrī kayilāsattu dekṣiṇāmuttikaḷ koyilile poliyūṭṭukku celavāka erippom ■ eṅkaḷ paṅkukaḷ viṟkumiṭattum oṟṟivaikkumiṭattum ṭattum citaṉaṅ kuṭukkumiṭattum neyyuḻakkum erikkakkaṭavārākave kuṭuppomāṇom ■ ipparicu cantirātittavaṟ kācu 10 2■kkum poliyūṭṭāka nittam uḻakku ney tirunon=tāviḷak kerippomākavum ■ ipparicuppaṭi eriyātu muṭṭil poṉ aiṅ kaḻañcu poṉ taṇṭamum paṭa piṉṉai yum ............ erippatāṉom ivvaṉaivom ■ naṭuvirukkum karippuṟattu nampiyai mutukaṇ ṇāka vuṭaiya ivar tāyārmātevi naṅkaic cāṉiyārkku ikkācu koṇṭu iviḷakkerikkak kaṭava ampalava nakkavirāṉ paṭṭaṉeḻuttu ■ ipparicu inney erippatāṉa pavākkiraṇi mātavaṟeḻuttu ■ ipparicu inney erippatāṉa nakkaṉ caṅkara nārāyaṇa neḻuttu ■ ivarkaḷpaṇikka ivvolai eḻutiṉeṉ ivvūr sabhaikkaṇakku māl āyiratteṇma neḻuttu ■■
svasti śrī ■ komāṟavanmarāṉa uṭaiyār śrīvikkiramacoḻapāṇṭiyatevaṟku yāṇṭu 2 10 5■āvatu rājarājap pāṇṭināṭṭu uttamacoḻavaḷanāṭṭu kuṭanāṭṭu brahmateyam śrīrājādhirājaccaruppetimaṅkalattu āṟṟūr śrīsomaṉāta tevar civabrāhmaṇaṉ nārāyaṇaṉ piccaṉum viṉācakaṉ taṇṭi paṭṭaṉum pākkaraṉ comaṉum comaṉ taṇṭiyum uḷḷiṭṭa akanāḻikaiyom ittevarkaṉmikaḷukku oṭṭik kaittiṭ ṭiṭṭuk kuṭutta paricāvatu ■ maṅkalakkāluṭaiyār kaṇṭaṉ aiyyaṉārāṉa nirupacikāmaṇi muventaveḷār ittevar koyilil ceyta nivan=tañ celuttukaikku ittevar paṇṭārattu oṭukkiṉa kāciṭṭu śrī rājādhirājaccaruppetimaṅkalattu sabhaiyār pakkal koṇṭa nilam tirunārāyaṇavayakkal uḷḷiṭṭa nilam ivaṉ tiruttaṟat tiruttit tantamaiyil innilam nāṅkaḷey kaikkoṇṭu payireṟṟiyum payireṟṟuviccum āṭṭāṇṭutoṟum comaṉātaṉ marakkālāl aḷakkakkaṭava nellu eḻupatiṉkalam innellu eḻupatiṉ kalattiluṅ kār pātiyum picāṉam pātiyum aḷantu nāṅkaḷ celuttakkaṭava nivantamāvaṉa ■ ittevaṟku māsam prati amāvāsināḷ pāṟpoṉakattukku vaitta paḻavarici patiṉāḻikku nellu mukkuṟuṇi oru nāḻiyumparuppu irunāḻikku nel laṟu nāḻiyum pāl kuṟuṇikku nellu patakkiru nāḻiyumcaṟkarai irupalattukku nellu kuṟuṇiyum porikkaṟi amutukku nellu irunāḻiyum neyyuḻakkukku nellukkuṟuṇiyum aṭaikkāyamutukku nellu nāṉāḻiyum kucakkalat tukkum viṟakukkum nel ēḻunāḻiyum tāmaraip paḷḷittāmam nūṟukku nellu nāṉāḻiyum āka amāvāsi oṉṟiṉukkunellu irutūṇip patakkirunāḻiyāka orāṭṭaikku nellu patiṉkalaṉe mukkuṟuṇiyum amāvāsināḷ ikkoyilil uṇṇakkaṭava civabrāhmaṇar patiṉaiyvaṟkup perā larici irunāḻiyāka arici mukkuṟuṇi aṟunāḻikkum neyyurikkum caṟkarai oru palattukkum parup pirunāḻikkum tayir kuṟuṇikkum poḻkaṟi muṉṟukkum ilaikkaṟi oṉṟukkum uppukkum puḷikku miḷa kukkum kucakkalattukkum pākku muppatukkum veṟṟilai yeṇpatukkum aṭuvāṉukkum viṟakiṭuvāṉukkum brāhmaṇaruṇṇu miṭameḻukuvāṟkum neṟ kuṟuvāḷukkumāka amāvāsi yoṉṟiṉukku nellu kalaṉeyirutūṇip patakkirunāḻiyāka orāṭṭaikku nellu irupattiru kalaṉe mukkuṟuṇiyum ikkoyilil ucciyampotu cantiyil civayokikaḷukku nittamum oṭukkik kuṭukka kaṭava caṭṭic coṟoṉṟiṉuk kaṭu marici yirunāḻikkum poḻkaṟi añcukkum ney oru piṭikkum tayirurikkum uppukkum puḷikku miḷakukkum pākkiraṇṭukkum veṟṟilaiyañcukkuñ caṭṭiccoṟaṭuvāṟkum viṟakiṭuvāṉukkumāka nāḷoṉṟiṉukku nellu kuṟuṇiyirunāḻiyāka orāṭṭaikku nellu muppatteḻukalaṉe tūṇippatakkum āka nellu eḻupatiṉ kalattukkum ippaṭi nivantam ittevakaṉmikaḷkaṇkāṇippaṭiye can=titarātittavaṟ celuttakkaṭavomākavum meṟpaṭiyār pakkala nāṅkaḷ poliyūṭṭākak koṇṭa kācu iraṇṭukkup policai cekuttu ittevarkoyilil .... yārkku māmpaḻamum vāḻaippaḻamum uḷḷa nāḷāl nittam aiyvaiñcuppaḻam nicatappaṭi iṭakkaṭavomākavum ■ paḻampeṟa uṇṇātanāḷkaḷil eṇṇāppūri nicatam aiyvaiñcu cuṭṭuk kāṭṭakkaṭavomākavum ■ ipparicu innivantaṅkaḷ nāṅkaḷumeṅkaḷ vaṟkattārume cantirātittavaṟ celuttak kaṭavomāka icaintu innilamum ikkācuṅkaikkoṇṭom ikkoyilil akanāḻikai civabrāhmaṇarom ■
svasti śrī ■ komāṟavanmarāna uṭaiyār śrīvikkirama coḻapāṇṭiya tevarkku yāṇṭu irupattañcāvatu rājarājajappāṇṭināṭṭu uttamacoḻa vaḷanāṭṭu kuṭanāṭṭu brahmateyam rājādhirājac caruppetimaṅkalattu vaṭapiṭākai āṟṟūr śrīsomaṉātatevarāṉa teṉ tiruppūvaṇamuṭaiyārkku amāvāsitoṟum pañcagavyaṅkoṇṭu tiruvārātaṉai paṇṇa dravyaṅkaḷukku pāl nāḻikku nel iru nāḻiyum tayir urikku nel nāḻiyum ney uḻakkukku nel aññāḻiyum gomuttirattukkum gomayattukkum nel uriyum kalacam oṉpatukkump pūrṇṇakumpam oṉṟukku vilai nel aṟunāḻiyum i ...cciṉka kiḻaṭṭa nel kuṟuṇi oru nāḻiyum kiḻaṭṭa arici nāḻikku nel iru nāḻiyumkkurāddhyattukku kuṭukkum ... kkum nellu uḻakkum snapana puṭavai oṉṟukku nel tūṇippata ..... tu arici patakkukku nel aiṅkuṟuṇiyum............... nel aññāḻiyum ..... āḻākku nel irunāḻi uriyum tayiramutu iru nāḻikku nel nāṉāḻiyum aṭaikkarayamutu eṭṭukkum ilaiyamutu muppattiraṇṭukkum nel iru nāḻiyum .. śeṣat tiruppaḷḷittāmam koṭu varuvārkku nellu nāṉāḻiyum tiruvamutu aṭṭa miṭā iraṇṭum caṭṭi nālum olomi iraṇṭukkumnel aṟunāḻiyum viṟakukku nellu nāḻiyum tiruvārātaṉai ceyvāṉukkunel kuṟuṇiyum aṟṟai nāḷāl caṅkamukam dirtthamāṭi vanta brāhmaṇar paratecikaḷāy nallārāyiruppar patiṉmarkku kalam oṉṟiṉukku ariciyumkaṟiyum neyyum aṭṭuvatukkum pākkum veṟṟilaikkum nel patiṉāḻiyāka nel kalaṉe i .... ivai aṭṭaveṇṭuṅ kucakkalattukkunellu aṟu nāḻiyum .... iru nāḻiyum āka oru māsattukku veṇṭunellu iru koccaṭaiyapaṉmarāṉa tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīvallapadevaṟku yāṇṭu nālāvatu piḷḷaiyārśrīsundarapāṇḍyadevar āṇmānāṭṭu aṟukai kuṉṟattūril eḻuntaruḷiyirukka koyil uḷḷālaip paḷḷiyaṟai kūṭattup ikkuḷattukku . nir pāykiṟa kālai iṟakki vaṭakku nokki uḷvāykke pontu ikkuḷattu vaṭakaṭaikkompe eṟip parippai valattu vaiccu vaṭameṟku nokkip pontu.... puttūr mel kaṭaikkompile eṟi vaṭakku nokkip svasti śrī ■ tirumaṭantaiyuñ jayamaṭantaiyun tiruppuyaṅkaḷi liṉitiruppa virunilamum perumaiyetta veṇṭicaiyuṅ kuṭainiḻaṟṟa maṉṉarellām vantiṟaiñca marapil varu maṇimuṭi cūṭit teṉkumari mutalākat tiraikkaṭal lorellaiyākap pār muḻutuṅ kayalāṇai parantu ceṅkoluṭaṉ vaḷara maṉṉiya virasiṃhāsaṉattu ulakamuḻutuṭaiyāroṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya māmutal matikkulam viḷakkiya koccaṭaiyapaṉmarāṉa tribhuvaṉaccakravattikaḷ śrīvallabhatevaṟ māṭakkuḷakkiḻ maturaikkoyili ṉuḷḷālai aḻakiya pāṇṭiyaṉ kūṭattup paḷḷikkaṭṭil pāṇṭiyarājaṉil eḻuntaruḷi iruntu nāṭṭāṟṟuppokku perumpaḻañciyil varakuṇaviśvaramuṭaiyār koyililun tirunākiśvaramuṭaiyār koyililum puravuvariśvaramuṭaiyār koyiliṉum devakaṉkaṉmikaḷum śrīmaheśvarakaṇkāṇi ceyvārkaḷum ceyya tiruvāymoḻintaruḷiṉapaṭi it tevarkaḷukku ivvūr peruvaḻikku kiḻakku mekkum paḻantevatāṉamāy ittevarkaḷ kārāṇmaiyāy varukiṟa nila iṟaippaṭi velinilam ittevarkaḷukku tiruppaṭimāṟṟuḷḷiṭṭu veṇṭuṭu nittal nimantaṅkaḷukku antarāyamuḷpaṭa tevatāṉa iṟaiyiliyāka yāṇṭu 4■vatumutal peṟaveṇumeṉṟu māṉāparaṇamaṅkalattu aiyyar namakkuc coṉṉamaiyilittevarkaḷukku veṇṭu nimantaṅkaḷukku antarāya muḷpaṭa tevatāṉa iṟaiyiliyāka nāṭṭāṟṟuppokku perumpaḻañci peruvaḻikku kiḻakku meṟkkum ittevarkaḷ paḻantevatāṉamāy kārāṇmai iṟaiyiliyāy varukiṟa iṉṉilam veli nilamoṉṟu yāṇṭu 4■vatu mutal kaikkoṇṭu tiruppaṭi māṟṟuḷḷiṭṭu veṇṭu nittal nimantaṅkaḷ cellap paṇṇuka veṉṟu tiruvāymoḻintaruḷa puravuvariyār eḻuttiṭṭa uḷvarippaṭiyāluḷḷa nilaṅ kallil veṭṭuka eṉṟu tiruvāymoḻintaruḷiṉār ■ ivaiteṉṉavataraiyaṉ eḻuttu ■ ivai vaṉṉāṭu uṭaiyā ṉeḻuttu ■
■■■ svasti śrī ■ tirumaṭantaiyum jayamaṭantaiyun tiruppuyaṅkaḷi liṉitiruppa irunilamum perumai eytaeṇṭicaiyum kuṭainiḻaṟṟa maṉṉavarellām vantiṟaiñca marapil vanta maṇimuṭi cūṭi teṉkumariyum vaṭakaṅkaiyun tiraikkaṭale ellaiyāka pārmuḻutuṅ kayalāṇai parantu ceṅkoluṭaṉ vaḷara maṉṉiya virasiṃhāsanattu ulakamuḻutuṭaiyāroṭum viṟṟiruntaruḷiya māmutal matikkulam viḷakkiya komutal koccaṭaiyapanmarāṉa tripuvaṉacakkaravattikaḷ śrīvallava devaṟku yāṇṭu nālāvatu tiruvaḻuti vaḷanāṭṭu peruṅkuḷamāṉa uttamapāṇṭiyanallūr tiruvaḻuti īśvaram uṭaiya
svasti śrī ■ tirumaṭantaiyuñ jayamaṭantaiyum tiruppuyaṅkaḷilinitiruppa irunilamum perumaiyeyta eṇṭicaiyuṅ kuṭai niḻaṟṟa maṉṉavarellāmvantiṟaiñca marapile varumaṇimuṭi cūṭitteṉkumariyum vaṭakaṅkaiyun tiraikkaṭale yellaiyākakappār muḻutuṅ kayalāṇai parantu ceṅkoluṭaṉ vaḷara virasiṅhāsaṉattu ulakamuḻutuṭaiyāḷuṭaṉ vīṟṟiruntaruḷiya māmutal matikkulam viḷakkiṭak komutaṟk koccaṭaiyapaṉmarāṉa tribhuvanacakravattikaḷ śrīvallavadevaṟku yāṇṭu 4 āvatu keraḷaciṅkavaḷanāṭṭu ataḷaiyūrnāṭṭut teṉāṟṟuppokkut tirukkuṉṟakkuṭit tirumalaiyil śrīmulastāna muṭaiya nāyaṉārkkuiṉṉāṭṭu ataḷaiyūr nāṭṭāḻvāṉ mumamuṭicoḻaṉ viracekaranen kiḻkkakaṇṇamaṅkalattu eṉṉopātiyālvanta iṟai kuṭimai kaṭamaiyum puṟaviṟai antarāyam eppeṟpaṭṭatu
svasti śrī ■ tribhuvaṉaccakkaravattikaḷ śrīvallavatevaṟkku yāṇṭu añcāvatu muḷḷi nāṭṭu brahmadeyam śrīceravaṉmātevic caturvetimaṅkalattu śrīkayilāsamuṭaiya mahādevarkku ivvūrp pāṭakattu kuppai nampi brāhmaṇi setuvuṭaiyāḷ itdevaṟkku vaitta tirununtāviḷakku oṉṟukku vaitta cāvā muvāp perāṭu aimpatuṅ kaikkoṇṭu cantrātittavaṟ tirununtāviḷakku nittam uḻakku ney celuttak kaṭavomāṉom ikkoyil śivabrāhmaṇar civaṉ cāttapirāṉ paṭṭaṉum ampalavaṉ nakkapirāṉ paṭṭaṉum caṅkaranārāyaṇaṉ cakkarapāṇiyum civaṉ śrīkayilāsa muṭaiyāṉum comāṉ ... pirāṉ paṭṭaṉum ivvaṉaivom ikkoyil eṅkaḷ pakkal vilai oṟṟi taṉma tāṉamuṭaiyārum ippaṭiyey celuttakkaṭavarāka cammatittom ivvaṉaivom ivvāṭaimpatukkum aṉṟāṭu vilaikkup peciṉa tiramam toṇṇūṟum aṟakkoṇṭu nāḷ oṉṟukku ney uḻakku celuttakkaṭavom i...... cantirātittavaraiyum celuttukaikku tarākkutti viḷakku eṭai patineṭṭum kaikkoṇṭom ivvaṉaivom ■■
svasti śrī ■ koccaṭaiyapanmarāṉa uṭaiyārśrīvallavadevaṟku yāṇṭuaiñcāvatu muḷḷināṭṭu brahmateyam ceravaṉmāteviccaturvetimaṅkalattu śrīkayilāsamuṭaiyārkku centaṉ cittanāṉa canemaya māṇiyāṉ kālvaḻināṭ ṭuyyakkoṇṭāṉceṉtaṉ cittaṉāṉa ..ya ceṉā . vaṉeṉvaitta tirununtāviḷakku onṟukku vaitta cāvāḻuvāpperāṭu aimpatum ivaiaimpatum kaikkoṇṭu ivveyiṟṟāl ney uḻakkum celuttakkaṭavaṉṉen i⌈ṭaiyan kāri cāttanāṉa nikarilicoḻakkoṉen ■ inneymuṭṭil ittevar kanmikaḷe vi⌈ṭai iṭṭupa taṇṭamkoṇṭum pinṉaiyum en vaṟkattāraiyum koṇṭu celuttak kalveṭṭikkuṭutten kāricāttaṉeṉ ■ ittiruviḷakku eṉ talaimelina ■
